data.jd_text:
**1 Mission** 




 The Project Director is in charge of the complete implementation of the management strategy for projects under his/her responsibility, and for which he/she has the support of resources either inside or outside the affiliate.
 



 To meet the expectations of Clients, for whom he/she is the direct and key contact, the Project Director supervises architectural and technical studies. Every decision of design modification leading to financial consequences is taken by him/her. At the same time, he/she guarantees the economic balance of the project and the respect of Quality principles. He/she also deals with all the contractual issues between Artelia Airports and its clients.
 



 In the management of studies, the Project Director supervises the project teams made available. He/she draws up and manages design contracts entered into with designers outside Artelia Airports and guarantees their functioning. With the support of the functional resources of affiliates, he/she defines the subcontracting strategy, then drafts and manages the subcontracting contracts necessary to project implementation.
 



 He/She contributes to the definition of the affiliate’s strategic focus.
 



  





**2 Line and Staff Relations** 




 The role will directly report to the Director, Production and Operations and will work in close collaboration with the following teams:
 



  




* ARTELIA AIRPORTS Staff
* Design Manager
* Contract Administrator
* Director of Tendering and Consulting
* Resident Engineer
* Planning Engineer
* Design Team, all disciplines
* Supervision Team at site
* QA/QC
* HSE
* External Collaborators
* Client Representatives
* Sub\-Consultants
* Contractors / Sub\-Contractors



  





**3 Key Responsibilities** 




 Ensures the management of signed contracts
 


* He/she negotiates the technical and financial approach to projects in his/her portfolio (with Management assisted by the Business Development)
* He/she defines the progress of the project (consistent with the Client’s specifications) and the recourse to outside resources (subcontracting)
* He/she defines the technical, budgetary and financial resources necessary
* He/she defines resources to be implemented and monitoring indicators
* He/she monitors Management’s continuous and adequate information as far as finance, technical choices and deadlines are concerned, in providing the Administrative, Financial and Human Resources Director and the Director of Production and Operations with the data necessary to their audit (Control Panels and performance indicators)
* He/she uses feedback information from the Administrative, Financial and Human Resources Director and the Director of Production and Operations in the management of his project
* He/she supervises studies and manages teams:
* breaks specifications down into study objectives and study team needs
* establishes the monitoring indicators of studies to be carried out
* directs, focuses and coordinates the group of project contributors, i.e. :
* is in charge of teams under his/her direct responsibility.
* focuses and coordinates the work of outside designers.
* coordinates the work of teams, including those teams working on the site.
* monitors subcontractors.
* monitors Artelia Airports spending and manages it in relation to projected financial schedules.
* guarantees project / Client program appropriateness (functional and technical aspects, study and finishing deadlines and target costs)
* monitors Quality and the respect of project deadlines through continuous dialogue with outside designers (optimization of economic choices, project consistency)
* contributes to the concrete production of studies
* updates the Director of Operations and Production on technical bases
* He/she manages Client relations:
* conducts the technical dialogue on the project with the Client (technical choices, functionality)
* validates the various stages of the project with the Client
* conducts the closure of services due under contracts entered into with Clients
* implements the contracts entered into with the Clients
* monitors the deadlines, quality and costs follow\-up
* is responsible to report to executive management any changes of the Artelia Airports contract
* prepares, with support from the Business Development Manager, the technical and financial files for possible complaints (follow\-up letters etc…)
* advises the Business Development Manager and Executive Management in terms on market opportunities when required
* He/she updates load plans by:
* Defining staff needs according to their skills
* Allowing or denying additional missions
* Accepting vacations
* Managing all the means needed for his project
* Contractors:
* signs all the instructions to the contractor including:
* notice to proceed and eventually to stop the works on site
* technical variation orders
* financial variation orders
* schedule variation orders
* penalty orders for delay
* validates all the contractors’ submissions and quality control plans produced by contractors or he/she can delegate such responsibility.
* He/she follows the project for Artelia Airports by :
* Following its spending and invoices
* Approving the schedule for the project
* Approving the missions and reporting it to the Managing Director
* Within the framework of his activities, the Project Director contributes, in a relevant manner, to the fulfillment of Quality objectives.



  





**4 Profile Specifications – Minimum Requirements** 



* Bachelor's or Master's Degree in airport management, planning, aviation science, or engineering.
* 15 years’ experience minimum on large size construction projects or similar transportation projects in a similar position, with a minimum of 3 airport projects references strongly preferred \- both design and site supervision.
* Thorough knowledge of engineering design, construction estimating, facility operation, project budgeting and scheduling.
* Demonstrated knowledge of capital planning and assessment, cost\-benefit analysis, planning and evaluation, and risk management protocols
* Experienced in Project Management and FIDIC contracts
* Experience in ICAO and IATA regulations is a plus
* Excellent presentation, coordination and leadership skills
* Knowledge of local laws and regulations, international codes and standards
* Fluent in English; reading, writing and speaking
* Proficiency in the use of standard Microsoft Office products, Primavera (Oracle’s Project Management software) or MS Project.
* Eligibility for frequent travels to be expected.
* SoE membership and AUH Engineering license are mandatory or proven eligibility



  





***Note to external recruiters:***
*Please note that Artelia Airports does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters or employment agencies. In the absence of a signed Recruitment Fee Agreement, Artelia Airports will not consider or agree to payment of any referral compensation or recruiter fee. In the event a recruiter or agency submits a resume or candidate without a previously signed agreement, Artelia Airports explicitly reserves the right to pursue and hire those candidate(s) without any financial obligation to the recruiter or agency. Any unsolicited resumes, including those submitted to hiring managers, are deemed to be the property of Artelia Airports and no fee will be paid in the event the candidate is hired by Artelia Airports as a result of the referral or through other means.*

**Manatal** 
 is an HRTech software service (B2B SaaS) company headquartered in Bangkok, Thailand. Manatal is one of the fastest\-growing start\-ups in the region and is backed by Surge and Sequoia Capital.
 



 Manatal has a global presence and is trusted by thousands of businesses in over 135 countries. Our goal is to transform the entire hiring process by making it simple, efficient, and enjoyable for recruiters, hiring managers, and candidates alike. Our mission is to offer the best\-in\-class AI\-powered technologies to empower small, medium, and large businesses in their staffing \& recruitment transformation.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 



* **Drive Technical Excellence:** 
 Lead major technical initiatives, ensuring architectural soundness, scalability, and long\-term impact.
* **Own Delivery:** 
 Oversee full project lifecycles from design to deployment with a focus on speed, quality, and reliability.
* **Release Management:** 
 Run a predictable release process with progressive delivery, clear rollout and rollback strategies, and strong operational readiness.
* **Platform Ownership:** 
 Own the AWS and Kubernetes platform end\-to\-end, including reliability, security, performance, and cost.
* **Hands\-On Execution:** 
 Stay close to the work by writing code, reviewing PRs, debugging production issues, and improving core services when needed.
* **Infrastructure as Code:** 
 Design, standardize, and maintain Terraform\-managed environments and operational best practices.
* **CI/CD and Velocity:** 
 Own CI/CD pipelines, improve build and deploy reliability, reduce lead time, and remove friction from the developer workflow.
* **Observability and Reliability:** 
 Implement and maintain monitoring, logging, alerting, dashboards, and SLO\-driven reliability practices.
* **On\-Call Leadership:** 
 Build and manage on\-call rotations, incident response, escalation paths, and postmortems with clear follow\-ups.
* **Technical Standards:** 
 Set and enforce engineering standards for architecture, code quality, security, and operational discipline.
* **Team Leadership:** 
 Mentor and develop engineers, create ownership, and keep priorities clear and execution under control.
* **Cross\-Functional Alignment:** 
 Partner with Product and other stakeholders to align platform work with business goals and delivery commitments.



**Qualifications** 




 We are looking for a hands\-on Director of Platform Engineering with the qualifications below. Each requirement is mandatory for this role:
 


* **Software Engineering Background:** 
 8\+ years building and operating production web applications and systems.
* **Platform Engineering Background:** 
 5\+ years owning AWS and Kubernetes in production, including reliability, security, and cost control.
* **Hands\-On Leadership:** 
 Regularly designs, implements, debugs, and reviews code and infrastructure, and can execute independently when needed.
* **Startup Mindset:** 
 Thrives in fast\-moving startups, takes ownership, works hard when needed, and brings high energy with a bias for action.
* **Infrastructure as Code Experience:** 
 Proven Terraform ownership across multiple environments, including networking, compute, and access controls.
* **Delivery and Releases:** 
 Owns CI/CD pipelines, release processes, progressive rollouts, and rollback strategies to keep deployments fast and safe.
* **Observability Stack:** 
 Has implemented and operated monitoring, logging, alerting, and dashboards with Datadog and/or Prometheus/Grafana.
* **On\-Call Operations:** 
 Build, manage and run on\-call rotations, incident response, and postmortems, and is willing to be on\-call when required.
* **Execution Focus:** 
 Sets clear priorities, protects development velocity, and keeps platform work under control.
* **Communication Skills:** 
 Communicates clearly and directly, and collaborates effectively across engineering and product.
* **English Fluency:** 
 Fluent in spoken and written English for high\-stakes technical discussions.
* **Relocation Readiness:** 
 Based in Bangkok or willing to relocate and work in a multicultural team.



**Working with Manatal** 



* This role is based at our Bangkok office in the heart of the city center
* As a team of diverse cultures and nationalities, English language proficiency is required
* We enjoy collaborating in person, and the team is working on\-site



**Why you'll enjoy working with Manatal** 



* Well\-funded start\-up backed by Surge \& Sequoia
* Be part of one of the fastest\-growing B2B SaaS start\-ups in the region
* You will be collaborating with talented individuals in the industry
* Join a lively and highly international team
* Indulge in a challenging and innovative working culture
* Attractive medical healthcare plan
* Personal development allowance
* 2 weeks of work from anywhere per year
* Regular fun team\-building activities



**Hiring Process:** 




 You can expect in our hiring process some or all of the following rounds:
 


1. Introduction interview with the HR team
2. Introduction interview with CTO and/or Director of Engineering
3. Technical Interview with technical assessment
4. Cultural fit interview with top management team



**Our Tech Stack:** 




 Our engineering team leverages a variety of modern technologies. While working at Manatal, you can expect to be exposed to the following stack:
 


* **Infrastructure:** 
 Amazon Web Services; Kubernetes; GitOps (ArgoCD), GitHub Actions, Terraform, among others.
* **Backend:**
* Language: Python (Django, FastAPI);
* Databases: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Open/ElasticSearch, and Redis, among others;
* Other: Celery, RabbitMQ, among others.
* **Frontend:** 
 Typescript (Vue, React)

 We are seeking an experienced Corporate Tax Director to lead complex engagements across the UAE, advising multinational groups, regional conglomerates, family offices and sovereign wealth funds on UAE Corporate Tax and related advisory matters. The role combines market leadership, technical excellence, and people management, with accountability for client portfolio growth, quality execution, and risk management. You will be a senior member of the leadership team, shaping our go‑to‑market strategy and coaching high‑performing teams to deliver exceptional client outcomes. 
 


**How You’ll Contribute** 

**Key responsibilities** 




 You will support the Corporate Tax Partners and lead and oversee a diverse portfolio covering advisory, compliance, controversy, and transactions: 
 



 Client leadership and advisory 
 


* Serve as lead advisor on UAE Corporate Tax matters under Federal Decree‑Law No. 47 of 2022 and implementing decisions, including group structuring, free zone regimes, participation exemption, interest limitation, deductibility, loss utilisation, business restructuring, and permanent establishment and nexus analyses.
* Lead complex transactions and reorganisations, including due diligence, tax structuring, SPA tax clauses, step‑plan design, post‑deal integration, and tax accounting implications.



 Engagement delivery and quality 
 


* Set engagement strategy, scope, budgets, and staffing plans; ensure timely, high‑quality deliverables aligned to global methodologies, independence, and risk management requirements.
* Review and sign‑off technical analyses, memoranda, models, and client reports; ensure clear articulation of positions and defensibility under UAE law and OECD standards.
* Oversee tax compliance for complex groups, including registrations, elections, group relief/consolidation, returns, and tax accounting/disclosures under IFRS; ensure robust documentation and workpapers.



 Market development 
 


* Drive business development with existing and new clients; originate and convert pipeline; lead proposals, thought leadership, and market eminence initiatives focused on priority sectors (financial services, energy, real estate, technology, consumer/retail, logistics, sovereign/PE).
* Build executive‑level relationships (CFO, Tax Director) and cultivate a trusted‑advisor profile through insights on regulatory developments and market trends.



 People leadership 
 


* Lead, coach, and develop high‑performing teams across grades; provide on‑the‑job training, formal feedback, and sponsorship; promote inclusion and psychological safety.
* Foster collaboration across service lines (TP, Deals, Legal, Audit, Consulting) to deliver integrated solutions and develop next‑generation leaders.



 Risk, ethics, and operations 
 


* Uphold the firm’s quality, independence, confidentiality, and information security standards; proactively manage engagement risks and escalation protocols.
* Ensure accurate WIP, billing, and cash collection; deliver profitable growth against targets.


**What You’ll Bring** 

**Qualifications and experience** 



* 12\+ years of relevant corporate/international tax experience, with significant time in a Big Four or leading law/consulting firm; strong UAE/GCC exposure required.
* Deep technical command of UAE Corporate Tax law and guidance.
* Proven track record leading large, multi‑jurisdictional engagements and managing senior client stakeholders.
* Demonstrable business development success, with experience originating and closing sizable advisory projects.
* Strong understanding of IFRS tax accounting (IAS 12\) and reporting for groups; familiarity with GloBE deferred tax, safe harbours, and data requirements will be an advantage.
* Experience with Revenue Authority interactions, audits, rulings/clarifications, and dispute strategies will be an advantage.



**Education and professional credentials** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Law, Economics, or related field; advanced degree preferred.
* Recognised tax/accounting qualification preferred (e.g., ADIT, CTA, ACA, CPA, CFA, or equivalent).
* Arabic language skills are advantageous; fluency in English is required.



**Technical and leadership competencies** 



* Expert written and oral communication, with the ability to translate complex rules into pragmatic, commercially grounded advice.
* Strong financial modelling and data literacy; ability to guide clients on tax data, systems, and controls, including Pillar Two data readiness.
* High judgment and negotiation skills; capable of defending positions and navigating regulatory dialogue.
* Inclusive leadership, team building, and coaching at scale; resilient under pressure with excellent project management discipline.



**Technology and data** 




 You are proficient with MS Office and tax compliance platforms, and familiar with data extraction and transformation for tax compliance and reporting. You are comfortable utilising and developing market leading tax technology to support your role and deliver value to our clients, including AI, automation and analytics. 
 


**How You’ll Make a Difference** 

 At PwC Midde East, we expect all our people to embody the skills and behaviours of The PwC Professional framework, helping us deliver on our strategy while growing and developing as leaders at every level.  
 


**Why You’ll Love Working at PwC** 

 At PwC Middle East, you’ll find more than just a job \- you’ll build a meaningful career, supported by rewards and benefits that help you thrive. We offer competitive pay, comprehensive benefits, and programs that promote well\-being, balance, and personal growth. You’ll have access to continuous learning, digital upskilling, and a collaborative environment that values innovation, mentorship, and diversity. Are you ready to make a difference? Want to unlock new value by applying your unique perspective and talents? You can grow exponentially here. Discover more about Life at PwC Middle East.

data.title: Quality Engineer Manager - Global Data Center Segment
data.raw_snippet:
Join Our Team at Eaton: Empowering Tomorrow, Today!
   

  

 Dubai serves as a strategic hub for Eaton’s Middle East operations, bringing together commercial, engineering, manufacturing, and support teams within a globally connected business environment. Building on more than 40 years in the region
data.jd_text:
Join Our Team at Eaton: Empowering Tomorrow, Today!
   

  

 Dubai serves as a strategic hub for Eaton’s Middle East operations, bringing together commercial, engineering, manufacturing, and support teams within a globally connected business environment. Building on more than 40 years in the region, Eaton recently announced the development of a new sustainable campus in Dubai, reinforcing our long‑term investment in growth, collaboration, and capability building.
   

  

**Eaton's Global Data Center Segment** 
 is focused on helping data centers realize real business benefits today while optimizing their operations for the future. With the rise of big data, edge computing and cloud, data centers are under pressure to be more high\-performing, sustainable and cost\-effective than ever, without compromising resilience or security. At the same time, new opportunities and revenue streams require faster speed\-to\-market. With our digital intelligence, world\-class cyber\-secure products and services, reliable, compatible solutions and engineering expertise, we help data centers realize real business benefits today while optimizing their operations for the future.
   

  

 Within this segment, Eaton has an opening for a
 **Quality Manager – Global Data Center Segment** 
 . This position is a senior, globally accountable leader that is leader responsible for defining, governing, and continuously improving the end‑to‑end quality framework for post‑order execution across
 **Eaton’s Global Data Center Segmen** 
 t.
   

  

 Operating within the
 **Post Order Center of Excellence (CoE)** 
 , this role ensures that quality is designed into execution—not inspected in after the fact—by establishing global standards, assurance mechanisms, testing rigor, and process discipline that scale across regions, customers, and service offers. The position plays a critical role in enabling consistent, reliable, and repeatable customer outcomes while supporting Eaton’s growth with hyperscale and colocation data center customers worldwide. This role is based in Dubai, serving as a global coordination hub, and works across regions, time zones, and functions to drive a “one Eaton” quality mindset for post‑order delivery.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
**Global Quality Strategy \& Governance**
* Define and own the global post\-order quality strategy for the Global Data Center Segment, aligned with segment priorities, customer expectations, and Eaton enterprise standards.
* Establish and maintain a single global quality framework covering assurance, testing, process compliance, and continuous improvement across regions.
* Partner with the Post Order Director, Services, Engineering, PMO, OPEX, and regional execution leaders to embed quality expectations into operating models and execution rhythms.


**Quality Assurance \& Testing**
* Lead global assurance and testing methodologies to validate that post\-order deliverables, services, and execution outcomes meet defined quality, safety, and reliability standards.
* Ensure quality gates, reviews, and acceptance criteria are consistently applied across complex, multi\-region data center programs.
* Drive root\-cause analysis and corrective actions for systemic quality issues, partnering cross\-functionally to prevent recurrence.


**Process Quality \& Standardization**
* Own global process quality for post\-order execution, ensuring that standardized processes are clearly defined, documented, deployed, and adhered to.
* Work closely with the Quality Analyst – Process and OPEX partners to identify gaps, simplify workflows, and eliminate variation that negatively impacts customer outcomes.
* Support the evolution of global processes as services scale, new offers are introduced, or customer requirements change.


**Performance Management \& Continuous Improvement**
* Define and monitor global quality KPIs, dashboards, and review cadences that provide transparency into performance, risk, and trends.
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives focused on reducing defects, rework, cycle time, and execution risk while improving customer satisfaction.
* Escalate critical quality risks with clear data, options, and recommendations to senior leadership.


**People Leadership \& Capability Building**
* Lead, coach, and develop a small but highly impactful global quality team, including the Quality Analyst – Assurance \& Testing and Quality Analyst – Process.
* Build quality capability across the broader Post Order organization by influencing leaders and teams beyond direct reporting lines.
* Foster a culture where quality, safety, and accountability are core expectations—not trade\-offs for speed


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Quality, Operations, or a related technical discipline from an accredited institution.
* Minimum of 15 years of experience in quality management, operational excellence, or execution leadership within complex, global, engineered\-to\-order or services\-led environments.


**Skills**
* Experience supporting data center, critical power, or infrastructure services.
* Formal quality or continuous improvement certifications (e.g., Lean, Six Sigma, ISO‑related frameworks).
* Experience working in or leading teams based in the Middle East or other global hubs.
* Experience driving standard work and continuous improvement across regions (process discipline \+ pragmatism).


**Why Join Eaton**
* Competitive compensation and benefits, aligned with your experience and impact.
* Opportunity to work on challenging, high‑impact projects within a dynamic and collaborative team environment.
* Your aspirations matter – Eaton actively supports internal mobility and promotes from within whenever possible.
* Your growth matters – We invest in long‑term development through continuous learning, upskilling, and global programs via Eaton University.
* Your contributions matter – Reliability, safety, efficiency, and sustainability are at the heart of what we do, driving meaningful impact on people’s lives and the environment.
* Your wellbeing matters – Health, safety, and wellness are a priority. At Eaton, wellbeing goes beyond programs, empowering employees with the tools and environment to thrive.


**Living And Working In Dubai**
 Dubai is an internationally connected city that offers strong professional opportunities within a truly global environment. Living and working in Dubai means being part of a diverse, forward‑looking business community, supported by modern infrastructure, excellent connectivity, and a well‑established expatriate ecosystem.
   

  

 At Eaton, employees based in Dubai are part of a stable, well‑governed organization that brings together global teams, clear ways of working, and the flexibility needed to support both performance and long‑term career development.
   

  

 All positions may require participation in video and in\-person interviews as part of the hiring process. All candidates will be evaluated based on job\-related competencies, and all candidates’ privacy rights and data security will be protected in accordance with applicable laws.
   

  

 We are committed to ensuring equal employment opportunities for job applicants and employees. Our recruitment processes use balanced selection criteria and avoid unlawful discrimination against applicants on the basis of their age, colour, disability, marital status, national origin, gender, gender identity, genetic information, race or racial origin, religion, sexual orientation or any other status protected or required by law.

data.title: Commercial Director
data.raw_snippet:
**Job Purpose:**




 To lead exhibition and sponsorship sales delivery for AixEnergy Asia 2026, owning the commercial pipeline end\-to\-end and converting it into contracted revenue against the budget target. The Commercial Director carries an individual revenue number, manages the AixEnergy agent
data.jd_text:
**Job Purpose:**




 To lead exhibition and sponsorship sales delivery for AixEnergy Asia 2026, owning the commercial pipeline end\-to\-end and converting it into contracted revenue against the budget target. The Commercial Director carries an individual revenue number, manages the AixEnergy agent network, and works alongside the VP to close exhibition packages, sponsorship inventory, and feature areas. The role is the senior commercial operator on the AixEnergy team and is accountable for the Year 1 close and the Year 2 rebooking pipeline captured on\-site plus any additional AixEnergy edition launches.
 



  





**Key Accountabilities:**




 Own the AixEnergy Asia 2026 exhibition and sponsorship pipeline end\-to\-end: prospecting, qualification, proposal, negotiation, and contract close. Carry an individual revenue target and report progress weekly against the Revenue Pathway forecast.
 



 Open and convert priority accounts across hyperscalers, data centre operators, energy and utility companies, EPCs, industrial real estate developers, and AI infrastructure vendors. Build credible peer\-level relationships with senior commercial decision\-makers and convert verbal interest into signed contracts.
 



  





 Manage and grow the AixEnergy agent network. Set agent targets, brief on pricing and proposition, and quality\-control agent\-sourced leads before they enter the AixEnergy pipeline.
 



 Work on sponsorship sales to convert sponsorship inventory: title partner, strategic partners, theatre and feature sponsorships, and on\-site activations.
 



  





 Maintain Salesforce hygiene to dmg events standard: every opportunity logged, staged, weighted, and updated weekly. Provide accurate weekly forecasts to the VP and into the WSR (Weekly Sales Report) cadence, with clear flags on slipped, won, and at\-risk deals.
 



  





 Maintain working knowledge of the AI infrastructure and energy markets: track competitor events, pricing benchmarks, exhibitor movements, and account\-level developments that affect AixEnergy's pipeline and pricing. Feed market intelligence back into the proposition and the floor plan.
 



 Work closely with Marketing, Operations, Content, and Finance to ensure the commercial pipeline is fed, supported, and delivered. Brief Marketing on priority targets and EDM cadence; align with Operations on floor plan, build, and exhibitor delivery; coordinate with Finance on contracting, invoicing, and collections.
 



  





 Deliver a strong on\-site rebooking result for AixEnergy 2027, including target rebooking rate (40%\+) by end of show, signed Letters of Intent for 2027, and a qualified Year 2 pipeline document handed to the team within 30 days of the close of the 2026 edition.
 



  





**Job Context:**




 AixEnergy Asia 2026 is a launch\-edition event. The Commercial Director is joining at a critical phase of the cycle and is expected to close the gap to budget through direct sales, agent activation, and conversion of the existing pipeline. The event is co\-located with Gastech 2026 in Bangkok but operates as a standalone product with its own P\&L, exhibition, sponsorship inventory, and conference. The Commercial Director reports to the VP ADIPEC \& Business Development and works alongside the Operations Director, the Marketing Director and the Head of Content. The role requires a senior operator capable of working independently in an early\-stage commercial environment, holding peer\-level conversations with hyperscale and energy executives, and delivering against a hard September 2026 close.
 



  





**Qualifications, Experience, \& Skills:**




 Technical / Functional: Minimum 7 years senior B2B exhibition and sponsorship sales experience, with a track record of personally carrying and delivering revenue targets in excess of US$1m. Demonstrable success selling at a senior, peer\-level into AI infrastructure, data centres, energy, utilities, or industrial sectors. Experience launching first\-edition events strongly preferred. Working knowledge of Salesforce or equivalent CRM is essential. Familiarity with ASEAN markets, particularly Thailand, Singapore, Malaysia, and Indonesia, is an advantage. Experience working with sales agents and channel partners. Understanding of how exhibition, sponsorship, and conference content combine into a single commercial proposition. Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience.
 



  





 Personal Attributes / Interpersonal: Senior commercial presence; comfortable holding peer\-level conversations with hyperscale procurement leads, energy company executives, and EPC commercial directors. Closer’s instinct: identifies the path to contract early and drives the deal to signature. Self\-directed and entrepreneurial; able to operate effectively in a launch\-phase environment without established processes or large team support. Resilient under pressure; comfortable with hard targets, weekly forecast scrutiny, and a non\-negotiable September 2026 close. Disciplined with CRM hygiene and forecast accuracy. Collaborative across Marketing, Operations, Content, and Finance; treats the pipeline as a shared commercial asset. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English. Willing to travel internationally as required, including to Bangkok ahead of and during the September 2026 event.
 



  





**dmg events is an equal opportunity employer. If you have not had feedback from us within 14 days, please consider your application as unsuccessful for this round.**

data.jd_text:
**Job Purpose:** 




 To lead the design and continuous improvement of seamless, user\-centred customer journeys across all touchpoints and channels. This role ensures that every stage of the customer experience is intuitive, efficient, and aligned with the company’s service standards and strategic goals. By applying design thinking and data driven insights, the Manager — Customer Experience Design drives initiatives that enhance satisfaction, foster loyalty, and strengthen the brand’s reputation for excellence in customer care.
 



  





**Key Accountabilities:** 




**Customer Experience Design \& Innovation** 



* Lead the creation and maintenance of detailed customer journey maps and service blueprints for key customer segments.
* Apply design thinking methodologies to identify pain points and develop innovative solutions that simplify and enhance customer interactions.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams (e.g., IT, Marketing, Operations) to implement design solutions that align with digital transformation and business goals.
* Develop prototypes (UI/ UX) screens, test concepts with end\-users, and iterate designs based on feedback and data insights.



  





**Customer Insights \& Measurement** 



* Analyse qualitative and quantitative customer feedback to inform design priorities and validate experience improvements.
* Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) for journey effectiveness, including customer satisfaction (CSAT), Net Promoter Score (NPS), and journey friction points.
* Regularly present insights and design recommendations to senior management.



  





**People Leadership** 



* Lead and mentor team members to build strong design and customer empathy capabilities.
* Set clear performance objectives, provide regular feedback, and support professional development to maximize team effectiveness.
* Foster a collaborative culture of innovation and continuous improvement.



  





**Governance, Compliance \& Reporting** 



* Ensure compliance with information security and privacy requirements in all design initiatives.
* Adhere to and champion company policies, processes, and standards to maintain consistent and high\-quality service delivery.
* Prepare timely and accurate reports on journey performance, project progress, and design impact for leadership review.



  





**Continuous Improvement** 



* Identify opportunities to enhance departmental tools, methodologies, and best practices in line with global CX design trends.
* Lead or contribute to projects that drive service excellence and operational efficiency.



  





**Other Duties** 



* Perform other responsibilities related to the role as assigned by the Director — Customer Experience.



  





**Qualifications and Experience:** 




**Minimum Qualification** 



* Bachelor’s degree in marketing, Business or relevant field
* MBA is a preference



  





**Minimum Experience and Skills** 



* At least 5 years of experience in customer experiences related field.
* Multi\-disciplinary with excellent understanding of all touchpoints in the customer lifecycle.
* Ability to collaborate with multiple teams (e.g., Marketing, IT, external partners).
* Familiar with designing UI/UX screens on Figma or any other similar tool.
* Familiar with running customer focus groups and designing customer satisfaction surveys.
* Proven ability to apply customer\-centric design methods, strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.

data.jd_text:
**Job Description**
 The Associate Director / Technical Director – Rail will provide senior technical leadership across multidisciplinary rail projects while helping to grow the rail business in the UAE and wider Middle East market.
   

  

 The role requires broad experience across rail design and delivery, including track, civil works, stations, systems, signalling, power and operations, together with proven delivery of major rail programmes such as high\-speed rail, metro and light rail in regional and international markets.
   

  

 This position suits an experienced rail leader with strong technical credibility, established client relationships, and the ability to support project delivery, technical assurance and work\-winning across the region.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Technical Leadership \& Design Governance**
* Provide senior technical leadership and act as technical authority, or deputy where appropriate, on rail projects in the UAE and across the Middle East.
* Define and uphold technical standards, design principles and governance processes in line with UAE and regional authority requirements.
* Lead the delivery of multidisciplinary rail design projects as Project Director, Project Manager or Subject Matter Expert, as required.
* Lead multidisciplinary design reviews, technical approvals and assurance activities across complex rail programmes.
* Ensure compliance with international standards and regional regulations, codes and approvals processes.


**Multidisciplinary Rail Design Oversight**
 Provide technical oversight and coordination across all rail disciplines, including:
   

  

* Track \& Alignment
* Civil \& Structural Works (bridges, viaducts, tunnels, earthworks)
* Stations \& Buildings (architecture, MEP, fire \& life safety)
* Rail Systems (signalling, traction power, OCS, substations, SCADA)
* Communications \& Telecoms
* Depots \& Rolling Stock Interfaces
* Systems Integration, Interfaces \& RAMS


 Ensure coordination and technical consistency across disciplines to deliver safe, operable and integrated rail systems.
   

  

**Business Development \& Client Engagement**
* Play a leading role in business development and work\-winning across the Middle East rail market.
* Shape bid strategies, technical solutions, delivery methodologies and fee proposals for priority rail opportunities.
* Act as a senior technical representative in client meetings, workshops, presentations and bid interviews.
* Build and maintain trusted relationships with government entities, rail authorities, operators, developers and contractors across the UAE and wider region.
* Contribute to pipeline growth, key account development, market intelligence and strategic positioning for rail in the Middle East.


**Project Delivery Support**
* Work with Project Directors and discipline leads to support the successful delivery of major rail programmes across the UAE and Middle East.
* Resolve complex technical, interface and systems integration issues across multidisciplinary rail projects.
* Support technical review of contractor submissions, authority submissions and design deliverables.
* Provide technical input during construction, testing and commissioning phases where required.
* Promote high standards of design quality, safety and engineering excellence.
* Support the application of RAMS, safety assurance and risk management processes.
* Proactively identify technical and integration risks and support mitigation strategies.
* Ensure full compliance with regional and local QHSE requirements.


**Quality, Safety \& Risk**
* Promote high standards of design quality, safety and engineering excellence.
* Support the application of RAMS, safety assurance and risk management processes.
* Proactively identify technical and integration risks and support mitigation strategies.
* Ensure full compliance with regional and local QHSE requirements.


**People \& Capability Development**
* Mentor and develop engineers and discipline leads across the Middle East rail team.
* Collaborate effectively with global rail colleagues and contribute to cross\-region technical excellence.
* Support recruitment, succession planning and capability growth to meet the expanding Middle East rail market.
* Promote knowledge sharing, lessons learned and regional best practice across the business.


**Qualifications**
* Degree in Civil, Railway or Systems Engineering; a Master’s degree is advantageous.
* Chartered Engineer status, or the ability to demonstrate progress toward chartership.
* Typically 15 to 18\+ years of experience in rail engineering and rail design consultancy.
* Proven rail project experience in the UAE and/or Middle East, including familiarity with regional authorities, standards and approvals processes.
* Strong multidisciplinary rail background with experience across the full project lifecycle and a track record of rail design and delivery.
* Experience leading bids, proposals, client engagement and business development activities.
* Ability to operate confidently in a client\-facing technical leadership role.
* Strong technical credibility across rail disciplines, with systems\-thinking and problem\-solving capability.
* Strong commercial acumen, with experience supporting bids, client frameworks and market growth.
* Client\-focused, collaborative and credible with senior stakeholders.
* Clear communicator with the ability to influence clients, partners and internal stakeholders.
* Experience working across both regional and international rail programmes, including high\-speed rail, metro and light rail.
* Established relationships with key regional rail clients, authorities or delivery partners would be advantageous.


**Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all.**
 Join our close\-knit community of talented individuals who share your passion for making a positive impact. Our global team includes more than 69,000 employees, working together to make a difference in communities both close to home and around the world.
   

  

**With us, you can. Apply today.**

* Ensure creation, standardization, and publication of cleansed datasets into the Government\-Wide data catalogue and sharing platforms — enabling accessibility and reuse
* Oversee development of data quality dashboards to track KPIs and cleansing progress
* Establish and lead program governance bodies — driving timely, quality delivery, issue resolution, and stakeholder alignment

data.jd_text:
**Job Summary**
 Our customer is seeking an experienced professional with a strong background in commercial interior fit\-out projects to oversee end\-to\-end project execution. The role involves managing site operations, coordinating with vendors and subcontractors, ensuring timely delivery of materials, and maintaining high standards of quality, safety, and compliance. The ideal candidate will bring strong project management, team leadership, and communication skills, with the ability to handle multiple projects, manage budgets and timelines, and proactively resolve on\-site challenges while maintaining excellent client relationships.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Oversee the end\-to\-end execution of assigned commercial interior fit\-out projects, ensuring timely completion and adherence to quality standards.
* Plan and manage site operations, including labor allocation and coordination of a team of 3\-4 site supervisors to guarantee efficient project delivery.
* Engage with vendors to secure timely material deliveries and on\-site execution, addressing concerns and implementing corrective actions as needed.
* Monitor daily site activities to ensure projects are completed within scope, budget, and timeline constraints while maintaining high\-quality standards.
* Coordinate labor and subcontractor resources through approved agency channels to ensure adequate on\-site workforce availability.
* Manage material requisition and procurement processes, verifying deliveries align with project schedules and construction programs.
* Mitigate and resolve unforeseen delays or challenges to maintain project timelines and client expectations.
* Organize site logistics and facilities, ensuring all equipment is operational and operated only by trained personnel.
* Enforce compliance with workmanship, material standards, building regulations, health and safety legislation, and quality control protocols.
* Maintain comprehensive project documentation for internal management and client reporting, ensuring accuracy and transparency.
* Review project plans and specifications in collaboration with design teams, identifying cost\-saving opportunities and potential construction challenges.
* Assist the estimator in developing project budgets and financial projections to support accurate cost management.


**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, Architecture, or a related field
* 6\+ years of relevant experience in commercial interior fit\-out projects
* Proven track record of delivering office, retail, or commercial projects end\-to\-end
* UAE or GCC project experience, with preference for DIFC or authority\-driven environments
* Strong understanding of fit\-out execution across civil, MEP, joinery, and finishes
* Ability to read and interpret technical drawings, including IFC, shop drawings, and MEP layouts
* Experience with project scheduling and planning tools such as MS Project, Primavera, or Excel\-based trackers
* Strong knowledge of material procurement, vendor coordination, and site logistics
* Familiarity with local regulations, authority approvals (DIFC, DM, Civil Defense), and compliance requirements
* Ability to manage multiple sites simultaneously while maintaining control over timelines, budgets, and quality
* Hands\-on experience managing site supervisors, subcontractors, and labor teams
* Strong vendor and contractor management capabilities
* Proficiency in project documentation, reporting, and client communication
* Ability to handle client\-facing discussions with confidence and clarity
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Word)
* Working knowledge of AutoCAD
* Exposure to ERP or project tracking tools is a plus


**What They Offer**
* Ownership of high\-impact design projects within a dynamic, tech\-forward environment that values innovation and growth.
* Hands\-on exposure to industry\-leading VR\-based design tools and collaborations with prestigious, high\-profile clients.
* Competitive compensation package that includes performance\-based incentives to recognize and reward excellence.
* A culture that blends entrepreneurial initiative with collaborative teamwork, fostering high individual ownership and impact.

**About the Company** 




  





  





 At Lummus Technology, innovation thrives, and excellence is a shared pursuit. When you join Lummus, you are empowered to make an impact and be part of a dynamic team that celebrates creativity, encourages professional development, and fosters collaboration. From our technology portfolio to our global workforce, Lummus is growing at a rapid pace, and we hope that you will grow with us during this exciting time. Lummus Consultants International (LCI) is an autonomous business within Lummus Technology that provides technical, environmental \& social and management consulting services worldwide. We work primarily in the energy industry, with a depth of expertise in power generation, oil \& gas, refining and petrochemicals. We maintain a very strong presence in the international technical due diligence markets to support the global financial industry. LCI has a far\-reaching organization with offices in the United States, UK, the Middle East and Asia.
 



  





  





**About the Role** 




  





  





 Lummus Consultants is looking for a Business Development Director to grow the company into the area of technical and management consulting in the energy industry – offshore and onshore oil \& gas, LNG, pipelines, power generation and transmission, as well as refining and petrochemicals. This role will be expected to help grow the consulting practice area in the fields of oil \& Gas, power delivery and decarbonization and will primarily entail growing relationships with the financial community and project developers. Assignments require a high level of experience and ability to focus quickly on important issues. The individual we are seeking must be comfortable and confident to work in a seller/doer organization structure.
 



  





  





**Responsibilities** 




  





  




* Grow Lummus Consultants’ business – in cooperation with the existing business heads. His growth strategy should be heavily focused on technical solutions but with a broad business perspective beyond traditional due diligence assignments.
* Develop a business plan to capitalize on existing talents and resources within Lummus Consultants and Lummus Technology; the candidate’s strengths; and market opportunities.
* Grow name recognition of Lummus Consultants in all Energy industry segments (with assistance from the Lummus Communication team and other internal resources).
* Carry out business development, marketing, and proposal preparation efforts and lead Key Account Management teams efforts.
* Lead or participate in consulting project work.
* Prepare clear and concise written reports on assignments, develop conclusions and present clear and precise written and verbal results to clients.
* Expand the Lummus Consulting practice area (globally), consistent with the business plan – identify gaps in skills and potential recruits.
* Achieve objectives with minimal oversight.
* Management of the P\&L forecast by close collaboration with his supervisor and finance.
* Report to Senior Director of Lummus Consultants in Dubai office.



  









**Qualifications** 




  





  




* A degree\-educated Engineer; MBA is a plus but not required.
* The candidate should have at least 20 years relevant professional experience.
* Prior experience with an owner/operator or major engineering company and/or consultancy.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, including ability to write clear and concise reports in English.
* The candidate should have strong interpersonal skills and be comfortable conversing with clients and senior management.
* Demonstrated management and project management skills.



  









**Required Skills** 




  





  




* Strong leadership abilities and excellent interpersonal skills.

* Capability of earning respect from the team and capable of influencing others without authority.
* Excellent professional image/presentation.
* Knowledge of many cultures/international style.
* Strong commercial savvy and negotiating skills.
* Interest in being knowledgeable in all services offerings in Lummus Consultants portfolio.
* Ability to work well with finance partners.
* Must have a strong balance of technical and commercial capabilities.



  





  





 Dubai office. Relocation is not being offered. Job\-related travel (business trips usually requiring less than a two\-week duration; often just one or two days) which includes international travel to financial institutions in London, is an important part of the work. Time away from the office may average 10 to 30 percent of work hours.
 



  





  





 Lummus Technology is the global leader in developing technology solutions that make modern life possible and focus on a more sustainable, low carbon future.  We are seeking an experienced Human Resources Director to lead the HR function for a growing construction business based in Dubai. This role will focus heavily on talent acquisition, workforce planning, compensation and benefits strategy, and building scalable HR frameworks to support project\-based operations across the UAE and wider region.
 



 The HR Director will act as a strategic partner to executive leadership, ensuring the organisation attracts, develops, and retains top\-tier talent while maintaining compliance with UAE labour laws and industry regulations.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



 1\. Talent Acquisition \& Workforce Planning
 


* Develop and implement a comprehensive talent acquisition strategy aligned with business growth and project pipeline demands.
* Lead high\-volume recruitment across technical, engineering, project management, and corporate functions.
* Build strong talent pipelines for critical construction roles (e.g., project directors, engineers, quantity surveyors, site managers).
* Establish employer branding initiatives to position the company as an employer of choice within the construction sector.
* Oversee recruitment partners, agencies, and international hiring campaigns where required.
* Implement workforce planning models to ensure manpower forecasting aligns with project timelines.



 2\. Compensation \& Benefits
 


* Design and implement competitive compensation and benefits frameworks aligned with market benchmarks in the UAE construction industry.
* Lead salary benchmarking exercises and ensure internal equity across roles and geographies.
* Develop incentive schemes linked to project performance and business outcomes.
* Oversee benefits administration including health insurance, allowances, bonuses, and expatriate packages.
* Ensure compliance with WPS (Wage Protection System) and UAE Labour Law requirements.



 3\. HR Strategy \& Leadership
 


* Develop and execute the overall HR strategy in alignment with business objectives.
* Establish HR policies, procedures, and governance frameworks suitable for a project\-driven environment.
* Lead organisational design initiatives to support business expansion.
* Provide strategic counsel to senior leadership on people\-related matters.



 4\. Employee Relations \& Compliance
 


* Ensure full compliance with UAE Labour Law and regulatory requirements.
* Oversee employee relations matters including disciplinary processes and conflict resolution.
* Develop retention and engagement strategies to reduce turnover across site\-based and corporate employees.



 5\. Performance Management \& Development
 


* Implement performance management frameworks aligned with KPIs and project milestones.
* Support leadership development and succession planning initiatives.
* Promote a culture of accountability, safety, and high performance.



  





 Candidate Profile
 


* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field (Master’s degree preferred).

* Strong expertise in talent acquisition within project\-based environments.
* Proven experience designing compensation and benefits frameworks in the UAE market.
* In\-depth knowledge of UAE Labour Law and HR compliance requirements.
* Experience managing multi\-site or geographically dispersed workforces.
* Strong leadership, stakeholder management, and influencing skills.

data.jd_text:
**Company Description** 




 Golden Square Engineering Consultants (GS), founded in 2001, is a multi\-disciplinary planning and design firm dedicated to delivering innovative and sustainable solutions. With a strong presence in the UAE and MENA region, the firm offers a full range of architectural and engineering services for public and private sector projects, including industrial, residential, commercial, and institutional developments. Committed to high\-quality, energy\-efficient, and sustainable design, GS collaborates with major developers, contractors, and consultants to ensure on\-time and budget\-conscious project completion. Operating from offices in Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Al Ain, Sharjah, Baghdad, and Canada, GS has designed numerous landmark projects, earning a reputation for excellence and integrity in the industry.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




**The Technical Director is the highest technical authority within the organization, responsible for leading multidisciplinary design and construction supervision functions across a diverse portfolio of projects. This role ensures technical excellence, regulatory compliance, and alignment between design intent and project execution throughout the full project lifecycle.** 




**Combining strategic leadership, client engagement, and financial oversight, the Technical Director drives performance, innovation, and quality across architectural and engineering teams while supporting business growth and operational efficiency.** 




**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\.        Technical Leadership** 




**Act as the organization’s principal technical authority across all disciplines (architecture, structural, MEP, quantity survey).** 




  





**Establish and enforce design standards, technical policies, and quality assurance frameworks.** 




**Ensure all designs comply with local authority regulations, codes, and international best practices.** 




  





**Provide expert technical input during concept, schematic, detailed design, tender and construction stages.** 




**Review and approve major technical deliverables and engineering solutions.** 




  





**2\.        Project Oversight \& Delivery** 




**Oversee the full project lifecycle from concept design through construction supervision and handover.** 




**Ensure alignment between design intent and on\-site execution.** 




**Lead multidisciplinary coordination to deliver integrated, efficient, and buildable solutions.** 




**Monitor project performance related to quality, timelines, and budgets.** 




**dentify and mitigate technical risks and implement corrective actions.** 




  





**3\.        Client \& Stakeholder Management** 




**Act as a senior technical advisor and key point of contact for clients.** 




**Support business development through technical input in proposals and presentations.** 




**Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, authorities, and stakeholders.** 




**Lead technical negotiations and resolve complex project issues.** 




  





**4\.        Team Leadership \& Development** 




**Lead, mentor, and develop multidisciplinary technical teams.** 




**Oversee recruitment, performance management, and succession planning.** 




**Promote knowledge sharing and technical excellence across departments.** 




  





**5\.        Financial \& Operational Oversight** 




**Contribute to business strategy and operational planning.** 




**Oversee project profitability, resource allocation, and cost control.** 




**Support budgeting, forecasting, and financial performance monitoring.** 




**Ensure efficient utilization of technical resources across projects.** 




  





**6\.        Compliance and Quality** 




**Ensure adherence to UAE regulations, authority requirements, and international standards.** 




**Implement and monitor QA/QC procedures across all projects.** 




**Drive innovation through adoption of new technologies, digital tools, and sustainable design practices.** 




**Stay updated on industry trends, codes, and emerging technologies.** 




  





**Qualifications \& Experience** 




**§  Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Architecture.** 



* Minimum 18–20 years of experience in architectural/engineering consultancy (pre and post tender stages).
* Proven experience in leading multidisciplinary teams.
* Strong knowledge of UAE codes, standards, and authority requirements (e.g., Dubai Municipality, DDA, etc.).
* Demonstrated experience in design management and construction supervision

 Job Purpose
 



 To audit and verify the extent to which the Authority and its organizational units comply with administrative, operational, and financial procedures, regulations, and policies, after conducting risk assessments and preparing independent and objective reports and recommendations to increase the effectiveness and efficiency of those procedures.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



 Functional Responsibilities
 


* Conduct risk assessment interviews with managers of technical departments as well as heads of non\-technical departments, and participate in the preparation of the strategic and annual internal audit plan in light of the results/practice of the risk assessment.
* Exercising professional care in carrying out audit engagements related to the financial, operational, legal, and technical aspects of the organization.
* Directing internal auditors to conduct interviews, review documents, develop and administer surveys, and prepare urgent memos, working papers, and document issues and recommendations related to audit work.
* Ensuring the quality of work performed by internal auditors.
* Developing risk\-based audit programs.
* Conducting audit tests in defined areas and identifying reportable issues.
* Reviewing the adequacy of the internal control design and providing recommendations for its improvement.
* Ensuring timely execution and completion of engagements in accordance with the audit plan.
* Performing special tasks, e.g., investigations, management consultations, and independent reviews in areas related to anti\-fraud, risk management, and any other relevant areas.
* Executing tasks assigned by the Director of the Internal Audit Office based on requests from the Chairman of the Board.
* Preparing draft reports, quality assurance stage reports.
* Conducting preliminary/final audit engagement meetings.
* Preparing and archiving audit files for completed audit engagements and reviewing audit documents uploaded via the Audit Office tool.
* Coordinating with management (under the supervision of the Director of the Internal Audit Office) to discuss external audit engagements in terms of defining the scope, audit plan, observations, etc., to obtain maximum assurance and avoid duplication of audit efforts.
* Following up with operations officers to verify the status of execution work, updating the follow\-up schedule based on the results of follow\-up work, and preparing audit and follow\-up reports for review by the Director of the Internal Audit Office.
* Ensure compliance with the Internal Audit Methodology, the Internal Audit Charter, and relevant management policies and standard operating procedures to ensure efficient work performance and adherence to the Authority's rules, standards, policies, and procedures, as well as applicable laws and regulations in the UAE and other relevant documents.
* Organizational documents such as the Internal Audit Charter (at the manual level).

* Assist the Director of the Internal Audit Office in developing training and continuing development programs, and follow up on professional development activities, including internal and external training, membership in professional associations, and sharing acquired information with colleagues.
* Prepare audit reports for review by the Director of the Internal Audit Office and submit audit findings and project consultancy reports via written reports presented to the Director of the Internal Audit Office.
* Prepare audit and follow\-up reports.
* Maintain adequate records of audit reports issued to management.
* Prepare and compile presentation/documentation materials for review by the Chairman of the Board or senior management for review by the Director of the Internal Audit Office.
* Prepare a conflict of interest report and submit it to the Director of the Internal Audit Office.
* Perform other duties and responsibilities related to the position and as assigned.



 Operational Responsibilities
 


* Provide support in analyzing data periodically and as requested, and present it to leadership to support decision\-making.

 Financial Management
 


* Ensure alignment with relevant financial policies and procedures in place for the function.



 Stakeholder Management

* All Organizational Units within the Authority.



  





**Key External Stakeholders** 



* Relevant Semi\-Government and Private Entities.

 Required Qualifications
 



  





**Academic Qualifications** 




**Professional Experience and Skills** 



* 6\+ years of relevant work experience.
* Professional certifications such as CPA, CIA, CMA, or CFE.
* Data collection and analysis.
* Knowledge of best practices in auditing, professional standards, and ethics standards issued by the Institute of Internal Auditors (IIA) and any related future changes.
* Management, processing, and implementation of compliance procedures.
* Innovative problem solver, able to find actionable solutions and resolve complaints.

 We’re looking for a highly technical and hands\-on Head of Cloud Systems \& Security to lead our cloud infrastructure, DevOps, platform engineering, and security capability across a regulated fintech environment.
 



  





 This is a senior leadership role for someone who can combine deep technical expertise with strong delivery, programme leadership, and stakeholder management experience within complex technology environments.
 



  





**What you’ll do** 



* Own and lead our multi\-cloud environment across AWS \& GCP
* Drive DevOps, CI/CD, Infrastructure\-as\-Code, Kubernetes, and platform engineering initiatives
* Build scalable, resilient, and secure cloud infrastructure aligned with fintech and regulatory standards
* Lead cloud and application security, including IAM, secrets management, vulnerability management, and compliance
* Establish engineering best practices across automation, deployment, monitoring, and operational excellence
* Lead cross\-functional cloud and infrastructure transformation initiatives across engineering and business teams
* Build and mentor a high\-performing Cloud \& Security team
* Partner closely with engineering, product, compliance, and leadership teams to support business growth at scale



  





**Essential skills \& experience** 



* 10\-12\+ years in DevOps, Cloud Engineering, or Platform Engineering roles
* Candidates should already be based in the UAE and bring prior experience operating within the UAE market environment, with an understanding of regional business dynamics and regulatory expectations.
* Deep hands\-on expertise across AWS \& GCP production environments
* Strong experience with: Kubernetes \& Docker, Terraform / Infrastructure\-as\-Code, CI/CD pipelines and automation tooling, Linux systems and microservices architecture, Cloud security, IAM, RBAC, networking, and secrets management
* Previous hands\-on software engineering background, ideally Node.js / JavaScript
* Experience designing and operating secure, scalable cloud environments
* Proven experience leading cloud, DevOps, or platform engineering teams
* Strong cross\-functional collaboration and stakeholder management skills
* Strong programme / project management capability, with the ability to drive delivery across multiple teams and priorities
* Strong influencing, leadership, and communication skills with the ability to operate effectively across both technical and non\-technical audiences



  





**Strongly preferred** 



* Experience within fintech, banking, payments, or other regulated industries
* Experience with MERN stack deployments and scaling
* Exposure to GitOps, ArgoCD, or advanced observability tooling
* Security or cloud certifications across AWS, GCP, or Kubernetes



  





**Why join amana?** 



* A genuinely international team with 20\+ nationalities
* A fast\-moving fintech environment where ideas turn into action
* A modern, mobile\-first product built for the next generation of investors
* Real opportunity to shape infrastructure and engineering standards at scale
* A culture built around collaboration, ownership, innovation, and support



  





 We’re not just hiring for a role. We’re building a team of people who want to help shape the future of finance in the region.
 



  





 📍 Dubai, UAE \| Based at Mashreq HQ Building \| 4 Days Office / 1 Day WFH \| Reporting to the CIO

The Apex Group was established in Bermuda in 2003 and is now one of the world’s largest fund administration and middle office solutions providers.
   

  

 Our business is unique in its ability to reach globally, service locally and provide cross\-jurisdictional services. With our clients at the heart of everything we do, our hard\-working team has successfully delivered on an unprecedented growth and transformation journey, and we are now represented by over circa 13,000 employees across 112 offices worldwide.Your career with us should reflect your energy and passion.
   

  

 That’s why, at Apex Group, we will do more than simply ‘empower’ you. We will work to supercharge your unique skills and experience.
   

  

 Take the lead and we’ll give you the support you need to be at the top of your game. And we offer you the freedom to be a positive disrupter and turn big ideas into bold, industry\-changing realities.
   

  

 For our business, for clients, and for you
   

  

**REGIONAL HEAD OF OPERATIONS – CLOSE ENDED (MIDDLE EAST)**
**Location: UAE**
**About Apex:**
 The Apex Group is a global financial services provider with over 13,000 employees across 85 offices globally. We look to recruit bright, articulate, and numerate employees who are not afraid of a challenge and are prepared to work hard and love what they do.
   

  

 Every employee plays a part in making Apex who we are today and the more we grow, the more important that becomes. Whatever your career path or specialism, Apex provides a global platform to allow you to thrive.
   

  

**The role:**
 Apex Group has created a regionalised operational organisation structure, divided into sub\-product segments, that enables Apex to sustain service delivery levels of the highest standards and maximize productivity and efficiencies.
   

  

 In this position you will be responsible for the end\-to\-end operational performance of the closed\-ended funds business in the different countries within the Middle East region, reporting to the Regional head of Fund Solutions – MEAIM.
   

  

 You should have extensive experience in the administration of close\-ended funds. You should have a proven track record of demonstrating your knowledge of fund accounting and a proven track record in leading multi\-jurisdictional operational platforms.. The role requires a strong combination of operational leadership, client delivery excellence, commercial awareness and transformation capability.
   

  

**Technical Tasks:**
* Oversee and lead the end\-to\-end delivery of the fund accounting service for close\-ended funds, ensuring accuracy and compliance with fund governing documents and regulatory guidance.
* Provide leadership on complex client and operational matters requiring senior judgment.
* Ensure full adherence to the prevailing control environment.
* Be a leading participant in the continuous development of our operating processes and procedures.
* Be an escalation point for technical queries from all stakeholders in your region.
* Oversee the timely completion of all audits.
* Ensure local teams’ adherence to regulatory compliance and underlying reporting.


**Tasks/Responsibilities:**
* Translate strategy into an operational plan for delivery of service and provide guidance to ensure consistent organisational leadership and day\-to\-day business running.
* Ensure effective implementation of the operating model with ownership for both onshore and offshore components, work closely with other regional functional leads across operations and wider CRM and Product teams.
* Implement agreed best practices while striving for continuous improvement.
* Develop and foster client relationships and ensure we exceed their expectations and are their provider of choice.
* Team collaboration across multiple jurisdictions globally including global operations centres and ensure that client deliverables are being met.
* Monitoring of actual versus target hours per fund/client and action as required. Ensure there is a continuous drive to improve our efficiency.
* Contribute to the achievement of regional financial and operational performance targets.
* Ensure effective \& timely resolutions to any errors identified.
* KPI’s to be consistently above the specified target for each team in your region (accuracy, timeliness, and delivery)
* Team capacity planning and full awareness of incoming pipeline, including ownership of hire requests.
* People management with a focus on development, motivation, and succession planning/talent management.
* Identify training needs within your teams in the region and interact with our training department.
* Manage employee performance and salary review process.
* Partner with the relevant Country Head, HR lead and senior leadership team to implement effective strategies for employee engagement and retention.
* Ensure adherence to all internal and external audit standards.
* Ensure stakeholder awareness, engagement, and support through effective and timely communication.
* Actively support Groups strategy, plans, and values, contributing to the achievement of a high\-performance culture.
* Demonstrate visible leadership and promote collaboration and accountability across the multi\-jurisdictional teams.
* Develop, maintain and role model a culture that is open to change and innovation, and supports collaboration, respect, and accountability.
* Maintain knowledge of industry trends.


**Skills Required:**
* Bachelor or Master level degree.
* Strong accountancy knowledge, a professional designation such as CA, CPAA, or ACCA etc., would be an asset.
* Solid experience working with private markets / closed\-ended fund structures across multiple jurisdictions.
* Extensive practical experience, 15\+ years of fund accounting work experience.
* Experience managing a large team / managing regional or multi\-location teams.
* Extensive experience working with external clients and an ability to inspire confidence.
* Excellent communication skills and proficiency in English (both verbal and written).
* Motivated, bright, and diligent individual who is driven to meet deadlines \& targets.
* Attention to detail and ability to work on multiple projects.
* A team player who is genuinely motivated by improving our service and teams.
* An ability to think critically and objectively while having strong organizational and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to resolve complex issues in a timely manner.
* Advanced level MS Excel, proficient with MS Word, MS PowerPoint.
* A detailed understanding of the various fund types covered by this role (Private Equity, Real Estate, Credit \& Venture Capital).


**What you will get in return:**
* A unique opportunity to be part of an expanding large global business and to lead teams across different locations.
* A friendly, co\-operative, and supportive environment.
* Exposure to many different fund types and a wide variety of clients.
* An opportunity to make an impact in a leading product for Apex.
* Training and development opportunities.


**Disclaimer:** 
 Unsolicited CVs sent to Apex (Talent Acquisition Team or Hiring Managers) by recruitment agencies will not be accepted for this position. Apex operates a direct sourcing model and where agency assistance is required, the Talent Acquisition team will engage directly with our exclusive recruitment partners.
