data.jd_text:
**Job Requisition ID:** 
 176545
   

  

 Established in the 1930s as a trading business, Al\-Futtaim Group today is one of the most diversified and progressive, privately held regional businesses headquartered in Dubai, United A”rab Emirates. Structured into five operating divisions; automotive, financial services, real estate, retail and healthcare; employing more than 35,000 employees across more than 20 countries in the Middle East, Asia and Africa, Al\-Futtaim Group partners with over 200 of the world's most admired and innovative brands. Al\-Futtaim Group’s entrepreneurship and relentless customer focus enables the organisation to continue to grow and expand; responding to the changing needs of our customers within the societies in which we operate.
   

  

 By upholding our values of respect, excellence, collaboration and integrity; Al\-Futtaim Group continues to enrich the lives and aspirations of our customers each and every day.
   

  

**Overview Of The Role:**
* The Head of Subscription supports the General Manager for Hertz and MOOV in overseeing daily operations, ensuring smooth and efficient service delivery, customer satisfaction, and business profitability. This role is pivotal in managing staff, fleet operations, financial performance, and customer service while maintaining compliance with company policies and industry regulations. Success in this role requires effective leadership in managing direct reports, fostering growth, and maintaining high service standards across all displays.


**What You Will Do:**
 Operations Management
   

  

* Assist in managing daily monthly subscription operations, ensuring efficiency and adherence to company policies.
* Monitor fleet availability, maintenance schedules, and vehicle utilization to maximize revenue.
* Oversee compliance with safety standards, insurance policies, and regulatory requirements.
* Implement process improvements to enhance operational efficiency.
* Turnaround Time (TAT): Time taken to prepare and rent out returned vehicles.
* Fleet Availability: Ensuring the right vehicles are available at peak times.


 Customer Service \& Satisfaction
   

  

* Ensure a high level of customer service is provided at all rental locations.
* Handle customer complaints and disputes, ensuring swift resolution and customer retention.
* Monitor customer feedback and implement service enhancements.
* Train staff on customer service best practices and brand standards.
* Net Promoter Score (NPS): Measures customer satisfaction and loyalty.
* Customer Retention Rate: Percentage of repeat customers.


 Financial \& Business Performance
   

  

* Financial planning, budgeting, and revenue management.
* Analyze performance metrics, including revenue, fleet utilization, and operational costs.
* Assist in developing pricing strategies and promotional offers.
* Work on cost control initiatives to improve overall profitability.
* Revenue Growth: Year\-over\-year or month\-over\-month revenue increase.
* Fleet Utilization Rate: Percentage of cars rented versus available.


 Staff Management \& Development
   

  

* Manage and mentor employees, customer service representatives, contract management and operational staff.
* Assist in hiring, training, and performance evaluations.
* Develop staff schedules and ensure adequate coverage during peak times.
* Foster a positive work environment and promote teamwork.
* Employee Productivity: Measured by subscriptions processed per employee.
* Effective in setting priorities and scheduling activities.


 Sales \& Marketing Support
   

  

* Assist in implementing marketing campaigns and promotional initiatives.
* Develop partnerships to drive sales.
* Identify new business opportunities and contribute to growth strategies.
* Ensure sales targets and customer acquisition goals are met.
* Booking Conversion Rate: Percentage of inquiries converted into rentals.
* Upselling \& Cross\-selling Revenue: Additional revenue from upgrades, insurance, etc.


 Compliance \& Risk Management
   

  

* Ensure that all rental agreements comply with company policies and legal regulations.
* Oversee adherence to vehicle maintenance schedules and safety inspections.
* Implement policies to minimize risks, including fraud prevention and damage control.
* Compliance \& Audit Score: Ensuring adherence to safety and legal regulations.
* Smooth functioning of the department delivering desired service and quality levels.


**Required Skills To Be Successful:**
* Strong customer relations and team building skills.
* Strong commercial acumen.
* Ability to maintain a good tracking system on applications for better management of business.
* Excellent communication, problem solving, and analytical skills.


**What Qualifies You For The Role:**
* University graduate.
* At least 5 years of experience in the customer service industry.
* General understanding of the car rental industry.
* Fluent in English and Arabic.


 We’re here to provide excellent service but a little help from you can ensure a five\-star candidate experience from start to finish.
   

  

 Before you click “apply”: Please read the job description carefully to ensure you can confidently demonstrate
 **why** 
 this opportunity is right for you and take the time to put together a well\-crafted and personalised CV to further boost your visibility. Our global Talent Acquisition team members are all assigned to specific businesses to ensure that we make the best matches between talent and opportunities. We not only consider the requisite compatibility of skills and behaviours, but also how candidates align with our Values of Respect, Integrity, Collaboration, and Excellence.
   

  

 As part of our candidate experience promise, we also want to make ourselves available to you throughout the application process. We make every effort to review and respond to every application.

The
 **Head of Business Intelligence** 
 will own and lead the end\-to\-end BI strategy, architecture and insight delivery across the business. This role is responsible for transforming complex data into clear, actionable intelligence that enables leadership teams to make faster, smarter and more profitable decisions.
 



 You will build and lead a high\-performing BI function, establish best\-in\-class reporting standards, and partner closely with Commercial, Trading, Merchandising, Marketing, Finance, Supply Chain and senior leadership to drive measurable business impact.
 



 This is a senior, hands\-on leadership role requiring strong technical expertise, commercial acumen and the ability to translate data into decision\-ready insight.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**BI Strategy \& Architecture** 



* Define and own the group\-wide BI roadmap across DTC and marketplace channels.
* Translate trading, pricing, merchandising, supply chain and finance requirements into scalable data models and reporting layers.
* Design and maintain a single source of truth across brands, regions and channels, despite fragmented upstream systems.
* Set clear ownership of raw data, transformed layers, business logic and reporting views.



**Data Integration \& Pipelines** 



* Lead the structuring and transformation of core data tables including orders, traffic, pricing, promotions, logistics, inventory and returns.
* Build and maintain robust pipelines to support daily, weekly and near real\-time trading decisions.
* Partner closely with technology and data teams to improve data reliability, timeliness and accessibility, and to define new data fields or views where required.



**Reporting, Dashboards \& Analytics** 



* Design decision\-first dashboards that drive action, not just visibility.
* Create standardised reporting frameworks while accommodating brand\-level nuances.
* Enable self\-serve analytics for trading, finance and senior leadership teams.



**Business Partnering \& Decision Support** 



* Act as a strategic BI partner to Trading and Commercial teams, proactively surfacing insights, risks and opportunities.
* Help evolve the organisation from reactive reporting to proactive and predictive insight.



**Data Governance \& Quality** 



* Define clear data definitions, metric logic and documentation to eliminate multiple versions of the truth.
* Implement data quality checks, alerts and reconciliation processes to ensure trust in reporting.



  





**What You’ll Bring** 



* 12\+ years’ experience in Business Intelligence, Analytics or Data, with at least 3–5 years in a senior leadership role.
* Strong background in e\-commerce, fashion retail or consumer\-facing brands.
* Expert\-level SQL (BigQuery preferred) and deep understanding of modern data warehousing and modelling concepts.
* Advanced experience with BI tools such as Tableau or equivalent.
* Working knowledge of Python or similar for data analysis, automation or advanced analytics.
* Strong commercial mindset with a proven ability to influence senior stakeholders.
* Experience building and scaling BI teams in fast\-growth, high\-change environments.

Executive Opportunity: Head of Regional Sales (MEA)
 



  





 Zenith Technologies
 



 Location: Riyadh, KSA based
 



 Start Date: Immediate
 



 ⸻
 



 About Zenith
 



  





 Zenith Technologies, founded in Melbourne and established across Australasia and the Middle East, is a recognized leader in Homeland Security, Intelligence Systems, and Advanced Security Technologies.
 



  





 For over 15 years, Zenith has partnered with governments, ministries of interior, defense organizations, and elite law enforcement agencies to deliver end\-to\-end mission\-critical solutions that fuse physical, digital, and cyber domains. Our solutions are engineered entirely in\-house, giving us unmatched flexibility to innovate, customize, and deliver at scale.
 



 ⸻
 



  





 Our Portfolio
 



  





 Zenith’s portfolio reflects a track record of world\-first innovations and proprietary platforms that transform how governments and agencies secure their nations. Key domains include:
 



 • Intelligent Mobility \& Enforcement Systems – including the world’s first AI\-powered Intelligent Lightbar, combining ANPR, live data analytics, communications, and edge AI for real\-time enforcement and situational command.
 



 • Next\-Generation ANPR \& Video Analytics – advanced fixed, mobile, and covert platforms enabling real\-time vehicle intelligence, threat detection, and multi\-domain data correlation.
 



 • AI\-Powered Data Fusion \& Analytics – proprietary platforms that ingest and integrate structured and unstructured data streams, delivering actionable intelligence and predictive insights to decision\-makers at speed.
 



 • Open\-Source Intelligence (OSINT) \& Social Media Monitoring – cutting\-edge solutions for live monitoring, deep\-data correlation, and AI\-enhanced threat intelligence across open sources, social media, and digital ecosystems.
 



 • Command \& Control Solutions – scalable, integrated C4i platforms enabling strategic oversight, rapid response, and mission\-critical decision\-making across multiple agencies.
 



 • Cyber\-Physical Security Integration – bridging digital and physical domains to deliver end\-to\-end national security resilience against emerging threats.
 



  





 Zenith’s unique strength lies in IP ownership and in\-house R\&D, enabling us to deploy fully integrated ecosystems rather than fragmented systems — a decisive advantage in the Homeland Security, National Resilience, and Law Enforcement sectors.
 



 ⸻
 



  





 The Role
 



  





 Zenith is seeking a Head of Regional Sales (MEA) to drive strategic expansion across the GCC, with primary focus on the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
 



  





 Reporting directly to the Group CEO, this executive will lead Zenith’s market growth, government engagement, and multimillion\-dollar program delivery across one of the world’s most dynamic security environments.
 



 ⸻
 



  





 Key Accountabilities
 



 • Define and execute regional sales strategy aligned with Zenith’s growth objectives.
 



 • Lead high\-level engagements with Ministries of Interior, law enforcement, and homeland security agencies across KSA and GCC.
 



 • Manage full lifecycle: pipeline development, bid and proposal management, high\-stakes negotiation, and closure of complex projects.
 



 • Build, lead, and inspire a high\-performing regional sales force.
 



 • Establish and deepen strategic alliances with leading system integrators and security partners.
 



 • Deliver strong commercial outcomes while ensuring operational excellence, customer satisfaction, and market leadership.
 



 ⸻
 



  





 Candidate Profile
 



 • 10\+ years in senior sales leadership within Homeland Security, Security Technology, or Defense.
 



 • Minimum 5 years of demonstrable success in the GCC, with direct experience engaging KSA MOI.
 



 • Proven track record in structuring and closing multimillion\-dollar government security contracts.
 



 • Strong professional networks across security, defense, and law enforcement communities in the region.
 



 • Master’s degree (Business or Engineering), MBA preferred.
 



 • Fluent in both Arabic and English.
 



 ⸻
 



  





 What Zenith Offers
 



  





 This is a high\-impact executive mandate within one of the most respected innovation\-driven players in the homeland security sector. Zenith offers:
 



 • Attractive executive package (base \+ commission).
 



 • Opportunity to shape national\-level security transformation.
 



 • A platform to operate at the intersection of AI, intelligence, and homeland security innovation in one of the fastest growing regions globally.
 



 ⸻
 



  





 How to Apply
 



  





 Submit your CV (PDF/Word) to employment@zenith.com.au
 



 Subject line: “Head of Regional Sales (MEA) – \[Your Name]”
 



  





 Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

data.jd_text:
**Together we make the difference**
 We are a leading provider of innovative and high\-performance solutions for airport logistics. Our portfolio includes products and solutions for baggage and cargo handling, high\-end software for the digitalization of logistics processes as well as an extensive range of maintenance and services. Major customers include renowned airports and airlines around the globe.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Are you energized by partnering with senior leaders to enable business success through people\-focused solutions? As Head of HR, you will work closely with leaders and their leadership teams across the Middle East with focus on UAE and Saudi\-Arabia to support the delivery of the people agenda.
   

  

 In this role, you will act as a trusted HR advisor on a broad range of people and organizational topics, helping leaders translate business priorities into effective people actions and play an important role in supporting leadership teams through change, organizational development, talent decisions, and workforce planning.
   

  

 This role combines senior HR partnering with hands\-on execution of (a.o.) HR cycle topics.
   

  

**What are my job responsibilities?**
**Strategic HR Leadership \& People Advisory**
* Act as a strategic advisor to Executive Management on all HR and workforce\-related matters
* Partner with leaders to design organizations that effectively support both operational and office\-based teams
* Translate business priorities into practical people\-centered actions that resonate across all workforce segments
* Lead employee relations initiatives, including dispute resolution and organizational interventions


**Workforce Planning, Talent \& Employee Lifecycle**
* Lead workforce planning aligned with business growth and operational realities
* Oversee recruitment, onboarding, and employee lifecycle processes
* Partner with leadership on hiring strategies, workforce structures, and succession planning
* Ensure smooth onboarding and integration, especially for expatriate and site\-based employees
* Ensure attraction, development, and retention of talent while maintaining workforce stability


**Employee Relations, Labour Law \& Compliance**
* Manage employee relations and labor matters in line with UAE \& KSA labor laws
* Act as a key point of contact for complex employee relations matters, with strong on\-the\-ground involvement
* Build trust with blue\-collar employees through visibility, accessibility, and consistent communication
* Support leaders in resolving employee issues, conflicts, and workplace challenges
* Ensure fair, consistent, and legally compliant HR practices
* Develop and implement HR policies and conduct audits to ensure governance and continuous improvement


**Performance, Development \& Engagement**
* Implement performance management practices aligned with business goals
* Support leaders in driving performance through effective people management
* Drive career development, succession planning, and talent initiatives
* Foster a high\-performance culture while ensuring employee engagement and sustainable workloads


**Compensation, Benefits \& Employee Value Proposition**
* Design and manage competitive compensation and benefits structures
* Lead salary benchmarking, job evaluations, and incentive programs
* Enhance benefits and offerings to meet both organizational and employee needs


**HR Operations, Systems \& Employee Experience**
* Oversee HR operations including HRIS, payroll coordination, and employee records
* Ensure smooth delivery of employee services (facilities, travel, housing, etc.)
* Manage HR systems, reporting, and workforce analytics
* Drive efficient processes while maintaining a positive employee experience


**HR Transformation, Projects \& Change Management**
* Lead HR transformation and digitalization initiatives
* Manage HR projects end\-to\-end, ensuring delivery and impact
* Drive change management with strong focus on communication, adoption, and employee impact
* Ensure change initiatives are clearly communicated and understood by all workforce segments, including non\-office employees
* Define and track KPIs to measure both business and people outcomes


**What do I need to qualify for this role?**
* Strong experience in an HR Business Partner or HR leadership role, preferably in a global or matrixed organization
* Experience partnering with senior leaders on people, workforce, and organizational topics
* Experience managing large blue\-collar or operational workforce populations
* Proven experience in employee relations, labor law, and workforce management
* Experience supporting organizational change and leadership decision\-making
* A collaborative style and confidence working across all levels


**Qualifications \& Experience**
* Bachelor’s degree in human resources, Business Administration, or related field (master’s preferred)
* 12–15 years of HR experience, including 5\+ years in a leadership role within UAE \& KSA
* Strong knowledge of UAE \& KSA Labor Law
* Experience in HR transformation and project management


**Skills \& Competencies**
* Strategic thinking and business acumen
* Leadership and stakeholder management
* Change management and transformation expertise
* Communication and influencing skills
* Strong business understanding and the ability to translate business priorities into people actions
* Analytical and problem\-solving abilities an end\-to\-end experience which anchors improved performance
* A pragmatic, resilient, and solutions\-oriented mindset
* The ability to work effectively in a dynamic and fast\-changing environment


**About The Team**
 You will report to Global HR BP ICS of VL and work closely with the regional VL and VI HR colleagues, and HR Functions and HR Service team.

**About noon** 




 We’re building an ecosystem of digital products and services that power everyday life across the Middle East \- fast, scalable, and deeply customer\-centric.  Noon’s fastest hyper\-local delivery platform, Noon Minutes, offers a localized assortment of FMCG \& grocery products with delivery within 15\-minutes. Currently live across the UAE and Saudi Arabia, offering thousands of products to customers in record time.
 



  





 noon’s mission: Every door, every day.
 



  





**What you'll do:** 




 Oversee daily production operations in the cold kitchen facility, ensuring production targets are met while maintaining food safety standards. Manage workflow, monitor team performance, control wastage, and coordinate order fulfilment to dark stores. Act as first point of contact for operational issues and ensure smooth execution of daily production schedules.
 



  




* Supervise and coordinate prep staff and assemblers to meet daily production targets
* Plan and schedule daily production based on dark store orders and demand forecasts
* Monitor workflow efficiency and adjust team assignments to optimize output
* Track and control wastage, identifying causes of excess disposal and implementing corrective actions
* Ensure order fulfilment accuracy
* Conduct pre\-shift briefings and assign tasks to prep and assembly teams
* Monitor ingredient inventory levels and report shortages or quality issues immediately
* Enforce HACCP procedures, temperature monitoring, and hygiene protocols throughout shift

* Ensure proper FIFO stock rotation and storage procedures are followed

 Training:

* Wastage tracking and reporting systems

* You need to be relentlessly resourceful and operate with a deep bias for action.
* We need people with the courage to be fiercely original.

**Role Overview** 
 The Senior Event Producer \- Dubai SUP \& Dubai Yoga is responsible for the operational planning, production, and delivery of Dubai Stand Up Paddle and Dubai Yoga, two high\-profile DFC events with distinct venue, safety, and programming requirements. The role oversees both events holistically, ensuring operational consistency while respecting the specific technical and safety needs of water\-based and wellness\-focused delivery.The role works closely with the appointed mass events delivery agency, Fitness Villages teams, internal stakeholders, and city authorities to ensure safe, high\-quality execution and strong participant experience.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Provide senior operational leadership for the planning and delivery of Dubai SUP and Dubai Yoga.
* Manage and direct the appointed delivery agency across both events, ensuring scope, timelines, and quality standards are met.
* Lead coordination with relevant authorities and stakeholders, including maritime safety, venue management, and public safety entities.
* Oversee all operational workstreams including water safety, venue layouts, programming schedules, participant flow, and logistics.
* Coordinate closely with Fitness Villages teams and Partnership Operations to ensure alignment of branding, programming, and on ground delivery.
* Act as the primary escalation point for operational risks and on\-ground issues during delivery.
* Lead post\-event reporting, reconciliation, and close\-out for both events.


**Deliverables/Milestones**
**June**
* Complete onboarding and formal alignment with the Head of Operations and wider DFC Operations Team.
* Lead operational onboarding with the appointed delivery agency, confirming scope, responsibilities, governance, and escalation protocols for bothevents.
* Review previous Dubai SUP and Dubai Yoga playbooks, risk logs, and post event reports.
* Confirm scope ownership, milestones, and governance structure.


**July**
* Lead detailed operational planning for Dubai SUP and Dubai Yoga, ensuring appropriate differentiation between water\-based and venue\-based delivery.
* Oversee early development of water safety plans, venue zoning, participant flow, and operational layouts.
* Initiate and lead engagement with relevant authorities, including maritime safety, venue management, and public safety stakeholders.
* Support development and refinement of entertainment, programming, and experiential concepts, ensuring operational feasibility.
* Provide structured progress reporting and risk updates to the Head of Operations.


**August**
* Oversee development of detailed operational plans, layouts, schedules, and delivery documentation for both events.
* Coordinate commercial and branding requirements with Partnership Operations.
* Support refinement and finalisation of approved entertainment and programming concepts.
* Ensure authority submissions, approvals, and NOCs are progressing in line with programme timelines.
* Identify, track, and mitigate operational risks and interdependencies across both events.


**September**
* Lead lock\-down of all operational, production, and delivery scopes for Dubai SUP and Dubai Yoga.
* Confirm final safety plans, venue layouts, programming schedules, and contingency measures.
* Ensure entertainment, branding, and activation elements are fully integrated into operational and safety plans.
* Conduct formal readiness and risk review sessions with the delivery agency and key stakeholders.


**October**
* Oversee final preparations and pre\-event readiness activities.
* Manage pre build\-up coordination across water and land\-based venues.
* Ensure operational readiness ahead of the DFC live period.
* Resolve high\-impact issues and manage escalations as required.


**November**
* Lead live operational delivery of Dubai SUP and Dubai Yoga.
* Manage on\-ground command, real\-time issue resolution, and stakeholder coordination.
* Oversee decommissioning, venue reinstatement, and handover to relevant authorities and venue owners.


**December**
* Lead post\-event reporting, operational close\-out, and reconciliation for both events.
* Consolidate agency reports, authority feedback, and operational learnings.
* Document recommendations and formally hand over to the Head ofOperations.


**Candidate Profile** 
 Minimum 8 years’ experience delivering complex outdoor or sporting events.Experience with water\-based events, wellness programming, or multi\-venue delivery is highly desirable.Strong background in safety planning, authority coordination, and agency management.Excellent leadership, communication, and organisational skills.Comfortable operating under pressure during live event delivery.

data.jd_text:
The Executive Assistant (EA) will report to the Head of Middle East. This is a key role within the Middle East team. The successful candidate will bring substantial EA experience, gained within an international Law Firm(s) based in the Middle East. A high level of professionalism, discretion and commercial awareness is essential.
   

  

  
   

  




  


 This is a full\-time, fixed\-term position of up to eight months to cover maternity leave. Working hours are Monday to Friday, 9 00am to 6 00pm, with the option to work from home one day per week.
   

  




  


  

  

 We are seeking an agile, highly organised and responsive professional who is passionate about providing outstanding EA support to the Head of Middle East and contributing positively to the wider team. The role requires someone who can proactively manage competing priorities, build strong working relationships with stakeholders at all levels, and consistently deliver work to a high standard. The ideal candidate will take pride in going above and beyond, while exercising sound judgement and maintaining confidentiality at all times.
   

  

 Please note that, as part of the recruitment process, successful shortlisted candidates will be asked to complete Numeracy, Comprehension and Prioritisation assessments, which will take approximately 60 minutes in total.
   

  




  


**Please apply directly through with your application and kindly only contact our Recruitment team for any further details, legal experiance is essential part of the criteria for this role.**
  

  
   

  




  


 Roles and Responsibilities
   

  

  
   

  




  


 Executive support, Diary \& Stakeholder Management
   

  

  
   

  




  


 This may include but is not limited to the following
   

  

 •Proactively manage the Head of Middle East’s complex and high‑volume diary, including scheduling internal and external meetings across multiple time zones, often involving numerous senior stakeholders with competing priorities.
   

  

 •Act as a gatekeeper for the Head of Middle East, triaging meeting requests, queries, issues and complaints, redirecting appropriately while ensuring matters are dealt with effectively and without unnecessary involvement from the Head.
   

  

 •Prepare agendas, attend meetings where the Head of Middle East is attending or chairing, take detailed notes and action logs, and proactively follow up with action owners to ensure completion within agreed timeframes.
   

  

 •Attend additional meetings alongside or on behalf of the Head of Middle East where appropriate, independently managing follow‑up actions and keeping the Head fully briefed.
   

  

 •Support the Head of Middle East with strategic and commercial decision‑making by proactively preparing briefing materials, summaries, background information and data to ensure decisions are well‑informed.
   

  

 •Anticipate information requirements and liaise with Finance, BD, HR, Compliance and other Business Operations teams to ensure relevant input is available in advance of key meetings or decisions.
   

  

  
   

  




  


 Travel, Logistics \& Trip Optimisation
   

  

 •Arrange end‑to‑end complex travel for the Head of Middle East, including multi‑destination international itineraries, coordination of different modes of transport, accommodation and airport transfers.
   

  

 •Manage all visas, permits and travel documentation, ensuring sufficient lead time and compliance with jurisdiction‑specific requirements.
   

  

 •Provide strategic input into travel planning, designing trips that maximise effectiveness by combining multiple objectives (client meetings, internal meetings, events and business development) into a single itinerary where possible.
   

  

 •Liaise extensively with colleagues across offices and business functions to ensure a joined‑up firm approach and maximise the value of each trip.
   

  

 •Remain flexible and responsive, managing last‑minute changes to travel and schedules calmly and efficiently when required.
   

  

 •Prepare detailed post‑trip reports summarising meetings held, key outcomes, opportunities identified and agreed next steps, for circulation to relevant internal stakeholders.
   

  

 •Ensure all follow‑up meetings and actions arising from travel are diarised promptly, tracked and progressed to completion.
   

  

  
   

  




  


 Marketing / Business Development Support
   

  

 •Manage speaking engagements and thought‑leadership commitments, including tracking article and submission deadlines, coordinating preparatory research, and drafting briefing materials such as panel questions or speaker scripts.
   

  

 •Arrange and coordinate preparatory and briefing meetings in advance of panels, speaking slots or publications, ensuring the Head of Middle East is fully prepared.
   

  

 •Liaise with the Knowledge team and other internal stakeholders to obtain research support and background material where required, to ensure contributions are accurate, relevant and high quality.
   

  

 •Register the Head of Middle East for events when instructed and prepare comprehensive pre‑event briefings, including attendee information and engagement objectives, to maximise the value of attendance.
   

  

 •Working with the Head of Middle East and Business Development teams to maintain up‑to‑date client target lists.
   

  

 •Track and maintain updates on client target status, ensuring actions and deliverables assigned to relationship partners are followed up and progressed.
   

  

 •Provide regular status updates to the Head of Middle East on progress, upcoming actions and any slippage against agreed objectives.
   

  

  
   

  




  


 Billing, Finance \& Expenses
   

  

 •Manage the full monthly billing process for the Head of Middle East’s matters, maintaining detailed knowledge of client fee agreements, caps and billing arrangements.
   

  

 •Prepare draft bills for approval, liaise with Finance as required, and issue final approved invoices to clients in their preferred format with appropriate covering correspondence.
   

  

 •Manage client billing queries in coordination with Finance and the Head of Middle East.
   

  

 •Maintain oversight of expense submissions for the Head of Middle East, including liaising directly with vendors (restaurants and transport providers etc) to obtain duplicate receipts or supporting documentation where receipts were not provided or have been misplaced.
   

  

 •Ensure expenses are accurately described, correctly coded and supported by appropriate budget holder approval in line with firm policy.
   

  

 •Proactively follow up with clients regarding outstanding invoices and payments, providing regular updates to the Head of Middle East and keeping the Billing and Finance teams fully informed of progress, issues or agreed payment timelines.
   

  

  
   

  




  


 Performance \& People Processes
   

  

 •Support the Head of Middle East throughout the performance review process, ensuring review meetings are scheduled in line with firm‑wide deadlines.
   

  

 •Prepare performance review meeting packs, ensuring all required documentation and financial data are available in advance.
   

  

 •Proactively monitor and follow up to ensure reviewees complete required system inputs ahead of meetings.
   

  

 •Attend performance review meetings to take detailed notes and assist the Head of Middle East during discussions.
   

  

 •Support completion of post‑meeting evaluations, notes and system requirements, ensuring timely and accurate submission.
   

  

 •Maintain oversight of outstanding actions arising from performance reviews.
   

  

 •Maintain close and regular communication with HR throughout the performance review cycle, ensuring awareness of progress, confirming deadlines, understanding process or system changes, and ensuring all requirements are met accurately and on time.
   

  

  
   

  




  


 CRM \& Relationship Management
   

  

 •Maintain and update the Head of Middle East’s contacts and relationship data in InterAction, ensuring activities, meetings and relationship notes are accurately recorded.
   

  

 •Support the Head of Middle East in managing and maintaining effective working relationships with other law firms and referrers, supporting collaboration across jurisdictions.
   

  

 •Track inbound and outbound referrals between the firm and external law firms, ensuring referrals are recorded accurately and progress is monitored.
   

  

 •Support the Head of Middle East in ensuring referral relationships are actively maintained, with appropriate follow‑up on agreed actions and opportunities.
   

  

  
   

  




  


 Recruitment \& Business Operations Liaison
   

  

 •Maintain oversight of Middle East recruitment activity, liaising with HR and providing regular updates to the Head of Middle East.
   

  

 •Act as a key coordination point with Business Operations functions (HR, Finance, BD, Compliance, IT and Operations), ensuring strong communication, alignment and effective delivery of initiatives impacting the region.
   

  

 •Establish regular Middle East Operations meetings, ensuring all Business Operations functions are kept informed, aligned and engaged on regional matters.
   

  

 •Use these forums to share relevant knowledge or developments that may impact specific functions, agree deliverables, and capture upcoming activities, deadline changes and requirements that should be on the Head of Middle East’s radar.
   

  

 •Ensure key outputs from Middle East Operations meetings are fed into agendas and briefing materials for wider Middle East leadership or team meetings, promoting alignment and proactive planning across the region.
   

  

  
   

  




  


 Person Specification
   

  

 •Proven experience as an Executive Assistant, Legal PA or similar role supporting a senior Partner or regional lead, ideally within an international law firm or professional services environment.
   

  

 •Demonstrable experience managing complex diaries and multi‑time‑zone scheduling for senior stakeholders.
   

  

 •Strong experience arranging complex international travel, including multi‑destination itineraries, visas and short‑notice changes.
   

  

 •Experience supporting billing and financial processes, including preparation of draft bills, liaising with Finance and following up on client payments.
   

  

 •Experience supporting people and performance review processes, including scheduling review meetings, preparing documentation and assisting with system requirements.
   

  

 •Experience working closely with HR, Finance, BD, Compliance and other Business Operations teams, with the ability to coordinate and track actions effectively.
   

  

 •Highly organised, with excellent attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast‑paced environment.
   

  

 •Strong written and verbal communication skills, with confidence drafting correspondence and reports on behalf of a senior leader.
   

  

 •Ability to exercise sound judgement, discretion and confidentiality when handling sensitive matters.
   

  

 •Proactive, flexible and resilient, with the ability to adapt quickly to changing priorities.
   

  

 •Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office, with experience using practice management, CRM and expense management systems.
   

  

 •Professional, client‑focused approach, with the confidence to liaise directly with senior internal stakeholders and clients.
   

  

 •Fluent written and spoken English.
   

  

  
   

  




  


 Benefits include (but are not limited to)
   

  

 •Competitive salary (negotiable depending on experience)
   

  

 •Premium international medical, dental, and optical insurance
   

  

 •30 days of annual leave
   

  

 •Employee Assistance Programme
   

  

  
   

  




  


 Competencies
   

  

 •Working together
   

  

 •Integrity and respect
   

  

 •Inclusive
   

  

 •Personal impact and growth
   

  

 •Driving high standards
   

  

 •Commercial mindset
   

  

 •Client \- centric
   

  

 •Responsible

**Who We Are:** 
 At Huda Beauty, our Vision is to lead in creating a democratized beauty industry where power is given back to people to define, create, and enjoy beauty for themselves! Launched by award\-winning beauty powerhouse Huda Kattan in 2013, Huda Beauty is one of the world's fastest\-growing beauty brands. As a company, we are fueled by purpose and not profit, this allows us to approach things differently so that we can create products, content, and a community like no other. A lot has changed since our launch in 2013, but something that will forever remain at the core of Huda Beauty is our focus on business excellence and our unwavering passion for kindness!
   

  

**Summary:** 
 We're seeking a strategic and hands\-on
 **Head of Post\-Production** 
 to lead and elevate Huda Beauty's video content function. In this role, you will own the post\-production vision across brand campaigns, social\-first content, and marketing initiatives, while managing and mentoring a team of four in\-house editors.
   

  

 You'll work closely with Creative, Marketing, and Social teams to ensure best\-in\-class output, efficient workflows, and consistent on\-time delivery. This role requires deep post\-production expertise, strong leadership, and the ability to operate in a fast\-paced, high\-volume content environment. You'll be responsible for setting creative and technical standards, streamlining operations, developing talent, and ensuring creative excellence from concept through final delivery.
   

  

 This is a hybrid role: highly strategic, yet hands\-on when needed \- supporting shoots, defining technical approaches, and building a scalable ecosystem of videographers and freelance partners.
   

  

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities:**
* Manage and mentor a team of 4 editors
* Lead, plan, and manage post\-production for a full slate of video projects
* Manage post\-production schedules and traffic control
* Create and implement processes and workflows that enable the team to work efficiently and independently
* Guide team development, helping junior members grow towards independence
* Oversee branded storytelling, ensuring delivery of best\-in\-class assets in line with brand vision
* Juggle multiple high\-priority post\-production projects in various stages, ensuring deadlines are met
* Identify workflow gaps in post\-production and lead continuous improvement initiatives
* Develop and refine a distinctive Huda Beauty editing style \- color grading, motion graphics/animation, sound design
* Work closely with the Head of Agency to build efficient project tracking, workflow systems, and deadline rigor
* Be a force for innovation \- integrate AI or other new tools into video production where appropriate
* Build robust storage solutions and archives
* Maintain a network of freelancers/vendors to scale up for projects when needed


**Requirements**
* 10\+ years' experience in post\-production management or a closely related field
* Deep understanding of all areas of post‑production: editing, color grading, VFX, sound design
* Ability to manage multiple projects at once under tight deadlines
* Experience working in agency, brand in\-house, or post\-production house environments
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence, align, and drive decisions across multiple teams
* Prior experience managing teams of 5\+ direct reports and freelancers
* Proficient with editing software (Premiere Pro is required; After Effects, etc.)
* Excellent creativity, communication, and attention to detail
* Social\-first mindset with a deep understanding of digital and platform\-native video content


**Benefits**
* Monthly "Self Love Days" (at company discretion)
* Premium Medical/Dental/Vision coverage for employee plus dependents
* Monthly coaching sessions with our in\-house Success Coach
* Employee discounts on all Huda Beauty products
* Quarterly product gifting


*Huda Beauty is committed to building diverse and inclusive teams and upholding an equal employment workplace that is free from discrimination. We hire stellar individuals regardless of their race, color, ancestry, religion, gender identity, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, medical conditions, disability, or veteran status. If you need reasonable accommodations at any point in the application or interview process, please let us know.*

data.jd_text:
AESG is seeking an accomplished Electrical Engineer with deep expertise in mission\-critical facility design to join our growing Mission Critical department.
   

  

 Reporting directly to the Head of Mission Critical, this senior role offers significant career progression opportunities and the chance to lead diverse data centre projects across the EMEA region, spanning full design delivery, technical advisory services, and contractor support during construction phases.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will combine technical excellence in electrical systems design with proven client management skills, business development acumen, and the political savvy to navigate complex stakeholder environments.
   

  

 This is a leadership role for someone ready to take the next step in their career while maintaining hands\-on involvement across the full project lifecycle—from early\-stage advisory through design development to construction oversight and commissioning support.
   

  

**Qualification And Experience**
* 10\+ years of progressive experience in mechanical engineering design, with significant focus on data centre and mission\-critical facilities
* 10\+ years of progressive experience in electrical engineering design, with significant focus on data centre and mission\-critical facilities
* Demonstrated expertise in data centre electrical systems, including power distribution architectures (N, N\+1, 2N, 2N\+1 configurations), medium voltage and low voltage distribution, UPS systems (static, rotary, modular), generator plants and fuel systems, automatic transfer switches, power monitoring systems, busway and busduct design, and distributed and block redundancy topologies for mission critical environments
* Strong technical foundation in load calculations, short circuit analysis, arc flash analysis, protection coordination studies, voltage drop calculations, power quality analysis for mission\-critical facilities, as well as earthing and lightning protection system design
* Experience with high voltage substations and utility power infrastructure, including substation design, switchgear selection and layout, transformer sizing and specification, utility coordination, power purchase agreements, and grid connection requirements for small to large\-scale data centre campuses
* Proven track record delivering projects for major data centre owners, operators, or developers, with experience across multiple project delivery models, including design\-build, design\-bid\-build, and advisory engagements
* Significant experience with projects in the GCC and broader EMEA region, with an understanding of regional codes, standards, and stakeholder dynamics
* Working knowledge of relevant electrical engineering standards, including IEEE, IEC, NEC/NFPA 70, BS standards, and Uptime Institute Tier topology requirements
* Strong client relationship management skills with demonstrated ability to independently manage senior\-level client interactions and build lasting partnerships
* Business development experience, including proposal leadership, technical presentations, scope definition, and fee negotiation
* Demonstrated political acumen and ability to navigate complex organizational environments, manage competing stakeholder interests, and operate effectively in matrix structures
* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or related discipline; Chartered Engineer (CEng) or Professional Engineer (PE) status strongly preferred


**General Expectations**
* Lead electrical systems design for data centre and mission critical projects across various delivery models—from full design responsibility to technical advisory services and construction phase support—including power distribution systems (HV, MV, LV), UPS configurations, generator plants, emergency power systems, lighting, grounding, and lightning protection
* Act as a senior client\-facing technical lead, managing relationships with data center owners, operators, developers, and construction contractors throughout project lifecycles
* Provide technical advisory services to clients during procurement, design review, and construction phases, including contractor submittal reviews, RFI resolution, and technical assurance for project delivery
* Lead multidisciplinary coordination efforts, ensuring seamless integration between electrical, mechanical, architectural, structural, and other design disciplines
* Supervise, mentor, and develop engineering teams, providing technical guidance and fostering professional growth among junior and mid\-level engineers
* Support business development initiatives, including proposal preparation, technical presentations, fee negotiations, and strategic client engagement
* Represent the Mission Critical department in senior\-level client meetings, industry forums, and strategic planning discussions


**Responsibilities**
* Expertise in electrical modelling and analysis software (ETAP, SKM PowerTools, EasyPower, CDEGS, or similar)
* Proficiency in industry\-standard design software (Navisworks, AutoCAD, single\-line diagram tools)
* Knowledge of sustainability frameworks and certifications (LEED, BREEAM, ESTIDAMA) as they apply to data centres
* Experience with and understanding of the selection of electrical systems in mission\-critical facilities
* Familiarity with industry design standards and specifications (Uptime Institute Tier Standards, TIA\-942, ISO standards for data centres)
* Uptime Institute Accredited Tier Designer (ATD) certification preferred
* Experience with energy efficiency strategies, battery energy storage systems (BESS), and renewable energy integration in data centres
* Experience with utility (DEWA, TAQA, SEC) coordination, power infrastructure planning, and large load interconnection processes with regional utilities
* Knowledge of data centre monitoring and control systems (DCIM, EPMS, BMS integration)
* Strong commercial awareness and understanding of project economics, risk management, and value engineering
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders

* Define and implement the engineering strategy, design philosophy, and technical governance framework for the division.
* Establish company standards for drawings, documentation, SLDs, wiring diagrams, design templates, and BOM structures.
* Act as the final technical approval authority for all engineering deliverables and design packages.
* Own technical risk management and ensure alignment with business profitability and margin targets.
* Lead high\-level technical engagement with clients, consultants, utilities, and OEM partners.

data.jd_text:
**Job Purpose** 



* To support the Bank’s business strategy by acquiring and managing high\-net\-worth (HNW) clients. The role requires a UAE National Relationship Manager with a strong background in wealth management, capable of delivering tailored financial solutions, enhancing client relationships, and contributing to the growth of the Bank’s HNW client base.
* The role is required to acquire/ transfer HNW clients’ portfolios to Emirates Investment Bank to generate fee income and Assets Under Management (AUM).
* The role must work closely with team leaders, Head of Business Development and Investment Advisors to ensure client product suitability is maintained as per the internal policies.



  





**Key Accountabilities** 




**Client Acquisition and Revenue:** 



* To source new qualified clients for Wealth Management business based on the business plan submitted at the time of on\-boarding.
* To ensure generation of net fee income through the sale of Investment products and to generate the required Assets under Management (AUM).
* To maintain regular contact with the client including regular face\-to\-face meetings and maintain call reports of all client activities.
* To profile the clients’ risk and return aspirations and work with Investment Advisors to maintain client risk profile suitability at all times.
* To increase assets under management of existing clients and develop the relationship.
* To provide and maintain, on an ongoing basis, a monthly report, figures, forecasting and any other records which may be required by the Team Leader to keep up\-to\-date records of sales \& performance.
* To do account planning with Team Leader and Head of Distribution and Investment Advisors to understand the needs of the client and provide appropriate financial solutions to the client.
* To ensure consistent service delivery is maintained at all touch points for clients.
* To continuously provide feedback on competitive activities to the Product and Business team to track market developments.
* To attend regular product trainings and to be updated with the financial market developments.
* To safeguard the Bank’s reputation by ensuring ethical and professional behavior is maintained at all times.
* To maintain superior client service levels by pro\-actively meeting the clients on regular basis and pre\-empting any possible client complaints and concerns.



  





**Client Portfolio Management:** 



* To maintain and enhance new and existing relationships with key and prospective clients to ensure business continuity and growth.
* To provide regular updates to the Head of Business Development/ Wealth Management on performance of the portfolio accounts and on key market updates which may impact client attrition.
* To analyse the client’s financial standing to assess the credit risk for the client and ensure that the credit quality of the portfolio is not compromised.
* To recommend/reject or approve credit facilities, within prescribed limits, after a comprehensive analysis of the client’s net worth and proposed financial standing.
* To ensure provision of high quality and timely service to clients.



**Internal Collaboration:** 



* To monitor service level agreements and manage the coordination with other departments to meet client service expectations.
* To engage with key stakeholders including on\-boarding team, credit, operations, technology, and treasury to deliver a timely and effective level of client experience.



**Regulatory and Compliance:** 



* To ensure that the client being on\-boarded is of good reputation and financial standing and will maintain proper financial and KYC documentation at all times.
* To ensure customer documentation is complete and in line with the Bank’s requirements.
* To help service coordinators in resolving documentation and other client\-related discrepancies.
* To adhere to a robust control framework, ensuring communications with clients meet internal control standards and external regulatory requirements.
* To ensure clients’ KYC and risk profile are reviewed regularly as per compliance policy, and is updated with any new changes in clients’ financial status.
* To ensure risk assessment of the client portfolio is maintained by personally reviewing all proposals, identifying, and assessing all risk inherent in credit exposures.
* To ensure all compliance/ credit and AML queries are answered within 48 hours.
* To ensure all internal and external trainings are attended and CPD hours are completed.



  





**Qualification \& Experience** 



* Overall, 10\-15years of experience in Banking and minimum 5\-10 years of experience in Wealth Management/ Private Banking/ Asset Management.
* Proficient in MS Office.
* CISI qualification

data.jd_text:
**Job Overview**
 The Arbor School seeks a special individual for an exciting opportunity that has arisen within our school. The successful candidate will play a key role in fulfilling the school’s ecological and sustainability vision, as well as challenging students to fulfil their potential within the academic disciplines. The Arbor School is seeking a highly motivated  Head of Design and Technology to lead the Food Technology and Resistant Materials department in the Secondary School.
   

  

 We are looking for an experienced teacher/leader with a passion for this subject area. The successful applicant will be able to teach students of all abilities as well as demonstrate a proven track record of securing outstanding student outcomes. Proficient and experienced in teaching Design and Technology, ideally with experience of teaching across GCSE/iGCSE and A Level/BTEC.
   

  

***Enough For All, For Ever***
 The Arbor School opened in 2018 with a very different vision of what education could and should be – experiential, authentic and inspired by the natural beauty, human ingenuity, and profound ecological and social challenges of the Arabian Peninsula.
   

  

 The cultivation of a learning community uniquely committed to understanding and restoring the health of ecological and human communities as interconnected parts of a whole requires equal parts optimism, ambition, and humility. A fundamental belief in the inherit goodness of people and their capacity to act with empathy and compassion underscores the sense of hope that is fundamental to learning for a sustainable future. The resilience and determination to tackle challenges that have grown to global proportion is essential to finding sustainable solutions and orchestrating the social changes needed to grow them to scale. The realisation that comes from recognising that we are all students – never a master – drives our commitment to ignite a lifelong love of learning.
   

  

**Role**
 Recognising the interconnected nature of the cognitive, affective, and participative domains, and their roles in shaping learning, we are pursuing a holistic approach to teaching and learning, designed to prepare learners:
   

  

* to understand the interconnected concepts of sustainability, individual and collective well\-being, and environmental and social justice;
* to find purpose, meaning and joy in their interactions with the natural world and with each other, and to seek to understand people who are different to themselves;
* to experience a sense of accomplishment and self\-efficacy through their actions at home, in school and in the wider world.


  

  

**The Arbor Promise**
 Arbor teachers are a part of a community which is inclusive, fun\-loving, and active. Arbor teachers enjoy authentic friendships with their colleagues, positive relationships with school leaders, who care for their wellbeing, and are a team in the true sense. Arbor teachers are resilient in the face of challenge, are stable and calm in the face of change, and creative and flexible when solving problems. Arbor teachers bring their passions and interests to enrich our school and are clear that there is an expectation to do so. We commit to meeting agreed deadlines, to communicating proactively with an assumption of positive intent and share a passion to provide an education of the highest quality to our students.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 The successful candidate will be proficient and experienced in teaching Design and Technology with experience of teaching across GCSE/iGCSE and A Level/BTEC. You will lead the team, with responsibilities across KS3, KS4, and KS5, overseeing Design Technology.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Doing all that you can to ensure that you safeguard and promote the welfare of students (in line with Arbor’s Safeguarding framework/policy/Code of Conduct).
* Positively and actively promoting the Arbor vision, mission, and values.
* Ensuring your practice is in line with the Arbor Staff Handbook, the Arbor Support Teacher: A Framework for Outstanding Support.
* Implementing, where appropriate, school policies, procedures and expected practices, as identified by the Senior Leadership Team at the Arbor School.
* Undertake specific operational tasks as agreed upon with the Assistant Head of Curriculum, including some or all of the following areas:
* To support in developing and reviewing the Design Technology curriculum and schemes of work at KS3, KS4 and KS5\.
* Support in the preparation, delivery and evaluation of schemes of work for the school in accordance with the National Curriculum requirements; with a particular focus on challenge, pace, high order questioning and thinking skills to facilitate students accessing the highest grades at KS3, KS4 and KS5\.
* To ensure that the learning environment is well\-ordered, safe and stimulating, leading by example to encourage a high standard of display work in classrooms and communal areas with a clear emphasis on celebrating success, sharing achievements and highlighting specialist subject knowledge.


**Required Candidate Profile**
* Native\-level English language skills
* Bachelor’s degree in Design Technology or similar, with a PGCE in Education with QTS or equivalent
* A minimum of 3 years experience teaching Design and Technology in the UK or a reputable British school overseas
* A track record of outstanding GSCE and/or A Level examination results.
* A track record of outstanding teaching and learning and an ability to create a caring and nurturing classroom environment.


**Remuneration:** 
 A competitive tax\-free compensation package will be provided in accordance with School's policy and UAE labour law regulations.
   

  

**Application:** 
 To apply for this position, please complete the application on TES and upload:
   

  

* An up\-to\-date CV with a recent photograph to be included.
* A letter of application, no longer than two pages in length, which outlines your educational philosophy and suitability for the Arbor School.


***The Arbor School is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of all the students in our care and expects all applicants to share this commitment. We hold ourselves to a high standard of effective, safer recruiting practices with specific attention to child protection. All appointments are subject to CV and qualification checks, interview, identity checks, criminal record checks, and successful references.***
***All appointments are subject to the approval of the Knowledge and Human Development Authority and the Ministry of Human Resources and Emiratisation.***

data.title: Senior Director, Lifecycle & Retention Marketing
data.raw_snippet: Are you a world\-class growth leader with a proven track record of scaling customer lifetime value (LTV) across global digital products? At Kape Technologies, we’re building the future of cybersecurity and consumer privacy through a diverse portfolio of privacy and security brands, including Express
data.jd_text:
Are you a world\-class growth leader with a proven track record of scaling customer lifetime value (LTV) across global digital products? At Kape Technologies, we’re building the future of cybersecurity and consumer privacy through a diverse portfolio of privacy and security brands, including ExpressVPN, ExpressKeys, ExpressMailGuard, ExpressAI, Identity Defender, CyberGhost, Private Internet Access, EventVPN and Holiday.com.
   

  

 We’re looking for a VP / Director of Lifecycle \& Retention Marketing to own and scale the global lifecycle and retention engine across this portfolio as we expand into new markets and B2B opportunities. In this high\-impact role, you’ll operate at the intersection of growth, product, and data, leading a high\-performing team to shape how millions of users and businesses engage with and stay loyal to our products—while driving Kape’s evolution into a top global cybersecurity company.
   

  

 You will lead a team of \~20 across CRM, lifecycle, pricing, and CRO, defining the next generation of retention through AI\-driven personalization, advanced experimentation, and world\-class customer journeys.
   

  

 What You’ll Own
   

  

 Define \& Scale the Lifecycle Growth Strategy
   

  

 Own the end\-to\-end lifecycle marketing strategy across all brands, with a clear mandate to maximize LTV, reduce churn, and accelerate revenue growth. Build and execute a global roadmap spanning onboarding, engagement, renewal, upsell, and winback.
   

  

 Lead a Best\-in\-Class Retention Organization
   

  

 Build, scale, and inspire a high\-performing team of \~20 across CRM, lifecycle marketing, and CRO. Develop strong leadership layers, elevate talent, and foster a culture of accountability, experimentation, and impact.
   

  

 Own Monetization \& Pricing Strategy
   

  

 Drive the evolution of pricing, packaging, and monetization levers across multiple products. Partner closely with Product and Finance to optimize subscription models, promotions, add\-ons, and upgrade paths that maximize long\-term customer value.
   

  

 Drive AI\-Powered CRM \& Personalization
   

  

 Leverage cutting\-edge CRM platforms and AI\-driven tools to deliver highly personalized, data\-driven customer experiences at scale. Continuously evolve segmentation, targeting, and automation strategies.
   

  

 Optimize the End\-to\-End Customer Journey (CRO \& Lifecycle)
   

  

 Own the intersection of conversion rate optimization (CRO) and lifecycle marketing, ensuring seamless, high\-converting user journeys across all touchpoints—from onboarding through renewal.
   

  

 Build a Unified Retention Ecosystem
   

  

 Partner cross\-functionally with Product, Customer Success, Data, and Engineering to create a cohesive retention and monetization engine. Align incentives, roadmaps, and execution to deliver business impact.
   

  

 Champion Data\-Driven Growth
   

  

 Establish best\-in\-class analytics and experimentation frameworks. Deeply understand and optimize key metrics including churn, resurrection, winback, upsell, renewal rates, and LTV.
   

  

 Hands\-On Leadership in a Scaling Environment
   

  

 Operate as both a strategic leader and an execution partner—comfortable rolling up your sleeves to unblock teams, launch initiatives, and drive results, especially in a high\-growth or smaller company environment.
   

  

 What We’re Looking For
   

  

* 8–10\+ years of experience in lifecycle, retention, or growth marketing within high\-scale digital, SaaS, or cybersecurity businesses
* Proven track record of driving LTV growth, reducing churn, and scaling monetization
* Leadership experience managing teams of 10\+, with the ability to build and scale organizations
* Deep expertise in CRM, lifecycle marketing, experimentation (CRO), and retention strategy
* Strong experience with pricing and subscription monetization models
* Familiarity with AI\-driven marketing tools, automation, and advanced segmentation
* Highly data\-driven, with strong analytical and experimentation capabilities
* Hands\-on operator who can execute as well as lead
* Exceptional cross\-functional collaborator across Product, Sales, Data, and Customer teams
* Clear, compelling communicator who can align and inspire at all levels


**Before you apply**
* At the moment, we do not sponsor visas in the EU. For Hong Kong, we require at least two years of working experience and a university degree in a related field. For Singapore and the UK, we can only sponsor visas for mid\-career or above.
* Please upload your resume as a PDF and do not include any salary or compensation information in it.


*ExpressVPN is one of the world’s leading providers of online privacy and security services for consumers. Started in 2009, we’ve grown to have millions of active paying customers, a team of more than 700 people worldwide, and a brand recognized by hundreds of millions of people in 18 languages and more than a hundred countries. We see huge growth in our industry, and are gaining market share through strong execution.*

Our client is a globally recognised leader in advanced technology solutions across the Cyber \& Digital domains. Their portfolio of cutting\-edge products and services is designed to tackle critical challenges, including sovereignty, security, sustainability, and inclusion.
 



 We are partnering with a global technology organisation to appoint a Regional Enterprise Sales Director to lead their Identity \& Access Management (IAM) business across the MEA region. This is a high\-impact leadership role focused on driving revenue growth, expanding market presence, and building a high\-performing sales function within a fast\-growing cybersecurity segment.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 



* Own and drive IAM sales performance across the MEA region, with accountability for revenue, bookings, and billings
* Lead regional growth through a balanced strategy of new business acquisition ("land") and expansion within existing accounts ("expand")
* Champion cross\-selling across IAM product lines and broader cybersecurity solutions
* Align regional sales strategy with global business objectives and act as a key driver of transformation initiatives
* Build, lead, and develop a high\-performing sales team, ensuring clear targets, accountability, and continuous development
* Collaborate closely with marketing, pre\-sales, product teams, and partner ecosystems to strengthen go\-to\-market execution
* Leverage both direct and indirect sales channels to maximise reach and pipeline generation
* Drive brand visibility and pipeline growth through digital, social, and field marketing initiatives
* Partner with sales operations to ensure efficient deal execution and revenue realisation



**Key Requirements** 



* Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, or a related discipline
* Proven track record in MEA sales leadership within roles of comparable or greater scale, including revenue ownership, team size, and market complexity
* Strong knowledge of Identity \& Access Management (IAM) and the broader cybersecurity landscape, including CIAM
* Experience engaging with senior stakeholders across both business and technology functions (e.g. CIOs, Heads of Digital, Enterprise Architects), as well as governance and compliance leaders (e.g. CISOs, DPOs, Compliance Officers)
* Solid understanding of multiple go\-to\-market models, including direct sales, channel (1\-tier and 2\-tier), and GSI co\-sell structures, with the ability to apply the right approach to different sales motions
* Background in consultative and value\-based solution selling
* Familiarity with modern go\-to\-market strategies, including Account\-Based Marketing (ABM) and demand generation campaigns
* Strong relationship\-building capabilities with key customers and partners, coupled with advanced negotiation skills
* Technically proficient with sales and productivity tools such as Microsoft O365 and Salesforce
* Demonstrated ability to build, scale, and lead high\-performing sales teams
* Strong leadership presence with excellent communication, coaching, and mentoring capabilities, particularly in driving cloud\-based revenue growth

Our client is a leading FMCG company with a strong portfolio of multinational consumer brands. They are seeking to hire a Regional Marketing Director / Head of Marketing to lead and transform the overall marketing agenda across brands, categories, and markets. Based in Dubai, this is a high\-impact leadership role responsible for driving sustainable growth, strengthening brand equity, optimizing marketing ROI, and ensuring full alignment with principal brand strategies, while leading a team of Brand Managers across the portfolio.
 







 This opportunity is particularly exciting for a commercially minded marketing leader who can combine strategic brand building with trade execution, distributor market complexity, and measurable business growth across multiple geographies.
 







 Key Responsibilities:
 


* Develop and lead the overall regional marketing strategy across brands, markets, and channels (including modern trade, traditional trade, pharmacies and ecommerce)
* Drive long\-term brand positioning, category growth, and portfolio expansion
* Lead annual A\&P planning, budgeting, and investment allocation
* Oversee ATL, BTL, digital, trade marketing, and market execution strategies
* Ensure pricing, promotions, and category initiatives translate into measurable commercial growth
* Lead principal relationships, joint business planning, and strategic brand reviews
* Drive product launches, innovation pipelines, and portfolio optimization
* Establish strong KPI frameworks covering ROI, brand health, and performance analytics
* Strengthen route\-to\-market and go\-to\-market effectiveness across operating markets
* Lead and develop the regional marketing function, building capability and succession







 Candidate Requirements:
 


* 10–15\+ years of FMCG marketing experience
* 5\+ years in senior marketing leadership roles in FMCG
* Multi\-country or regional marketing leadership exposure preferred
* Proven track record of driving revenue growth, market share, and profitability through marketing
* Strong commercial, financial, and analytical capabilities
* Experience managing brand portfolios, trade marketing, and principal relationships
* Strategic leadership combined with operational execution excellence
