data.jd_text:
* About the position The Technical Engineer is responsible for supervising the delivery of technical maintenance and hard services across assigned client sites, ensuring that locations are maintained and operated in line with the agreed maintenance strategy, client requirements, statutory obligations, and CBRE standards.
* Decision Making Authority


**This Position Has The Authority To**
* Technical Maintenance Delivery


 Supervise day\-to\-day technical maintenance and hard services activities across assigned client sites.
   

  

 Ensure planned preventive maintenance and reactive maintenance activities are completed safely, on time, and in accordance with the agreed service levels, KPIs, and client requirements.
   

  

 Support delivery of a cost\-effective maintenance plan that protects assets, reduces business interruption risk, and supports a safe and comfortable working environment.
   

  

 Monitor workload, vendor capacity, site resources, and open technical issues, escalating concerns and recommending changes where required.
   

  

* Technical Site Inspections \& Risk Management


 Conduct regular technical site inspections to identify MEP, building services, operational, compliance, and asset condition risks.
   

  

 Identify defects, recurring faults, business\-critical risks, and maintenance gaps, and recommend practical corrective actions or improvement plans.
   

  

 Support root\-cause review of recurring technical failures and help drive preventative actions to reduce repeat issues and unnecessary invasive maintenance.
   

  

 Escalate critical technical risks, safety concerns, or potential service interruptions to the Facilities Manager / Account Lead.
   

  

* Work Order \& Maintenance System Management


 Monitor open work orders and ensure timely updates, evidence upload, escalation, and closure.
   

  

 Support the implementation and ongoing use of Chase or other CAFM / work order management systems.
   

  

 Ensure maintenance records, job cards, completion notes, service reports, photos, permits, and supporting evidence are accurately captured and maintained.
   

  

 Reduce reliance on manual Excel trackers by improving system\-based reporting, visibility, and accountability.
   

  

* Vendor, Subcontractor \& Service Partner Management


 Coordinate with subcontractors, third\-party vendors, and specialist service providers for planned, reactive, and small works activities.
   

  

 Monitor vendor performance, response times, quality of work, statutory compliance, and value for money.
   

  

 Validate completion of subcontractor works before closure, approval, or escalation.
   

  

 Support technical scoping, quotation review, and follow\-through for remedial works, minor projects, relocations, equipment handling, and lifecycle\-related improvements.
   

  

 Ensure service providers hold the required professional qualifications, permits, RAMS, licenses, and service documentation where applicable.
   

  

* Compliance, HSSE \& Statutory Requirements


 Ensure all technical works comply with statutory requirements, client standards, CBRE procedures, and site HSSE rules.
   

  

 Promote a strong safety culture and ensure unsafe practices, non\-compliance, or flagrant violations are escalated appropriately.
   

  

 Support site teams with permits to work, RAMS, isolation requirements, compliance certificates, service records, and audit evidence.
   

  

 Assist with closure of technical, safety, and compliance\-related findings.
   

  

* Team Support, Training \& Continuous Improvement


 Provide technical guidance and practical support to Facilities Coordinators, site teams, and vendors.
   

  

 Support competency reviews, identify technical training needs, and help uplift site\-based maintenance capability.
   

  

 Share best practice and recommend improved maintenance techniques, operational controls, and service delivery solutions.
   

  

 Build strong working relationships with internal teams, clients, vendors, and support functions.
   

  

* Reporting, Budget Awareness \& Client Support


 Provide regular updates on technical issues, open works, risks, defects, PPM progress, reactive performance, and action plans.
   

  

 Support account leads with technical input for client meetings, operational reviews, business cases, and reporting packs.
   

  

 Provide technical input into monthly reports, budget variance commentary, discretionary spend visibility, and maintenance improvement recommendations where required.
   

  

 Perform other duties as reasonably assigned by the line manager.
   

  

* Experience / Education Diploma, trade qualification, recognised apprenticeship, ONC / equivalent, or technical certification in Mechanical, Electrical, HVAC, Building Services, Facilities Management, or a related discipline. Minimum 5 years' experience in facilities management, building services, MEP, technical maintenance, or hard services delivery. Previous experience supervising technical teams, subcontractors, or specialist service providers is preferred. Experience in planned preventive maintenance, reactive maintenance, statutory compliance, asset management, and work order systems. Experience conducting technical site inspections and identifying MEP, building services, safety, and operational risks. Experience coordinating vendors, reviewing technical quotations, validating service reports, and following through on remedial works. Experience in a client\-facing FM environment. Knowledge of HSE requirements, permits to work, RAMS, statutory compliance documentation, and audit evidence is preferred.
* Skills Required Strong technical knowledge across MEP, HVAC, electrical, plumbing, fire/life safety, and general building systems. Strong technical inspection, fault\-identification, and root\-cause problem\-solving capability. Ability to supervise technical maintenance activities and coordinate multiple vendors across several sites. Ability to prioritise workload and maintain a safe, compliant, and effective operating environment. Ability to develop practical technical solutions, site improvement recommendations, and business case inputs. Good CAFM / work order system capability, including job updates, evidence upload, reporting, and closure discipline. Strong vendor management and contractor coordination skills. Strong communication skills with site teams, vendors, clients, and management. Good report writing, business writing, and Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Teams, and digital tracking systems. Proactive, detail\-oriented, service\-focused, and solution\-driven. Ability to coach and support site teams to improve technical standards and maintenance discipline. Strong safety awareness and commitment to compliance, quality, and client satisfaction.
* Knowledge Required Integrated facilities management and hard services delivery. MEP systems, building services infrastructure, and maintenance best practice. PPM planning, reactive maintenance, asset condition assessment, and lifecycle risk identification. Work order management / CAFM systems, preferably Chase or similar platforms. SLA / KPI management and technical service delivery standards. Vendor coordination, subcontractor control, quotation review, service report validation, and value\-for\-money principles. HSE standards, permits to work, RAMS, compliance records, statutory maintenance requirements, and audit evidence. Maintenance strategy, asset protection, business continuity risk, and prevention of service disruption. Basic budget awareness, discretionary spend controls, and cost\-effective maintenance delivery. Client account structures, site operating requirements, cost centres, and escalation routes.


**Competencies Required**
 Communication, Team leadership, Customer and quality focus, Problem solving and decision making, Accountability, Planning and organising, Drive and productivity, Collaboration
   

  

* Company Values Respect; Integrity; Service; Excellence; Accountability; Collaboration; Transformation
* Major Drivers of Work Volume The major drivers of work volume are planned preventive maintenance, reactive work orders, technical inspections, asset condition issues, vendor coordination, statutory compliance, HSSE requirements, service reports, open work order management, small works / remedial works, client reporting, SLA / KPI performance, and the implementation of structured maintenance processes across the portfolio.
* Interface / Relationships With Internal: Facilities Coordinators, Facilities Managers, Account Leads, Operations Managers, Middle East Operations Director, Procurement, Finance/AP, HSE, P\&A, IT, Regional Operations, and on\-site client stakeholders. External: Clients, landlords/building management teams, subcontractors, specialist service providers, suppliers, auditors, statutory authorities where applicable, and project\-related stakeholders.


**Working environment / Special factors**
 The incumbent will work across client sites and office environments, with regular site\-based inspections required to support technical delivery, vendor management, compliance, and maintenance performance. Normal working hours will apply as per client and operational requirements; however, flexibility may be required to support urgent technical issues, planned shutdowns, audits, emergency works, or client/project requirements.

**About us:** 




 dmg events is an international exhibitions and publishing company. We attract more than 650 000\+ visitors to our global portfolio of 115\+ exhibitions each year. **Job Description:** 



* To be fully responsible for the revenue generation of the exhibition stands and sponsorship packages to achieve agreed sales targets for your event.

data.jd_text:
The Business Development Director – P\&AI Division (Middle East). This division\-level leadership role is responsible for driving growth strategy and execution across all P\&AI businesses in the Middle East region. The role works in close partnership with Divisional Marketing, Business Unit Managers, Business Managers, Regional Sales, and Aftermarket teams to accelerate sustainable growth, expand market share, and improve profitability.
   

  

 This position focuses on business development and growth strategy. Marketing communications, branding, and promotional execution are supported through the P\&AI Division Marketing Shared Service and are not owned by this role.
   

  

**How You Will Make An Impact**
 Growth Strategy \& Execution
   

  

* Develop and lead execution of the Middle East regional growth strategy aligned with P\&AI divisional priorities.
* Drive execution of critical growth initiatives with measurable impact on orders growth, market penetration, margin expansion, and regional capability development.
* Align divisional, regional, and business\-level priorities to ensure focus on the highest\-value growth opportunities.


 Market \& Opportunity Development
   

  

* Identify, assess, and prioritize strategic growth opportunities at regional and country levels in collaboration with regional and business leadership.
* Lead market analysis, voice\-of\-customer activities, and competitive assessments to support investment decisions and resource allocation.
* Develop and maintain market sizing models, segmentation analysis, and opportunity pipelines to enable data\-driven decision\-making.
* Monitor market, customer, and competitive trends and adjust growth initiatives accordingly.


 Commercial Enablement
   

  

* Partner with Sales and Aftermarket teams to support growth\-focused commercial strategies, including key account development, value\-based pricing approaches, and channel strategy.
* Provide early visibility to regional leadership on upcoming opportunities, including expected scope, timing, and capability requirements.
* Contribute to the creation and continuous improvement of regional and divisional growth playbooks and best practices.
* Cultivate senior‑level customer and partner relationships, establishing top‑to‑top strategic executive engagement to supplement business‑element relationships, and engaging leaders across operators, EPCs, and strategic accounts to shape long‑term growth strategies and influence early‑stage project positioning.
* Coordinate cross‑business project strategies through a structured project pursuit process (e.g., Miller Heiman or equivalent) applied consistently across business elements, ensuring alignment of sales, marketing, engineering, and aftermarket teams to deliver integrated, customer‑centric solutions.


 Portfolio \& Capability Alignment
   

  

* Identify product, solution, and capability gaps relative to Middle East market requirements and competitive dynamics.
* Collaborate with Divisional Marketing and Engineering/R\&D teams to translate market needs into clear business cases and development requirements.
* Ensure growth priorities are clearly communicated to relevant stakeholders to support effective planning and execution.


 Cross\-Functional Leadership
   

  

* Act as a connector across P\&AI businesses, promoting collaboration, knowledge sharing, and regional alignment.
* Participate in divisional governance, operating rhythms, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Represent AMETEK P\&AI with customers, partners, and industry organizations in support of growth strategy and market insight.


**Required Experience \& Skills**
* Strong knowledge of oil \& gas and process industries, with understanding of Middle East regional market dynamics.
* Demonstrated experience in business development, strategy, or growth leadership within a global, matrixed organization.
* Proven ability to translate strategy into executable initiatives with measurable commercial outcomes.
* Strong analytical skills, including market analysis, financial modeling, and competitive assessment.
* Excellent communication, collaboration, and influence skills across cultures and organizational levels.


**Education \& Experience**
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, or a related field.
* 15\+ years of experience in business development, strategy, commercial leadership, or management consulting, including at least 5 years of direct experience within the oil \& gas and energy sectors.
* 5\+ years of experience working in a global, matrixed organization supporting multiple businesses or regions.
* Broad experience across upstream, midstream, downstream, petrochemical, and associated energy infrastructure markets is preferred, including exposure to national and international customers, operators, EPCs, and service providers.


**Additional Information**
* Position requires regular travel within the Middle East and internationally.
* Requires strong business acumen, leadership presence, and executive\-level professionalism.


 AMETEK, Inc. is a leading global provider of industrial technology solutions serving a diverse set of attractive niche markets with annual sales over $7\.5 billion.
   

  

 AMETEK is committed to making a safer, sustainable, and more productive world a reality. We use differentiated technology solutions to solve our customers’ most complex challenges. We employ 22,000 colleagues, in 35 countries, that are grounded by our core values: Ethics and Integrity, Respect for the Individual, Inclusion, Teamwork, and Social Responsibility.  Join the team at Messe Frankfurt Middle East as
 **Head of Marketing** 
 for our
 **Mobility \& Logistics portfolio** 
 , where you’ll lead strategic, insight\-driven marketing initiatives that drive growth, enhance audience engagement, and strengthen the positioning of our events across the region.
 



  





 This role is pivotal in shaping the success and future direction of the Mobility \& Logistics portfolio. You’ll take ownership of the end\-to\-end marketing strategy, working closely with the Portfolio Director and Show Directors to deliver high\-impact, data\-led campaigns. * Experience managing agencies and delivering high\-quality, impactful campaigns

data.jd_text:
**Job Description**
**What if you could do the kind of work the world needs?**
 At WSP, you can access our global scale, contribute to landmark projects and connect with the brightest minds in your field to do the best work of your life. You can embrace your curiosity in a culture that celebrates new ideas and diverse perspectives. You can experience a world of opportunity and the chance to shape a career as unique as you.
   

  

 WSP is seeking to appoint a Head of Architecture Integration \& Building Performance, a role that provides a single point of portfolio\-level direction and leadership across Fire \& Life Safety, Building Enclosures / Facades, and Technical Architecture, with clear line management accountability for the Heads of these disciplines.
   

  

 The Heads of Discipline already deliver strongly and cover many of the technical and operational activities within their teams. This role is not created to duplicate that work. It is created to formalize the portfolio\-level direction and alignment that has historically been driven by the Director of Specialists, ensuring consistent prioritization, governance, and follow\-through across the three business lines.
   

  

 The role will drive disciplined implementation of the Specialist Services Strategy and the Global Specialist Strategy for this portfolio, with particular emphasis on accelerating growth in Technical Architecture (architecture\-led technical coordination and expanded scope), while proactively managing delivery risk where FLS and building enclosures performance can impact project outcomes.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Portfolio leadership \& direction (non\-negotiable)**
* Set one clear direction across the portfolio: priorities, standards, decision\-making, and escalation routes.
* Align discipline plans so delivery and growth efforts are coordinated and outcome\-driven.
* Lead delivery recovery when projects are off track due to late inputs, rework, inconsistent advice, or weak coordination, with particular focus on high\-risk interfaces (e.g., Envelope ↔ Architecture/Structure/MEP/FLS dependencies).


**Line management of Heads of Discipline**
* Line\-manage the Heads of FLS, Building Enclosures/Facades, and Technical Architecture with accountability for performance, delivery discipline, team health, and capability building.
* Coach and enable the Heads of Discipline on complex delivery issues, client risk, resourcing constraints, and cross\-discipline coordination.
* Drive an operating rhythm that reduces reliance on the Director of Specialists for day\-to\-day direction.


**Technical authority \& delivery governance (quality \+ consistency)**
* Act as a credible technical authority (in at least one of the three disciplines) with the ability to challenge and guide across the portfolio.
* Define “what good looks like” for deliverables (minimum content, evidence requirements, review expectations) and ensure consistent application across the portfolio.
* Implement and enforce governance so issues do not repeat: standards, peer reviews, readiness gates, decision logs, and action\-closure discipline.


**Operational Excellence (ways of working that stick)**
* Establish consistent delivery ways of working across the portfolio (review gates, interfaces, escalation routes) and drive adoption.
* Drive measurable improvement in right\-first\-time outputs, fewer late changes, and clearer accountability across the three disciplines.


**Strategy adherence \& implementation (Specialist Services Strategy 2025–2027\)**
* Own implementation across the four pillars for this portfolio: Clients, Expertise, Operational Excellence, People \& Culture.
* Ensure discipline pillar champions/leads are active and contributing as designed, and translate strategy into practical execution and consistent follow\-through.
* Remove blockers so progress is sustained and not dependent on ad hoc senior intervention.


**Go\-to\-market and growth leadership (per business line)**
* Drive growth of each business line through market positioning, bid quality, cross\-sell, and consistent go\-to\-market collateral aligned to the Global Specialist Strategy intent.
* For Technical Architecture, accelerate growth by expanding scope and strengthening architecture\-led technical coordination and design integration aligned to the team’s published strategy direction.
* Contribute to global alignment outputs relevant to this portfolio (e.g., discipline forums / collaboration inputs and go\-to\-market strategy contributions) as required.


**People leadership \& capability building (portfolio bench strength)**
* Build bench strength across the portfolio (deputies, succession, coaching) and embed capability uplift through People \& Culture and Expertise pillars.
* Identify targeted upskilling and recruitment priorities aligned to strategy and growth needs.


**Qualifications**
* 20\+ years’ experience with senior leadership exposure in complex building environments, with strong relevance to Architecture / Technical Architecture and the ability to lead across Building Safety and Envelope disciplines.
* Demonstrated ability to lead senior discipline heads and drive consistent standards and outcomes across multiple specialisms.
* Track record of implementing operating models and standards (not just writing strategy).
* Strong stakeholder influence across disciplines and regions.


**Essential Behaviours**
* Delivery spine: drives closure, makes decisions stick, holds standards under pressure.
* Strategic thinking with practical execution: converts intent into clear prioritisation and outcomes.
* Collaborative “one team” mindset aligned to global specialist connectivity and growth objectives.


**Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all.**
 Join our close\-knit community of talented individuals who share your passion for making a positive impact. Our global team includes more than 69,000 employees, working together to make a difference in communities both close to home and around the world.
   

  

**With us, you can. Apply today.**

Pattern is a leading eCommerce accelerator with offices across the globe offering outsourced marketplace and ecommerce management services for brands worldwide. The Pattern Ecommerce Acceleration Platform leverages AI\-powered technology, industry expertise, and global distribution, logistics, and fulfilment services to help quality brands scale profitably on their own websites and through hundreds of marketplaces. Pattern works with some of the most recognized brands such as Thorne, Naturelo, Marshall, Nutricost, MegaFood, TIGI, Hair Burst and Sage and it ranks among the top 5 Amazon sellers globally.
   

  

 Pattern is expanding and we are looking for an experienced Ecommerce expert to join our MENA Team in Dubai to support the scaling of the business by driving the performance of the brands we represent on Amazon and other Marketplaces.
   

  

 You will own the relationship and financial performance of a portfolio of global brands managing their performance across marketplaces here in MENA. You will support the Associate Director of eCommercewith defining and implementing the E2E growth and profitability plan for your portfolio of brands by working cross\-functionally with Operations, Content, Advertising, Creative, Merchandising and Finance. You will also lead cross\-functional projects to implement processes to scale the organisation in MENA. You will be a strategic and commercial ecommerce professional who can engage partners and internal stakeholders towards a common goal. You will have a growth mindset and love navigating the challenges of working in fast changing landscapes.
   

  

**The core responsibilities of the eCommerce Manager reflect the following**

 At Kerzner, we never settle. Through continued innovation, our team of pioneers push until the next level is achieved, and then to keep going. Our philosophy is simple \- we go above and beyond to Blow Away our Guest and Colleagues. Good enough never is. For us, it is all about perfection and innovation. This is not simply our job, it’s our passion.
   

  

 Our Colleagues are at the heart of who we are and what we do. With an international team of over 10,000 Colleagues and strong strategic growth on the horizon, we offer unrivalled career opportunities around the world. We are committed to provide our Colleagues at all levels with opportunities to grow and develop within the organisation through personalised development plans and tailored succession planning. We invest in our communities to sustain the environment where we operate and minimising our own footprint. Whether it is through animal conservation, education or tree\-planting, we like to give back in as many ways as we can to help our communities flourish.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 The Director, Residential Portfolio Management is responsible for the portfolio‑level governance, planning, and setup of branded residential components across Kerzner’s global Private Homes and Branded Residences development pipeline.
   

  

 The role focuses on the pre‑opening residential lifecycle, from early pre‑development and planning through to opening, providing structured management and coordination with internal and external stakeholders. The objective is to ensure that all branded residential projects are consistently defined, correctly configured, brand‑aligned, and operationally ready for structured handover to OpCo at opening.
   

  

 The position acts as the residential portfolio authority, establishing and managing residential project stage gates, defining residential requirements and standards, and validating outcomes at key milestones to ensure quality, consistency, and readiness across a growing pipeline of residential projects. The role does not include responsibility for day‑to‑day operations, rental programs, or HOA governance, which sit outside of this position.
   

  

 The role requires a strong background in luxury hospitality‑led residential product, portfolio oversight, and cross‑functional coordination, with the ability to translate brand intent and residential requirements into repeatable, scalable outcomes across multiple projects and geographies.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Portfolio Governance \& Residential Frameworks** 
  

  

* Establish, own, and maintain portfolio‑wide residential frameworks, standards, and setup playbooks for all branded residential and Private Homes projects.
* Define, document, and maintain Kerzner side residential requirements and performance principles to inform the design and delivery of branded residential projects across the portfolio.
* Establish minimum portfolio requirements (not design solutions) covering:
+ Unit mix and typology principles (performance intent and target ranges, not layouts)
+ Residential amenity principles, including owner only vs shared use positioning
+ Arrival, circulation, privacy, and access requirements, expressed as outcomes rather than spatial solutions
+ Back of house and servicing requirements necessary to support efficient future operation and homeowner experience
+ Residential technology readiness criteria, defining capability requirements rather than system design

* Ensure consistent interpretation and application of branded residential standards across all projects and geographies.


**Residential Project Stage Gates (Portfolio Control)** 
  

  

* Establish and manage Residential Project Stage Gates aligned with the wider development lifecycle.
* Define required residential inputs and outputs at each stage, including:
+ Deal feasibility / concept confirmation
+ Concept design
+ Schematic design
+ Design development (residential “red‑flag” review)
+ Design and Build Phase
+ Pre‑opening residential readiness
+ Handover to OpCo

* Act as the Kerzner residential authority at each stage gate by:
+ Validating compliance with portfolio standards and residential requirements
+ Identifying material risks, gaps, or deviations
+ Confirming readiness to progress from a residential perspective

* Maintain a portfolio‑level record of residential stage‑gate reviews, approvals, and deviations
* Present stage gate readiness to all key internal stakeholders.


**Pre‑Development \& Planning (Residential Input)** 
  

  

* Provide residential subject‑matter input during pre‑development and early planning phases of new branded residential opportunities.
* Support Business Development and Design and Construction teams with residential assessments relating to:
+ Brand alignment and positioning
+ High‑level residential scope and feasibility assumptions
+ Unit mix strategy, typologies, and sizing logic
+ Amenity positioning and residential value proposition
+ Preliminary operational and governance implications

* Define early residential product principles to inform project briefs prior to design commencement.
* Identify and mitigate early‑stage risks that could impact:
+ Residential liveability and owner experience
+ Long‑term asset and portfolio value
+ Operational viability and handover readiness

* Ensure residential planning decisions align with a scalable, repeatable portfolio strategy.


**Design \& Project Interface (Residential Input Only)**
* Provide structured residential input to Design and Project teams at defined project milestones.
* Review residential layouts, adjacencies, circulation, and functional planning from an owner, operator readiness, and portfolio perspective.
* Ensure residential requirements and assumptions are clearly documented and integrated into the design process.
* Monitor design evolution to prevent unintended deviations that may negatively affect residential quality or long‑term usability.
* Maintain a collaborative, non‑authoring relationship with Design, respecting design leadership and consultant ownership.


**Brand Compliance \& Residential Product Integrity** 
  

  

* Ensure branded residential standards are interpreted and applied consistently across the portfolio.
* Review key residential elements impacting brand equity and owner experience, including:
+ Finishes intent and durability
+ Amenity positioning and exclusivity
+ Privacy, acoustics, and spatial separation

* Monitor and document residential deviations, concessions, and approved exceptions.
* Provide portfolio‑level insight into recurring issues and lessons learned across projects.


**Residential Operating Model \& Operating Plan Development**
* Define the Residential Operating Model and develop a structured Residential Operating Plan (ROP) for each project during the planning phase
* Ensure the defined residential operating plan is fully supported by design and asset configuration, validating that back‑of‑house layouts, access, storage, plant capacity, service flows, and residential technology capabilities enable efficient, discreet, and brand‑appropriate operation.
* Validate residential operational readiness from a governance perspective, confirming the asset can be realistically operated as intended, that material operational risks, inefficiencies, or cost drivers are identified and mitigated early, and that the project is ready for OpCo acceptance without fundamental re‑planning
* Formally package and transition the Residential Operating Model to OpCo as part of pre‑opening and handover, ensuring clarity of intent, scope, and assumptions.


**Pre‑Opening \& Handover** 
  

  

* Coordinate with OpCo teams in advance of opening to support a smooth transition of responsibility.
* Lead residential readiness activities prior to opening from a portfolio and governance perspective.
* Ensure completion of all residential handover requirements, including obtaining TCO and OC, establishing asset and warranty register frameworks, completing residential handover checklists, and confirming owner move‑in readiness principles.
* Coordinate structured handover of residential assets to:
+ OpCo (operations)
+ Director of Residence

* Formally transition responsibility at opening, retaining oversight only for portfolio‑level tracking, consult level support and continuous improvement.


**Portfolio Reporting \& Stakeholder Coordination** 
  

  

* Maintain strong collaboration with internal and external stakeholders including:
+ Design
+ Projects / Construction
+ Business Development
+ Property Management
+ OpCo

* Provide regular portfolio reporting on:
+ Residential pipeline status
+ Key risks and mitigation actions
+ Stage‑gate progress and readiness

* Support leadership decision‑making with clear, evidence‑based residential insights.


**Explicit Exclusions (Boundary Clarity)**
* No responsibility for residential rental programs or leasing
* No day‑to‑day residential operations or staffing
* No HOA or residential governance management
* No design authorship or consultant management


**Skills, Experience \& Educational Requirements**
* Bachelor’s degree in Real Estate, Business, Hospitality Management, Architecture, or related field required; Master’s degree preferred.
* Minimum 8–10 years’ experience across branded residences, luxury mixed‑use developments, or hospitality‑led residential platforms.
* Strong understanding of branded residential product, owner expectations, and residential lifecycle planning.
* Proven experience working at portfolio level across multiple concurrent projects.
* Ability to influence across Design, Development, Projects, Operations, and Property Management without direct authority.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong analytical and organisational skills with ability to manage complexity across geographies.
* Comfortable operating in an owner‑side, non‑operational, governance‑focused role.
* Willingness to travel internationally as required.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications; strong Excel skills preferred.
* Fluent in English; additional languages advantageous.


 Our company is expanding faster than ever before. We are investing in the growth of our company, and that means we are committed to investing in you. Join a team that is open\-hearted, innovative, inclusive, and inspiring in spirit. We believe in making our guests happy beyond anything they have ever imagined. We wow them at every turn and create memories that will last a lifetime. You will be at the heart of this vision, to constantly innovate to deliver Amazing Experiences and Everlasting Memories.

**SUMMARY** 




 The role is responsible for providing excellence in fund services client relationship management. Managing and nurturing client relationships within our fund administration division. This role requires a deep understanding of fund administration services, strong interpersonal skills, and the ability to provide tailored solutions to meet clients' fund administration needs. The role holder shall primarily interface between external parties (investment managers, auditors, bankers, brokers, legal counsels etc.) to understand their requirements and internal parties (different production units globally) to ensure compliance, ensuring all the deliverables are accurate, on time and of high quality.
 



  





**PRIMARY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES** 




 Client Relationship Management:
 


* Serve as the primary point of contact for a portfolio of fund administration clients, building and maintaining strong, long\-term relationships.
* Conduct regular meetings with clients to understand their fund administration needs, regulatory requirements, and reporting preferences.
* Ensure clients are informed about the full range of fund administration services available and provide expert guidance on best practices.
* Interpret the data and answer queries that might arise from the Investment Manager or investors regarding the financial statements of a fund and in particular its portfolio investments, fee calculations and NAV per share.
* Attending client meetings and provide technical support to the sales team.
* Service Delivery and Quality Assurance:
* Collaborate with internal fund accounting teams to ensure the accurate and timely delivery of services to clients.
* Service existing funds and their managers to ensure timely and excellent delivery of services as agreed with each manager.
* Review NAV packages and ensure they are error free before being sent to the investment manager and investors.
* Communicate regularly and effectively with the Fund Accounting team in India/ Mauritius who are responsible for all accounting and investor services.
* Give administrative support to Fund Services team and Fund Relationship Manager, including arranging payments, keeping filing updated, scanning and faxing.
* Constant monitoring of shareholder services to ensure up to date processing of subscription and redemptions, with timely completion of KYC/ AML checks.



  





 TIME RECORDING:
 


* Accurately record chargeable time and value of service using Maconomy, ensure effective monitoring of transactions, handle pricing, invoicing and collection of outstanding fees for the portfolio of clients.
* Monitor own productivity and chargeability on weekly basis and review productivity and performance against targets. to ensure that individual financial targets and client communication KPIs are met.
* Follow a disciplined approach to submitting timesheets for client work and meet the weekly and monthly time/ chargeability targets



  





 OTHER DUTIES
 


* Undertake the role of director, trustee, nominee, manager, partner, secretary, authorized signatory or any related position in internal entities or client entities of Amicorp Group, where necessary and required by the Management.
* Undertake such other duties, as may from time to time, be required by the Management or/ and Group Human Resources.



  





**CANDIDATE PROFILE** 



* Relevant Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Economics or Business Administration. CPA/ CA/ CAIA qualified or part qualified (preferred but not a must)
* At least 5\-8 years’ work experience in fund administration, with a good understanding of the daily operations of fund administrator including compliance, NAV computation and transfer agency function.
* Knowledge of regional financial markets and different financial products.
* Solid understanding of ledger entries, accounting for different transactions in the investments industry and their impact on financial statements.
* Hands on experience in the field of Fund Accounting, Investor Services, Fund Structuring and/or Fund
* Directorships. Good understanding of local market Fund regulations. Knowledge of PFX Paxus would be an advantage.
* Experience in Private Equity fund structuring, waterfall distribution, carried interest calculation are highly appreciated. Basic understanding on offshore jurisdiction fund structures as well as industry relevant regulations including FATCA, CRS, BEPS, GAAR, ESR.
* Excellent organizational, interpersonal and communication skills, preferable in regional languages.
* Exceptional client facing skills. Well\-developed spoken and written communication skills and the ability to tailor style to relevant audiences, and successfully liaise with people at different levels. Excellent English language fluency; additional languages preferred.
* Strong analytical and problem solving skills, solution driven, highly organized and detail\-orientated with good decision making and time management skills. Independent, hands\-on and takes accountability to deliver solutions and results.
* Ability to adapt and work in a smaller, dynamic local team environment with tight deadlines; along with being part of a bigger matrix organization. Proven team player skills, with ambition to excel in the role and grow into fund origination and structuring.

 Mid\-senior Level

data.jd_text:
**About Lucidya**
 Lucidya is an AI\-native platform for customer experience (CX) intelligence that manages entire customer lifecycles autonomously, from initial engagement through retention and growth.
   

  

 Unlike platforms that only surface insights and leave the action to you, Lucidya completes the loop with proprietary NLU capabilities developed entirely in\-house and trained on millions of multilingual conversations, equipping marketing, support, CX, and research teams to deliver personalised experiences that drive measurable improvements in customer satisfaction, retention, and lifetime value.
   

  

**Why This Role Matters**
 Enterprise clients don't churn because of the product. They churn because implementation fails, adoption stalls, or they never get to the outcome they were sold.
   

  

 As Lucidya moves upmarket \- BFSI, telecom, media, retail \- the complexity of deployments grows. Onboarding a large enterprise is no longer a handoff. It's a multi\-month, multi\-stakeholder programme with real financial and reputational stakes on both sides.
   

  

 This role owns that entire delivery motion. You will build and lead the team responsible for getting customers from signed contracts to measurable value \- and keeping them there. You will own the managed services P\&L and the operational rigour that separates a world\-class implementation function from a reactive project management team.
   

  

 If you are energised by building structure in complexity, are equally comfortable in a client boardroom and a resource planning spreadsheet, and want your work to directly determine whether enterprise customers succeed \- this role is built for you.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
**Lead delivery end\-to\-end.**
* Execute the PMO strategy across customer onboarding, implementation, migration, and ongoing managed services \- translating strategic direction into reliable, repeatable delivery
* Ensure every project is delivered within scope, on time, and within budget \- and that CSAT and NPS reflect it
* Serve as the executive escalation point when projects hit risk. You do not wait to be told \- you see it coming
* Develop, enforce, and continuously improve standardised delivery methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, or Hybrid depending on the engagement)


**Own the commercial side of services.**
* Own the deal economics for managed services \- project profitability, gross margins, and commercial accountability for the delivery function
* Forecast team capacity, manage utilisation, and optimise staffing across implementation specialists, project managers, analysts, and designers to match pipeline demand
* Work with Sales to scope SOWs accurately. Overpromising at the deal stage is a delivery problem \- you have a say in preventing it


**Build and develop the team.**
* Lead a team of Project Managers, Implementation Specialists, and Programme Managers
* Mentor the team on advanced client management, negotiation, risk mitigation, and how to balance client customisation requests against platform scalability
* Build a culture of product stewardship \- the team should be Lucidya's strongest advocates for what the platform does well, not just executors of client requests


**Be the bridge between clients and the business.**
* Manage expectations on custom development by bridging communication between clients and Engineering and Product teams \- clearly, without overpromising
* Report project health, velocity, and risk to executive leadership in a way that enables fast decisions

data.jd_text:
The Corporate Services Manager oversees the firm's internal operations and support services, ensuring the smooth and efficient running of the organization. This role encompasses managing administrative functions, facilities, IT support, human resources, and compliance, aiming to optimize operational efficiency and support the firm's strategic goals. The Corporate Services Manager acts as a central figure in maintaining an effective operational infrastructure that enables the firm's professionals to focus on delivering high\-quality consulting services to clients.
   

  

**Duties**
* Operational Leadership: Oversee the firm's day\-to\-day operational functions, including administrative services, facilities management, IT support, and human resources, ensuring operational excellence across all areas
* Team Management: Manage the Corporate Services team, setting objectives, evaluating performance, and facilitating professional development to build a cohesive and high performing team
* Policy Development and Compliance: Develop and implement operational policies and procedures that align with the firm's strategic objectives and compliance requirements. Ensure that all operations adhere to legal standards and best practices
* Facilities and Resource Management: Ensure the firm's facilities and resources are managed efficiently, overseeing office space, equipment, and technology infrastructure to support business operations
* Vendor and Contract Management: Manage relationships with vendors and service providers, negotiating contracts and ensuring the delivery of high\-quality services at optimal costs
* Candidate must hold Saudi nationality\*


**Requirements**
**Educational**
 Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, Human Resources, or a related field. A Master's degree in Business Administration or related area is advantageous.
   

  

**Experience**
 At least 5 years of experience in operations management, administrative leadership, or a similar role within a corporate or consulting environment.
   

  

**Training Certification**
 Certifications in Operations Management, Project Management PMP, or Facility Management are beneficial.

**Position\- MEP Project Manager**
**Location\- Riyadh\- Saudi Arabia**
**Role:**
 The Project Manager is responsible for delivering and leading the assigned project. This includes review of handover documentation from Tender Team, Project Kick\-off, planning, executing, controlling, monitoring and closing out the project, while managing risks, opportunities, commercial management, timelines, resources and the entire scope of the project. The Project Manager is required to act as the primary focal point of contact between JEG Senior Management, the Client, Consultants and the JEG Project Delivery Team ensuring the desired project objectives are delivered meeting all set project objectives
   

  

**Project Roles And Responsibilities**
* Direct line of report Regional Projects Director
* Critique tender documentation / Pre\-Construction project handover documentation, identify project risks and opportunities with Project Leads
* Manages the expectations of project leadership and stakeholders throughout the project.
* Ensures all departments are complying with all standard JEG SOP’s
* Responsible for managing the execution of all project milestones/deliverables. Establish and monitor program and project controls KPI's.
* Acts as a primary day to day liaison to the client project leadership teams and project execution partners.
* Identifies and resolve disputes quickly and reasonably with Project Stakeholders.
* Develops and maintains a comprehensive project plan, in keeping with the size and complexity as mutually agreed upon by the JEG organization SOP and the Project Director.
* Provides leadership and actively manages the project team resources within the confines of the project, identifying any deficiencies to the Project Director.
* Ensure that the health and safety requirements are provided in coordination with HSE Manager and that they comply with JEG HSE requirements and authorities’ regulations. Ensure regular audits are carried out for EHS compliance and any remedial actions are implemented in coordination with the HSE Manager.
* Manages detailed project planning documentation in conjunction with the Project Controls Engineer (Execution Plans, Risk Mgmt. Log, Status Reports, Schedule Reports, Progress Reports), these reports shall be prepared in accordance with Regional JEG Standardized Reporting Template formats.
* Manages detailed Project Budget Reports detailing Preliminaries, Procurement, indirect and direct staff, Subcontractors and overheads / Cost forecasts in conjunction with the QS / Project Controls Engineer with consultation of Project Director and Commercial Director
* Actively manages, communicates and mitigates project risks and issues and escalates when necessary


**Experience \& Qualifications**
* Time served apprenticeship an advantage.
* Minimum 10 years work experience on construction projects / Minimum 3 years as a Project Manager
* Qualifications commensurate with position:
* Role applicable degree from a reputed university / Trade Qualifications NVQ, etc.
* Experience in Data Centre Projects.
* Competent in the use of PC applications (Microsoft Office suit or equivalent)
* MEP background

 Sika is embarking on the construction of a new plant and the consolidation of its existing sites in Qatar. We are seeking a highly skilled
 **Project Manager** 
 to lead, coordinate, and oversee the full cycle of these strategic projects. The role requires strong leadership, technical knowledge of industrial construction, and proven project management experience to ensure timely, cost\-efficient, and safe delivery in line with Sika’s global standards.
   

  





**Key Responsibilities**



* **Project Leadership \& Planning** 
	+ Lead the planning, design, and execution of the new plant construction and site consolidation projects.
	+ Develop and manage detailed project timelines, budgets, and resource plans.
	+ Coordinate with internal stakeholders (local, regional, and global teams) and external partners (consultants, contractors, suppliers).
* **Execution \& Supervision** 
	+ Oversee construction activities, ensuring compliance with design specifications, Sika standards, local regulations, and HSE requirements.
	+ Conduct regular site inspections and progress reviews, addressing deviations, risks, and bottlenecks.
	+ Manage contractors and subcontractors, ensuring quality, cost, and schedule commitments are met.
* **Stakeholder Management** 
	+ Act as the main point of contact for project stakeholders, including authorities, consultants, and vendors.
	+ Report regularly on progress, risks, and financials to senior management.
	+ Ensure alignment of project objectives with business needs and operational requirements.
* **Governance, Compliance \& Safety** 
	+ Ensure all construction and consolidation activities follow Qatar’s regulatory requirements, Sika’s internal standards, and best practices.
	+ Drive a strong culture of safety and sustainability throughout project execution.


**Qualifications**

**Qualifications \& Experience**



* Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or related field.
* Minimum 5 years of proven experience managing industrial construction projects, preferably in chemical, building materials, or manufacturing industries.
* Strong knowledge of project management methodologies (PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent certification is an asset).
* Demonstrated ability to manage multi\-million\-dollar projects within scope, budget, and timelines.
* Experience working in GCC/Qatar projects with knowledge of local regulations, standards, and permitting processes.
* Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong command of English; Arabic is an advantage.


**Additional Information**

**Key Competencies**



* Strategic thinker with hands\-on execution capability.
* Strong negotiation and contractor management skills.
* Problem solver with risk management capabilities.
* Resilient, results\-driven, and able to thrive in a fast\-paced environment.



 We offer competitive salaries, aligned with local market benchmarks and the specific scope and responsibilities of each role. Compensation is determined based skills relevant to the position, education and/or training. We are committed to fair and equitable pay practices in accordance with applicable laws and regulations.

data.jd_text:
Imagine a piloted air taxi that takes off vertically, then quietly carries you and your fellow passengers over the congested city streets below, enabling you to spend more time with the people and places that matter most. At Joby, we've been working to make that dream a reality since 2009 and we're now in the final stages of certifying our aircraft with the FAA. With plans to launch our aircraft in the US and Dubai, we're now scaling manufacturing and preparing for the launch of our commercial service.
   

  

**Overview**
 As the leader for Joby’s future presence in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, you will build the business from the ground up, establishing the foundational relationships, operating model, and multi\-year strategy needed to launch a safe, compliant, and scalable service. Partnering closely with Joby’s senior leadership and U.S. headquarters teams, you will drive government and municipal engagement, develop strategic partnerships (including JVs and M\&A), and lead end\-to\-end deal execution. You will serve as Joby’s local face, elevating brand awareness, representing the company with stakeholders and media, translating market insights into action, and providing clear performance updates to executive leadership and the board.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Build the Business Foundation: Lay the foundation for the future KSA market for Joby
* Policy and Partnerships: In partnership with Joby’s senior leadership team, identify, build, and maintain strong relationships with local government entities, municipalities, and strategic partners to build trust and credibility, thereby strengthening Joby’s position in the KSA
* Corporate and Business Development: Source, evaluate, and execute M\&A, joint ventures, and strategic partnerships. Lead cross\-functional due diligence and manage deal execution from start to finish in the KSA
* Drive Strategic Execution: Implement a vision and multi\-year business strategy that balances execution across aircraft sales, business development, corporate development, government relations, OEM, manufacturing, and operations
* Develop Market Awareness: stay apprised of local trends, business opportunities, infrastructure opportunities, consumer mobility preferences, etc., within the KSA, and build action plans to exploit opportunities for Joby
* Collaborate with US Team: Work cross\-functionally with Joby’s US\-based headquarters functions to support global strategic initiatives and to support partner(s) in launching a successful, safe, and compliant service in the KSA
* Establish the Joby Brand Locally: Gather market insights and work closely with Joby’s marketing, business development, and communications teams to build a highly recognizable brand within the KSA
* Be the Local Face of Joby: Serve as the primary local representative of Joby at KSA events and with local press to drive awareness and early adoption
* Report to Joby Leadership: Provide regular updates on business performance and identify areas requiring support from the executive team and board of director s


**Required**
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience
* 10\+ years of experience in M\&A, Corporate Development, Program Management, Business Development, Government Relations, and/or Strategy
* 10\+ years of leadership experience, with increasing levels of responsibility
* Highly strategic thinker with strong business acumen and structured problem\-solving skills demonstrated through delivery of large complex projects/programs
* Excellent communication and presentation skills; able to influence at all levels,inspire teams, collaborate cross\-functionally, and represent the organization with external stakeholders

* Extensive professional network within the KSA and the Middle East, and proven ability to develop and maintain relationships
* Fluent in English and Arabic, both written and verbal communication
* Able to travel up to 30% of the time, including to the United States

**Desired**

* Experience in the aviation or aerospace industry
* Previously launched and scaled a business or business unit
* Broad business experience in the Middle East
* Experienced in government and military relations and operations

**Joby is an Equal Opportunity Employer**

data.jd_text:
The Director of IT (Operational Technology) will lead the transformation, governance, and standardisation of OT across a large, multi\-site mining and processing organisation. The role will define and implement the OT strategy, enabling a transition towards an Industry 4\.0 operating model driven by automation, data, and advanced control systems.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 



* Develop and implement an OT strategy across multiple mining and processing operations
* Establish OT architecture, standards, and governance frameworks aligned to ISA\-95 and Industry 4\.0 principles
* Assess current OT maturity across business units and define roadmap to achieve target state maturity
* Lead integration of automation technologies including:
+ Base control systems
+ Advanced process control (MPC)
+ AI\-driven predictive control systems

* Define and implement enterprise\-wide OT data architecture, including data governance, storage, and lifecycle management
* Drive standardisation of OT systems across decentralised plant environments
* Partner with plant managers and operational leaders to embed OT improvements at site level
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives focused on process stabilisation and optimisation
* Build confidence and capability across OT teams and business units
* Oversee a multidisciplinary team of 20\+ professionals across OT, data, innovation, and technology enablement
* Collaborate with VP\-level stakeholders across IT, Data \& AI, Innovation, and Technology Enablement



**Key Interfaces** 



* Plant Managers across mining and processing sites
* Business Unit Leaders
* IT and Digital Leadership Team
* Data \& AI and Innovation functions
* Operational Technology and Fleet Management teams



**Candidate Requirements** 



* Extensive experience in mining, metals, or heavy industrial environments
* Strong background in Operational Technology (OT) and industrial automation
* Experience with ISA\-95 frameworks and Industry 4\.0 transformation
* Deep understanding of industrial control systems and predictive technologies
* Experience with mining fleet management systems and operational data environments
* Proven ability to lead large\-scale OT transformation in decentralised organisations
* Strong leadership experience managing cross\-functional technical teams
* Ability to engage and influence senior operational and technical stakeholders



**Transformation Focus** 




 This is a strategic leadership role driving a step\-change in OT maturity (from \~2/5 to \~4\.5/5\), enabling:
 


* Increased automation and operational autonomy
* Data\-driven decision\-making across all operations
* Predictive and AI\-enabled industrial control systems
* Standardised, scalable OT architecture across all sites

+ Design Coordination: Familiarity with InDesign.

* Senior PM Support \& Added Capacity: Provides reliable support to the Senior Project Manager by taking ownership of delegated responsibilities, reducing pressure on senior leadership, and stepping in to manage additional tasks during peak periods.
* Client \& Stakeholder Relationship Building: Builds trusted, professional relationships with clients, consultants, contractors, and internal teams through clear communication and dependable delivery.
* PMO \& Project Controls Capability: Able to undertake all aspects of PMO support, including reporting, governance, programme coordination, document control, action tracking, and maintaining project controls.
* Financial Management \& Forecasting: Competent in managing project financials, including monitoring time charged, tracking spend, reviewing budgets, and maintaining accurate cost forecasts.
* Resilience \& Commitment: Comfortable working in demanding, fast\-paced environments, including longer days or additional hours when required to meet project milestones and business needs.
* Adaptability \& Flexibility: Responds positively to changing priorities, urgent issues, and evolving project requirements while maintaining a high standard of delivery.
* Communication: Exceptional command of written and spoken English. Ability to present complex data in a visually compelling and concise manner. Arabic proficiency is desirable.
* KSA Client Environment Experience: Good understanding of client expectations, business culture, and consultant standards when operating in Saudi Arabia.
* Certification: Active PMP (Project Management Professional) or Chartered Planner (RTPI/AICP/MRICS) status is highly desirable.

**About The Role**
 Role Overview
   

  

 The
 **Senior Account Manager** 
 is responsible for the day\-to\-day on the ground project coordination to help deliver a long\-term large scale digital project.
   

  

 This role will be embedded with the client team and act as a primary on\-the\-ground point of coordination in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The Senior Account Manager will work closely with our client’s internal departments and teams to gather feedback to communicate with the rest of the Journey team. The Senior Account Manager is responsible for delivering large and small scale projects according to brief, timeline and budget alongside developing strong relationships with the client team.
   

  

 Due to the nature of the work, the ideal candidate has experience supporting capital projects within cultural institutions and understands how creative work integrates into longer construction and institutional timelines.
   

  

**The Project**
 This giga\-project is a landmark destination city built around the philosophy of the “Power of Play,” integrating entertainment, sports, and culture at unprecedented scale within a livable urban environment. Spanning a wide range of districts and planned to support 500,000 residents, it brings together world\-class attractions, major global events, and diversified leisure offerings while contributing to broader national transformation ambitions.
   

  

 This Next\-Gen Visualisation programme supports this vision by establishing a scalable digital production ecosystem—including a continuously updatable Unreal Engine “Marketing Twin”—that enables consistent, high\-quality storytelling across multiple stakeholders. This platform integrates asset governance, real\-time workflows, and creative guidelines to ensure the digital representation of the city evolves in parallel with its physical development and can be used reliably by internal and external partners.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 The essential functions include, but are not limited to:
   

  

**Project Co\-ordination \& Delivery**
* Manage day\-to\-day delivery of multiple phases of a large project, ensuring alignment with approved scope, schedule, and budget
* Act as a central coordination point between client teams, internal studio teams, and external partners
* Translate client discussions and decisions into clear actions, timelines, and responsibilities
* Track milestones, dependencies, and approval across all workstreams
* Responsible for project budget of £10m\+
* Develop and maintain project schedules aligned with capital project phases and client milestones
* Proactively identify, assess, and manage risks related to schedule, budget, scope, and coordination


**Client \& Stakeholder Management**
* Liaise directly with client stakeholders to drive discussions to resolution
* Serve as a consistent point of contact for designated projects
* Attend and support client meetings, workshops, and site walks
* Build trusted relationships through clarity, reliability, and proactive communication


**Required**
**Candidate Qualifications \& Skills:**
* Arabic speaking
* 5\+ years experience in an account management role within a creative, cultural, architectural, or production environment
* Experience managing complex and high\-profile projects
* Strong understanding of schedules, budgets, and dependency management
* Experience working alongside or supporting capital projects or long\-term institutional initiatives
* Experience with project management tools / software
* Strong verbal and written communication skills (Arabic and English)
* Organized and efficient
* Experience with Google Suite
* Advanced Microsoft Office Suite
* Willingness to travel


**Desirable**
* Experience working with clients in the museums, cultural institutions, theme park, public\-facing capital projects
* Saudi National
* Familiarity with digital or interactive software development
* PMP or PRINCE2 but not essential


**Contract Type:** 
 Full time, Fixed Term Contract \- 6 months
   

  

**Location:** 
 this role is based in Riyadh, working remotely with the wider Journey Studios
   

  

 Salary Pay Range
   

  

 ر.س330,000 \- ر.س405,000 SAR
   

  

**About Journey**
 The Multidimensional Experience Agency
   

  

 Journey is a global design and innovation agency shaping the future through multidimensional experiences (MDX) that connect people, brands, and culture.
   

  

 Our layered MDX approach crafts story\-driven, sensory\-rich engagement across physical, immersive, digital, and virtual spaces—fuelled by creative and technological innovation.
   

  

 Born from a legacy of pioneering studios, Journey blends strategic thinking with deep creative expertise to deliver solutions across industries.
   

  

 Journey’s MDX approach fuels growth and forges lasting value for audiences and partners, by creating cultural connections that resonate with impact.
   

  

 Start your journey here www.journey.world

**Dynamic and experienced Project Manager** 
 to oversee the implementation of innovative smart city services. This role is critical in coordinating and managing Qiddiya's smart city delivery projects, integrating advanced technology with infrastructure to create efficient and sustainable urban environments.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is not expected to be deeply technical but should possess a strong understanding of the Master System Integrator (MSI) lifecycle, including design\-build\-operate and design\-build\-transfer models, as well as expertise in artefact delivery and review processes.
   

  

****Focus****
**Digital Foundation:** 
 Ensuring the city's physical\-to\-digital infrastructure (networks, IoT, data centers) is resilient, compliant, and cost\-efficient.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead the planning and execution of smart city service projects across Qiddiya districts, ensuring delivery is on time, within scope, and within budget.
* Oversee complex ICT deployments, including city\-wide 5G/6G integration, IoT sensor networks, and core infrastructure systems.
* Manage end\-to\-end commissioning and formal handover of ICT systems, ensuring a seamless transition from build phase to Operations \& Maintenance (O\&M) with minimal to zero disruption.
* Represent City Operations IT within Asset Infrastructure Design \& Delivery and Technical Design Working Groups to ensure ICT requirements are embedded in physical development.
* Navigate and enforce technical Stage\-Gate processes, ensuring full compliance of architecture, security, and deployment approvals.
* Coordinate with cross\-functional stakeholders (engineering, urban planning, contractors) to ensure seamless ICT integration into the built environment.
* Manage the Master System Integrator (MSI) lifecycle, overseeing design\-build\-operate\-transfer (DBOT) phases for critical smart city services.
* Ensure rigorous quality control across all deliverables, leading structured artefact review processes aligned with international standards.
* Collaborate with QTECH and relevant business units to mitigate risks related to system integration and large\-scale deployments.
* Provide regular project updates and performance reports to executive leadership and the City Operations IT PMO.
* Manage complexities of large\-scale urban programs, including procurement/RFP cycles, regulatory compliance, and on\-site coordination.
* Maintain comprehensive project documentation, including accurate "as\-built" records and progress tracking for all ICT infrastructure


**Requirements**
* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Management, or a related field.
* Minimum of 10 years' experience as a Programme/Project Manager, preferably within smart city or large\-scale infrastructure projects.
* Strong understanding of the Master System Integrator (MSI) lifecycle, including design\-build\-operate and design\-build\-transfer models.
* Proven experience in managing the delivery and review of project artefacts.
* Familiarity with systems integration and smart service deployment in urban environments.
* Strong leadership, communication, and organisational skills.
* Demonstrated ability to work cross\-functionally with diverse teams and stakeholders.
* Strategic thinker with a strong analytical mindset.
* Solid understanding of vendor management and SLA frameworks.
* Professional certifications such as MSP, P3O, and MoP are preferred.
* Proficiency in MS Project and Primavera P6


****Additional Requirements****
* PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent project management certification.
* Experience in system verification, validation, and commissioning processes.
* Strong understanding of critical infrastructure security standards.
* Proficiency in Aconex or similar document management systems

data.raw_snippet:

data.jd_text:
**ABOUT US** 



* Yomn (wwwyomn.sa) is a Saudi consultancy dedicated to driving social impact, economic development, and innovation. Our ultimate goal is improving people’s lives \- including but not limited to health, climate change, education, women empowerment, sustainable tourism, arts \& culture, etc.
* With 2 offices located in Lebanon and Saudi Arabia, we engage with prestigious government agencies, corporations, NGOs, and non\-profit organizations.



  





**WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR** 
 ?
 


* We are looking for a senior web product and delivery professional who can lead the development of a high\-quality institutional website for a major Saudi client.
* This person will act as the bridge between the client, internal leadership, designers, developers, content teams, and any external technical vendors.
* The ideal candidate understands website strategy, CMS platforms, UX, content operations, SEO migration, project management, quality assurance, and client communication.
* They do not need to be the main developer, but they must be technically strong enough to make informed platform decisions, challenge developers, manage risks, and ensure the final website is sustainable for the client’s team after launch.



  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 




**1\. Client Requirements, Scope Definition \& Solution Architecture — 25%** 



* Lead discovery sessions to clarify technical, operational, content, and governance requirements.
* Translate client needs into a clear scope, technical specification, and delivery plan.
* Recommend the most suitable platform approach, such as WordPress, Drupal or custom CMS.
* Define requirements for multilingual content, permissions, approval workflows, SEO migration, security, and support.



**2\. Project Management \& Delivery Governance — 25%** 



* Own the project plan, timeline, milestones, risks, dependencies, and deliverables.
* Coordinate between internal teams, developers, designers, content teams, and client stakeholders.
* Set up and manage project tools such as Jira, Asana, ClickUp, or similar.
* Track progress, manage change requests, and prepare regular status updates.



**3\. UX, CMS Usability \& Content Operations — 20%** 



* Ensure the CMS is easy for non\-technical users to manage in Arabic and English.
* Define page templates, content structures, navigation, and user journeys.
* Supervise content migration from the old website to the new website.
* Ensure training materials and user manuals are practical and clear.



**4\. Quality Assurance, SEO, Security \& Launch Readiness — 20%** 



* Lead QA across functionality, usability, responsiveness, accessibility, and browser compatibility.
* Ensure proper SEO migration, including URL mapping, metadata, redirects, and sitemap.
* Coordinate performance, analytics, security, hosting, and deployment checks.



**5\. Training, Handover \& Post\-Launch Support — 10%** 



* Plan and deliver training sessions for the client’s team.
* Ensure user manuals, admin guides, and governance guidelines are delivered.
* Support the client during the post\-launch stabilization period.



  





**REQUIREMENTS** 



* 10\+ years of experience in website product management, digital project management, solution architecture, or web delivery.
* Strong understanding of CMS platforms such as WordPress, Drupal, Strapi, Contentful, Sanity, or similar.
* Experience managing institutional, government, semi\-government, chamber, association, or large corporate websites is strongly preferred.
* Strong understanding of SEO migration, redirects, analytics, CMS governance, accessibility, performance, and security basics.
* Strong client\-facing communication skills in Arabic and English.
* Willingness to travel to Makkah on a monthly basis



  





**WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU?** 



* Competitive package
* Be part of and set the direction of a high\-growth startup
* Opportunity to work on projects that improve people's lives
* Exposure to international clients and prestigious government ministries
* Hybrid work (50\-50%)

data.jd_text:
SYSTRA is one of the world's leading engineering and consultancy groups specialising in public transport and sustainable mobility. With over 10,300 employees, SYSTRA's mission is to design safe and sustainable transport solutions to bring people together, develop social inclusion and facilitate access to employment, education and leisure throughout the world.
   

  

 For 65 years, the Group has been working alongside cities and regions to contribute to their development by creating, improving and modernising their infrastructure and transport systems, throughout the life cycle of their projects. SYSTRA is involved from the earliest stages of design through to the testing, deployment and maintenance phases. The company provides all its services in over 80 countries worldwide and generates 74% of its turnover internationally. With its new services, SYSTRA supports its clients and partners in their digital, ecological and energy transition, in order to invent the mobility of tomorrow.
   

  

 Context
   

  

***This requirement is for a bid opportunity only at this stage. Any engagement will be subject to successful project award and final client approval.***
 The Project Delivery Manager will be responsible for leading the successful delivery of the railway program, with a strong focus on construction execution, package coordination, site performance, and overall delivery outcomes. The role requires a highly capable leader with deep expertise in managing large\-scale railway and infrastructure construction works, coordinating multidisciplinary teams, resolving interfaces, and ensuring delivery in line with schedule, budget, quality, and safety objectives.
   

  

 Missions/Main Duties
   

  

* Lead and manage the overall construction delivery of the railway program across multiple project packages, work fronts, or contractor interfaces.
* Drive site execution strategies to ensure safe, efficient, and timely delivery of all construction activities.
* Oversee and coordinate construction teams, subcontractors, package managers, and support functions to achieve program milestones.
* Ensure strong integration between engineering, procurement, construction, commercial, planning, contracts, and project controls functions.
* Monitor construction progress and productivity, and implement recovery plans where required to address delays or performance gaps.
* Manage site\-related risks, constructability issues, sequencing constraints, logistics challenges, and interface coordination across the program.
* Lead delivery reviews, construction progress meetings, and reporting processes to ensure transparency and timely decision\-making.
* Ensure construction activities are executed in compliance with project specifications, contractual requirements, quality standards, and HSE regulations.
* Support the development of construction methodologies, phasing plans, mobilization strategies, and execution plans during bid and post\-award stages.
* Act as a key point of contact for internal stakeholders, contractors, consultants, and the client on all matters related to delivery and construction performance.
* Promote a strong site culture focused on safety, quality, productivity, accountability, and delivery excellence.
* Support testing, commissioning readiness, and handover planning in coordination with relevant teams, where required.


 Profile/Skills
   

  

* The successful candidate will be a hands\-on, delivery\-focused leader with strong construction execution capability and a proven ability to manage complex railway works in live and challenging environments. They should be capable of driving site performance, managing contractors and interfaces, and ensuring coordinated delivery across multiple packages while maintaining the highest standards of safety, quality, and operational excellence.
* Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, or a related discipline. A master’s degree is an advantage.
* Minimum 20 years of total experience in major infrastructure and construction projects.
* Strong experience in railway projects is essential.
* Proven project and construction delivery experience in leading major infrastructure, rail, or transportation projects from execution through completion.
* Strong background in construction management, site delivery, contractor coordination, and field execution.
* Prior experience in a Program Delivery Manager, Construction Delivery Manager, Senior Project Manager, or similar senior delivery role.
* Gulf experience preferred.
* Strong understanding of construction sequencing, site logistics, temporary works, constructability, project controls, and commercial impacts on delivery.
* Demonstrated ability to manage complex construction interfaces and multidisciplinary teams in large project environments.
* Excellent leadership, stakeholder management, communication, and problem\-solving skills.
* Strong knowledge of HSE, quality, risk, compliance, and construction best practices in major infrastructure projects.


 Systra is an equal opportunities company; this position is open to all applicants.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience producing progress reports, lookahead plans, tracking delays, and implementing recovery actions on construction projects
* Experience in the Riyadh or Saudi market
* Ability to start within 30 days (notice period ≤30 days)


**Benefits**
* Health insurance coverage (medical, dental, vision)
* Paid annual leave and public holidays
* On\-site support and resources for project management
* Opportunities for advancement within a leading Saudi investment group
