data.jd_text:
1\. About Front End
   

  

 Front End Limited Company is a Saudi\-headquartered industrial solutions group, named
 **"Innovator of the Year" at the Oil \& Gas Middle East 2025 Awards** 
 and 100% aligned with Saudi Vision 2030, Front End operates across eight integrated verticals:
   

  

* Energy — EPC \& project delivery, valves, actuators \& testing, subsurface
* Industrial Facilities — EPC \& turnkey services, valves \& safety systems, facility O\&M
* Geoscience — subsurface \& seismic, site \& geotechnical studies, airborne \& UAV surveys
* Space — satellite data \& analytics, monitoring \& insights, weather \& resilience
* Offshore — construction \& installation, surveying \& monitoring, drilling \& decommissioning
* Artificial Intelligence — strategy \& transformation, cloud \& modernization, AI operations
* Autonomy \& Mobility — UAV \& drone operations, marine \& subsea systems, air mobility
* Mining — exploration \& surveying, offshore mining, compliance \& sustainability


**This role sits within Front End's Environmental \& Sustainability initiatives** 
 , an extension of the Industrial Facilities vertical, focused on delivering circular\-economy and decarbonisation infrastructure for the Kingdom. While the successful candidate will be dedicated to the pyrolysis biochar project, they will be part of a multidisciplinary organisation that blends industrial execution capability with advanced technology, geoscience, and AI — giving the project access to capabilities that few peer organisations can match.
   

  

 2\. Role Purpose
   

  

 The Project Manager will lead the end\-to\-end delivery of the
 **BST\-06 MAX pyrolysis biochar plant** 
 at the SBF site in Riyadh — a flagship environmental and sustainability initiative converting organic waste streams into biochar and renewable syngas in support of KSA Vision 2030 circular\-economy and net\-zero targets.
   

  

 Reporting to the Front End Projects Director, the Project Manager is accountable for the safe, on\-time, on\-budget, and quality\-compliant execution of the project from mobilisation through commissioning and operational handover (target commissioning:
 **June 2026** 
 ). The role serves as the single point of accountability between Front End, the client (SBF), the equipment supplier (Beston Group), regulatory authorities, and all subcontractors.
   

  

 3\. Project Context
   

  

 The project comprises the design, civil construction, installation, commissioning, and operational handover of a pyrolysis biochar production unit. The plant will:
   

  

* Divert organic and agricultural residues from landfill
* Produce biochar for soil regeneration and carbon sequestration
* Generate renewable syngas as a process energy source
* Operate within KSA municipal environmental regulations and SBF site\-specific HSE standards


 The project also serves as a reference deployment that will inform Front End's broader sustainability portfolio across the Industrial Facilities and Mining verticals.
   

  

 4\. Scope of Responsibility — Project Lifecycle
   

  

 The Project Manager owns delivery across the full project lifecycle, structured per PMI/PMBOK standards:
   

  

**Phase 1 — Initiation \& Site Preparation (Civil Works)**
 Lead site mobilisation, stakeholder onboarding, and baseline confirmation. Direct all ground preparation activities — site clearing, levelling, compaction, drainage — and oversee foundation design review, concrete slab and equipment plinth construction, and utility trenching for power, water, and drainage tie\-ins.
   

  

**Phase 2 — Planning \& Equipment Receipt / Installation**
 Manage logistics of equipment arrival from Jeddah port (customs clearance, transport, laydown). Direct crane operations, heavy lifting, mechanical assembly, and anchoring of the BST\-06 MAX carboniser, feed systems, syngas outlet components, and ancillary equipment in line with Beston Group drawings and specifications.
   

  

**Phase 3 — Execution \& Commissioning Support**
 Coordinate on\-site Factory Acceptance Test (FAT) replication and operational commissioning with the Beston Group team. Verify civil and structural compliance with design intent and HSE requirements. Manage punch lists and close out civil and mechanical snags.
   

  

**Phase 4 — Monitoring, Control \& Operational Handover**
 Oversee initial operations to confirm the plant performs safely within its approved footprint. Manage infrastructure modifications, access road maintenance, containment areas, and ongoing HSE coordination with SBF authorities. Lead formal handover to the operations team with full documentation.
   

  

**Phase 5 — Project Closeout**
 Complete as\-built documentation, lessons\-learned register, financial reconciliation, and contractual closeout with the client and supplier.
   

  

 5\. Key Responsibilities (PMBOK Knowledge Areas)
   

  

**Integration \& Scope Management**
* Develop and maintain the Project Management Plan, Scope Statement, and Work Breakdown Structure (WBS)
* Manage change control through a formal change request and approval process
* Serve as the primary interface between Front End, SBF, Beston Group, and regulatory authorities


**Schedule Management**
* Develop and maintain the master construction programme (MS Project or Primavera P6\) aligned with the June 2026 commissioning target
* Track critical\-path activities, manage float, and report schedule variance weekly


**Cost Management**
* Manage the project budget; track committed vs. actual cost
* Approve subcontractor invoices and variation orders within delegated authority
* Report cost performance (CPI/SPI) to the Project Director monthly


**Quality Management**
* Implement Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs) for civil, structural, and mechanical works
* Ensure compliance with KSA building codes, SASO standards, Beston Group specifications, and ISO 9001 quality principles
* Conduct daily site inspections; maintain photographic records of all construction milestones


**Resource Management**
* Lead and direct subcontractors engaged in earthworks, concrete, steelwork, mechanical, and utilities installation
* Coordinate temporary site services: site office, welfare, security fencing, material storage


**Communications Management**
* Produce weekly progress reports, monthly stakeholder dashboards, and written daily site logs
* Chair weekly project coordination meetings and monthly steering committee reviews


**Risk Management**
* Maintain the Project Risk \& Issues Register; escalate geotechnical, structural, regulatory, or schedule risks promptly
* Develop mitigation plans for high\-priority risks; review register weekly


**Procurement \& Contract Management**
* Manage subcontractor contracts, scope, and performance
* Coordinate with supplier (Beston Group) on warranty, spares, and technical support obligations


**Stakeholder Management**
* Liaise with Saudi authorities for site permits, environmental operating licences, and industrial area compliance
* Coordinate with SBF facilities management on power supply, access routes, water/drainage tie\-ins, and waste management
* Manage client relationships and expectations throughout the lifecycle


**HSE \& Environmental Compliance**
* Ensure all site activities comply with KSA municipal environmental regulations and SBF site\-specific HSE requirements
* Oversee lifting plans, toolbox talks, permit\-to\-work systems, and incident reporting
* Champion sustainability outcomes consistent with the project's environmental mission


 6\. Key Performance Indicators
   

  

* Commissioning achieved by June 2026 (schedule adherence)
* Project delivered within approved budget (CPI 1\.0\)
* Zero Lost\-Time Incidents (LTI) and full HSE compliance
* All regulatory permits and operating licences secured prior to commissioning
* Quality close\-out: all punch\-list items resolved before handover
* Successful FAT replication and operational handover acceptance by client


 7\. Required Qualifications \& Experience
   

  

**Education**
* Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering, or Construction/Project Management from an accredited university
* Master's degree in Project Management, Engineering Management, or Sustainability is a plus


**Certifications (Required)**
* PMP (Project Management Professional) or equivalent (PRINCE2 Practitioner, IPMA Level B/C)
* Valid Saudi Council of Engineers (SCE) registration or eligibility to obtain
* NEBOSH International General Certificate or equivalent HSE qualification


**Experience**
* Minimum 7 years in site\-based project delivery, with at least 3 years in an industrial or process plant environment
* Demonstrable track record managing heavy equipment foundations, industrial slab construction, and utility infrastructure in KSA or the wider GCC
* Proven experience leading multidisciplinary teams (civil, mechanical, electrical, HSE)


**Technical Skills**
* Proficient in reading structural, mechanical, and P\&ID drawings
* Competent in AutoCAD or equivalent CAD software
* Proficient in MS Project, Primavera P6, or equivalent scheduling tools
* Familiar with KSA building codes, SASO standards, and municipal environmental permitting


**Language**
* Professional working proficiency in English (required); Arabic strongly preferred


 8\. Preferred / Desirable Experience
   

  

* Prior delivery of waste\-to\-resource, biochar, pyrolysis, gasification, or industrial thermal processing plants
* Experience in environmental and sustainability capital projects (circular economy, carbon reduction, ESG\-aligned)
* Heavy\-lift and crane operations management — lifting plan review, toolbox talks
* Vision 2030 giga\-project experience (SBF, NEOM, Diriyah, Red Sea, or equivalent)
* Experience with environmental operating permit applications in KSA industrial zones
* Familiarity with carbon credit/sequestration verification frameworks (Verra, Gold Standard)
* Working knowledge of ISO 14001 (Environmental Management) and ISO 45001 (OH\&S)
* Exposure to adjacent Front End verticals (energy, industrial facilities, geoscience, mining) is advantageous given potential cross\-project collaboration


 9\. Core Competencies
   

  

* Leadership \& decision\-making under pressure
* Stakeholder management across multicultural and multi\-organisational teams
* Problem\-solving and conflict resolution
* Commercial and contractual awareness
* Commitment to safety and environmental stewardship
* Strong written and verbal communication


 10\. Authorities
   

  

* Approve site\-level technical decisions within the scope of the approved design
* Approve subcontractor work and variations within delegated financial authority
* Stop\-work authority on any HSE or quality non\-conformance
* Escalate scope, schedule, cost, or risk exceptions to the Project Director


 11\. Why Join Front End
   

  

* Be part of a Vision 2030–aligned organisation recognised as Innovator of the Year at the Oil \& Gas Middle East 2025 Awards
* Lead a flagship environmental and sustainability project with regional visibility
* Work alongside teams across energy, industrial facilities, geoscience, space, offshore, AI, autonomy \& mobility, and mining
* Build a track record on a reference project that will shape Front End's broader sustainability portfolio

**Job Description**

 We are seeking a detail\-oriented and analytical QA/QC Engineer (Saudi National) to join our site supervision team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. As a key member of the quality assurance team, you will be responsible for ensuring that all construction activities comply with project specifications, quality standards, and applicable codes.
   

  





**Key Responsibilities:**



* Implement and monitor Project Quality Plans, procedures, specifications, and Inspection \& Test Plans (ITPs) for all construction activities
* Develop and maintain the Quality Management System (QMS), including procedures, guidelines, forms, data collection tools, reporting systems, and checklists to enhance performance and ensure compliance
* Plan, execute, and participate in internal and external quality audits, including supplier audits, and ensure implementation of corrective and preventive actions
* Monitor and assess project risks throughout the lifecycle, proactively addressing potential issues to prevent scope and quality deviations
* Supervise on\-site and off\-site construction activities, including mock\-ups, samples, and manufacturing processes (FAT/SAT)
* Lead change management initiatives for product quality improvements, ensuring effective implementation of new standards and processes
* Provide day\-to\-day support and guidance to project management teams and contractors on quality requirements and QMS implementation
* Lead regular quality surveillance and coordination meetings to drive continuous improvement
* Monitor and oversee contractors’ QMS implementation during project execution
* Conduct inspections and testing of construction activities, including excavation, formwork, reinforcement, concreting, structural works, masonry, and finishing
* Review and verify material test reports, mix designs, and calibration certificates
* Ensure all materials delivered to the site comply with approved material submittals and relevant standards
* Coordinate with clients and consultants on inspection requests and quality\-related matters
* Maintain and update quality control records, including inspection reports, test results, Site Observation Reports (SORs), and Non\-Conformance Reports (NCRs)
* Manage NCRs, conduct root cause analysis, and implement preventive actions using methodologies such as Six Sigma or Lean principles
* Ensure construction practices comply with approved drawings, specifications, and method statements
* Assist in the review and approval of QA/QC documentation
* Ensure all activities comply with safety and environmental requirements
* Support continuous improvement initiatives and provide feedback for process optimization
* Analyze quality data to identify systemic issues and report on KPIs, PQIs, and dashboards
* Lead site walkthroughs, raise punch list items, and review handover documentation packages
* Prepare and submit daily, weekly, and monthly reports to the Quality Manager, Program Director, and Client representatives


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering
* Certification in ISO 9001:2015 (Quality Management Systems) and ISO 19011:2018 (Audit Management)
* Licensed Civil Engineer (preferred)
* Minimum of 10 years of relevant experience
* Proficiency in reading and interpreting technical drawings and specifications
* Strong documentation and organizational skills
* Excellent communication and coordination abilities
* Experience with Quality Management Systems (QMS)
* Expertise in non\-conformance reporting and implementing corrective actions
* Knowledge of construction materials testing methods
* Analytical mindset with strong attention to detail
* Ability to make sound and timely quality\-related decisions
* Collaborative approach to working with project teams and stakeholders

 Context

 Profile/Skills

* Minimum 25 years of total experience in large\-scale infrastructure and construction projects.
* Strong experience in railway projects is essential.
* Proven project delivery experience in leading major infrastructure or railway projects from initiation to completion.
* Prior experience in a Project Director or similarly senior leadership role.
* Gulf experience preferred.
* Strong knowledge of project management principles, contract administration, commercial management, and project controls.
* Demonstrated ability to lead large, multicultural, and multidisciplinary teams.

The Data Cleansing Program Director leads the Government\-Wide data cleansing program — driving large\-scale data quality uplift across multiple government entities. You will own the cleansing strategy, orchestrate a multi\-vendor delivery model, oversee enterprise data modelling, and ensure that cleansed datasets are published into the Government\-Wide catalogue and sharing platforms — sustainably, with strong governance, ongoing monitoring, and continuous improvement.
   

  

* Define and lead the Government\-Wide data cleansing strategy aligned with data quality standards, policies, and government priorities
* Establish a structured framework to prioritize critical datasets and drive phased execution across entities
* Standardize, automate, and scale the end\-to\-end data cleansing lifecycle — leveraging advanced tools and AI\-driven solutions; govern reusable accelerators
* Establish and oversee a multi\-vendor delivery model — coordinated execution, performance management, and scalability across entities
* Oversee large\-scale data quality improvement initiatives aligned to defined quality dimensions, rules, and thresholds
* Oversee development of entities' enterprise data models — aligned with Government\-Wide data standards, central information models, and interoperability requirements
* Ensure creation, standardization, and publication of cleansed datasets into the Government\-Wide data catalogue and sharing platforms — enabling accessibility and reuse
* Oversee development of data quality dashboards to track KPIs and cleansing progress
* Establish and lead program governance bodies — driving timely, quality delivery, issue resolution, and stakeholder alignment
* Establish and govern sustainable data quality and cleansing frameworks for long\-term maintenance and continuous improvement
* Provide regular reporting to senior leadership on program progress, risks, and impact on data maturity and value realization


**Requirements**
* Bachelor's or Master's in Data Management, IT, Engineering, or related field
* 20\+ years in data management, data quality, or large\-scale transformation programs (preferably with exposure in Europe or North America)
* Proven track record leading enterprise\-wide or national data cleansing / data quality initiatives, including multi\-vendor delivery models
* Strong expertise in data quality frameworks, profiling, and remediation techniques
* Familiarity with modern data platforms — Informatica, Azure, Databricks, Snowflake, or similar
* Demonstrated experience managing large vendor ecosystems and complex multi\-stakeholder programs
* Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills at senior government or enterprise level
* Excellent English communication; Arabic a plus

 Core to Bechtel is our Vision, Values and Commitments . They are what we believe, what customers can expect, and how we deliver. Learn more about our extraordinary teams building inspiring projects in our Impact Report .
   

  

**Project Overview**
 Bechtel has been involved over the last 80 years in some of the world’s busiest and most complex airport projects, including Greenfield and Brownfield developments. In the GCC, we have held significant roles on King Khalid, King Fahad, Dubai, Hamad, and Muscat international airports. Saudi Arabian Bechtel Company has been appointed to provide project management consultancy services (including technical, commercial, and construction management) for the development of a state of the art international airport in the city of Riyadh, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
   

  

 King Salman International Airport will have a capacity of up to 120 million travelers by 2030 and 185 million travelers by 2050, and the capacity to process up to 3\.5 million tons of cargo by 2050\.
   

  

 Bechtel will provide PMC services for three new terminals; Terminal 6 is a new build ‘low cost carrier’ – hyper efficient terminal with gross floor area of ≈450,000m2, capacity of 20mppa; Iconic Terminal is a new build ‘new concept’ terminal with gross floor area of ≈ 1M m2, capacity of 40 to 45 mppa, and Private Aviation Terminal and hangars for VIPs and business jet passengers.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 In this role of the Program Quality Lead, you will be reporting to the Program Quality Director and leading the program quality team. You will support in reviewing the contractors’ QMS related plans, ITPs, quality procedures and templates based on the project scope of work. You will review and determine applicable quality requirements, report new or revised regulatory requirements, will be leading / participating in quality audits that will be conducted on contractors / suppliers and internal as well, monitor non\-conforming conditions, and determine the sufficiency of corrective actions. Interfaces with contractors and suppliers on quality related items. Your recommendations will assist in the resolution of complex issues and mitigate performance risk.
   

  

**Major Responsibilities**
* Oversee the implementation of quality programs on\-site.
* Provides direction and assigns work to senior quality specialists and others who assist on specific assignments.
* Exercises Stop\-Work Authority and provides independent reporting to Senior Management to ensure impartiality of the Quality function.
* Review and develop quality documentation, including ITPs, method statements, test reports, and procedures.
* Reviews and approves the contractor’s QA/QC personnel.
* Ensures that the contractor has a robust QMS and monitors its effectiveness.
* Conducts regular internal and external audits and surveillances to assess compliance and identify areas for improvement in quality processes.
* Prepares and submits quality performance reports and nonconformance reports (NCRs), follows up on implementation of rectification and corrective actions, and updates related statistics.
* Leads investigations into the root causes of non\-compliances and oversees implementation of necessary corrective and preventive actions.
* Identifies, records, and reports deviations or faults in construction, materials, or procedures, ensuring prompt corrective measures are implemented.
* Coordinates with the client quality management team and contractors to maintain compliance with project and regulatory requirements.
* Maintains contact with designated customer quality personnel to provide status updates, manage relationships, and execute applicable actions.
* Attends regular quality meetings with client and contractors to review quality performance, resolve issues, and update action plans and QA/QC activities.
* Compiles detailed QA/QC reports for the Quality Director, highlighting progress, quality concerns, and remedial actions taken.
* Supports deployment of the Quality Absolutes and other tools and processes to meet the project quality training program.
* Verifies existing Best Practices (BP) and LL implementation and documents new BPs/LLs in Ideagen and EDMS.
* Lead the quality team and provide direction, guidance, and support to the Quality Specialists to ensure effective implementation of quality requirements and project objectives.


**Education And Experience Requirements**
* Requires bachelor’s degree in civil engineering (or international equivalent) and 8 \-10 years of relevant experience in Quality Management or 12\-14 years of relevant work experience
* Minimum of (5\) years’ experience directly relating to Quality Assurance / Control in relevant scope of work (e.g. airport construction projects / large scale projects).


**Required Knowledge And Skills**
* Technical knowledge in the application of engineering, environmental, procurement, construction, testing, and commissioning practices sufficient to understand relevant project requirements and regulatory requirements.
* Advanced knowledge of the quality principles and their application to engineering, environmental, procurement, construction, testing, operations, and commissioning.
* Demonstrated expertise in implementing ISO 9001\-based quality management systems, including hands\-on experience with contractor’s quality plans, ITPs, and or Quality Control Plans (QCPs).
* Knowledge of corrective action system application to eliminate nonconforming conditions.
* Knowledge of regulatory requirements and their impact on the quality program.
* Proficiency in oral and written communication in English language.
* Proficiency in the use of relevant computer and reporting applications, including but not limited to BIM 360, Power BI, Microsoft Office programs, and other related tools.
* Knowledge of Bechtel’s administrative practices (preferred).
* A recognized degree and/or specialized courses in engineering, quality, or a specialized discipline.
* ISO 9001:2015 Certified Lead Auditor (IRCA approved) – required.
* Six Sigma knowledge / certificate is preferable.


**Total Rewards/Benefits**
 For decades, Bechtel has worked to inspire the next generation of employees and beyond! Because our teams face some of the world's toughest challenges, we offer robust benefits to ensure our people thrive. Whether it is advancing careers, delivering programs to enhance our culture, or providing time to recharge, Bechtel has the benefits to build a legacy of sustainable growth. Learn more at Bechtel Total Rewards
   

  

**Diverse Teams Build The Extraordinary**
 As a global company, Bechtel has long been home to a vibrant multitude of nationalities, cultures, ethnicities, and life experiences. This diversity has made us a more trusted partner, more effective problem solvers and innovators, and a more attractive destination for leading talent.
   

  

 We are committed to being a company where every colleague feels that they belong\-where colleagues feel part of "One Team," respected and rewarded for what they bring, supported in pursuing their goals, invested in our values and purpose, and treated equitably. Click here to learn more about the people who power our legacy.
   

  

**Bechtel is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, age, national origin, disability, citizenship status (except as authorized by law), protected veteran status, genetic information, and any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law. Applicants with a disability, who require a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application or hiring process, may e\-mail their request to**

**Overview**
 AtkinsRéalis is looking for a Construction Logistics Director (PMC), in Riyadh, KSA
   

  

 Your role
   

  

**Performance**
* Effective delivery of site\-wide logistics through the procurement of a site\-wide Logistics management contractor. Define and monitor that the scope of services is delivered satisfactorily through setting and monitoring of measurable goals and objectives around the following broad key enablers:
* Orderly, safe and efficiently movement of labour, plant, and materials around site.
* Planning the location of haul roads, laydown, external access and offloading zones to minimise obstruction and impacts to programme.
* Creation of a secure, well maintained site with regular (weekly) logistics meetings.
* Efficient and orderly management of any worker's'accommodation.
* Development of processes, procedures and induction programmes.
* Supply chain management, movement plans and lookahead forecasting.
* Ensuring logistics activities are not a constraining factor on the program
* Creating of site\-specific safety manual, with appropriate first aid cover and equipment present
* Develop, maintain and update the Site Emergency Plan.
* Ensuring information is communicated effectively around the site.
* Planning for effective signage in line with corporate branding
* Efficient management of any special public access roads – access to show houses/sales pavilions etc.
* Provision of an effective security management system that ensures all the above is achievable.


**Change Management**
* Variations and adjustments to Logistics Contractors scope, review the requirements and assess the impacts. Monitor construction change management process via the Engineer.


**Permitting**
* The Logistics Contractor's'acquisition of all necessary permits for smooth logistics operations.


**Cost**
* Review completeness of established budgets and review cost plans. Ensure that work is re\-measured and work is signed off in accordance with the contract.


**Planning**
* The monthly detailed graphical time slice showing plot and infrastructure activities and how logistics will support. Review weekly plans, confirm the activities are accurate and coordinated across stakeholders.


**Risk**
* Review detailed risk register developed by logistics contractor and team coordinated with all site stakeholders, complete with implement mitigation plan.


**Interface**
* Provide coordination across all programme consultants and stakeholders related to logistics works. Provide support to plots in terms of external access and influences that impact plot activities.


**Communication**
* Through regular meetings, highlight issues, concerns and roll out weekly directions to stakeholder's team managers. Seek resolution to any issues with the respective plot, infrastructure or logistics teams or escalate with the proposed mitigation plan.


**Reporting**
* Weekly issues through detailed logistics dashboards.


**Assurance**
* Submission of checklists of all logistics contractor self\-audits (QA, Safety, Environmental, Welfare etc.) review and report on status.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Project Management or Real Estate Development
* Chartership preferred
* CSCS, SMSTS/SSSTS, Recognised safety programme (qualified and up to date), First Aid, Lifting Supervisor Certification, Traffic management, Institutional membership


**About You**

* Global experience with the cycle of new business creation, investment analysis, portfolio creation and management and industrialised processing.

 With 3,500 employees across 8 countries in the Middle East, Egis has delivered over 700 complex development projects, stimulating economic growth and enhancing quality of life. Ranked among the top ten firms in the Middle East by Engineering News Record (ENR), Egis is committed to sustainable development. The Group’s operations in the Middle East are built on strategic acquisitions and a deep understanding of local market conditions. Egis’ long history of providing comprehensive engineering, consulting, and project management services makes it a trusted partner for regional governments, investors, and developers.
   

  

  

  




**Job Description**

 As the Investment and Business Development Director, you will spearhead the company's efforts in identifying and capitalizing on investment opportunities for sustainable urban development projects. Drawing upon your extensive experience in investment management and your deep understanding of the engineering industry, you will lead initiatives to attract funding, secure partnerships, and drive the financial success of our projects.
   

  





 The Investment and Business Development Director will work closely with the Investment Planning Director and the team.
   

  

  

  




**Qualifications**
* Investment and Business Development Strategy: Develop and execute a comprehensive Business development strategy aligned with projects objectives and market dynamics.
* Opportunity Identification: Conduct in\-depth market research and feasibility studies to identify potential investment opportunities in sustainable urban development projects.
* Investor Relations: Cultivate and maintain relationships with investors, financial institutions, and other stakeholders to secure funding and support for project development.
* Due Diligence: Conduct thorough due diligence on potential investment opportunities, including financial, legal, and technical assessments, to mitigate risks and ensure investment viability.
* Deal Structuring: Lead negotiations and structuring of investment deals, including equity investments, debt financing, joint ventures, and strategic partnerships.
* Compliance and Reporting: Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and reporting standards, and provide regular updates to stakeholders on investment performance and portfolio management.
* Team Leadership: Provide leadership and guidance to the investment development team, fostering a culture of excellence, collaboration, and innovation.


**Additional Information**
* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business Administration, or a related field; MBA or CFA designation preferred.
* Minimum of 15 years of experience in investment management, financial analysis, or corporate finance, with a focus on infrastructure or real estate investments.

* Proven track record of successfully sourcing, structuring, and closing investment deals, preferably in the infrastructure or real estate sector.
* Excellent analytical, quantitative, and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to assess complex investment opportunities and risks.
* Effective communication and negotiation skills, with the ability to build and maintain relationships with a diverse range of stakeholders.
* Strategic thinker with a results\-oriented mindset, capable of identifying and pursuing profitable investment opportunities.
* Proficiency in financial modeling and valuation techniques; familiarity with investment analysis software is a plus.
* Fluency in English and proficiency in Arabic \- reading and writing.

data.jd_text:
**About Lucidya**
 Lucidya is an AI\-native platform for customer experience (CX) intelligence that manages entire customer lifecycles autonomously, from initial engagement through retention and growth.
   

  

 Unlike platforms that only surface insights and leave the action to you, Lucidya completes the loop with proprietary NLU capabilities developed entirely in\-house and trained on millions of multilingual conversations, equipping marketing, support, CX, and research teams to deliver personalised experiences that drive measurable improvements in customer satisfaction, retention, and lifetime value.
   

  

**Why This Role Matters**
 At Lucidya, closing a deal is the beginning of the work \- not the end of it. Enterprise clients come with complex requirements, multiple stakeholders, and zero tolerance for delivery that doesn't match what was promised.
   

  

 This role sits at the centre of that delivery. You will be the operational backbone that keeps projects on track, stakeholders aligned, and risks visible before they become problems. You will work across Commercial, Product, Engineering, Finance, and Legal \- not as a coordinator, but as the person who holds the whole picture and makes sure every part of the business is moving in the same direction.
   

  

 If you are the kind of person who gets uncomfortable when things are vague, who builds structure because it actually helps, and who takes personal ownership of whether a project lands well \- this role is for you.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
**Own delivery from pre\-RFP to go\-live.**
* Lead pre\-RFP alignment sessions to validate scope, timeline, resource availability, and budget assumptions before any commitment is made
* Establish and enforce a handover framework from RFP to delivery \- with clear ownership and traceability at every stage of the project lifecycle
* Ensure every project proposal goes through cross\-functional validation (Commercial, Product, Engineering, HR, Legal, Finance) before it goes out the door
* Review vendor and subcontractor arrangements for procurement compliance and operational readiness


**Run governance like it matters \- because it does.**
* Design and maintain project governance frameworks that define accountability, escalation paths, and decision\-making checkpoints
* Keep a live project and risk register covering progress, dependencies, financial exposure, and compliance risks
* Maintain executive dashboards and PMO reports that give leadership real visibility \- not a sanitised summary
* Enforce stage gates and approval processes before any contractual, financial, or delivery commitment is made
* Run post\-implementation reviews that actually produce lessons, not just documentation


**Keep every part of the business aligned.**
* Serve as the central coordination point across Commercial, Product, Engineering, HR, Finance, Legal, and Delivery
* Lead project initiation, steering, and review meetings \- and make sure they produce decisions, not just updates
* Maintain consistent communication with internal and external stakeholders through dashboards, executive summaries, and progress reports that people actually read
* Facilitate procurement and vendor coordination, ensuring external partners meet internal standards and regulatory requirements


**Manage third\-party and vendor risk.**
* Oversee vendor and third\-party onboarding governance \- tools, processors, and contractors must meet data protection and regulatory standards before they touch a project
* Maintain a Third\-Party Risk Register tracking compliance obligations, privacy safeguards, and mitigation activities
* Coordinate with Legal, Compliance, and Data Privacy on risk assessments, incident responses, and breach reporting related to external partners


**Bring the same rigour to internal programmes.**
* Extend the PM framework beyond client projects to internal strategic initiatives \- process transformation, system rollouts, product programmes
* Track progress against annual strategic objectives and KPIs, and report it clearly to leadership
* Develop and maintain standardised PM tools, templates, and procedures that the wider team can actually use


 You are responsible for outcomes: projects that land on time, within budget, and without surprises.
   

  

**Who You Are**
* You have 5\+ years in project or programme management, preferably in SaaS or enterprise technology. You have managed complex, multi\-workstream projects and you know what good governance looks like in practice
* You are comfortable holding multiple complex projects simultaneously without dropping the thread on any of them
* You think in terms of risk before others see it. You flag early, escalate when you should, and never let a problem fester because it was uncomfortable to raise
* You have real financial acumen \- cost modelling, budget tracking, and ROI analysis are not tasks you hand off
* You can influence without authority. You work across functions where you do not control the resources, and you still get things done
* Your communication is clear, structured, and calibrated to the audience \- whether that is an engineer, a client, or a CEO
* You hold a PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent certification. You apply methodology pragmatically \- the framework serves the project, not the other way around
* You are comfortable in a fast\-scaling environment where not everything is defined. You build the structure and improve it as you go


**Culturally, you are:**
* Structured but not rigid
* Proactive, not reactive
* Calm when it gets complicated \- and it will get complicated
* Someone who takes ownership of outcomes, not just tasks


**What The Hiring Process Will Look Like**
* Screening call with Talent Acquisition
* Deep\-dive interview with the Head of Services
* Case study presentation \- project governance and risk scenario
* Offer

 As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we consider all qualified applicants for all positions without regard to race, creed, color, religion, national origin, ancestry, ethnicity, age, disability, genetic information, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, citizenship, marital status, domestic partnership or civil union status, familial status, military and veteran status, and other characteristics protected by applicable law.

**Tech Director (Head of Engineering)** 
**Globant — Riyadh, KSA**

 Riyadh, Saudi Arabia (on\-site). Alternative locations: Jordan, Lebanon, UAE, Egypt — with regular travel to Riyadh required.
   

  

**Reports to:** 
 VP of Technology
   

  

**Direct scope:** 
 50\+ engineers across back end and front end disciplines
   

  

**Role type:** 
 New role \| Permanent \| Leadership/Strategy
   

  

**About The Role**
 This is a senior engineering leadership position responsible for the strategic direction, delivery performance, and technical maturity of Globant's software engineering function in the MENA region. The Head of Engineering will own the engineering roadmap, drive AI adoption, establish engineering culture and standards, and lead a growing organisation of 50\+ engineers across back end and front end teams.
   

  

**Key Priorities**
* Improve delivery velocity — Identify and remove bottlenecks across the engineering lifecycle. Establish metrics, streamline release processes, and improve predictability of delivery across teams.
* Drive AI adoption across engineering — Define and execute a strategy for embedding AI into engineering workflows, tooling, and product development. Champion the use of AI\-assisted development, testing, and operations to accelerate output and quality.
* Build engineering culture and processes — Establish engineering standards, governance, and ways of working. Improve tooling, development processes, and code standards across teams. Create a culture of ownership, technical excellence, and continuous improvement. Introduce career frameworks, knowledge sharing, and communities of practice.
* Tackle technical debt and platform modernisation — Assess the current estate, prioritise remediation, and lead modernisation efforts aligned with long\-term architectural goals. Balance delivery demands with sustainable engineering practices.
* Scale the engineering organisation — Partner with talent acquisition to grow the team in line with business demand. Build a hiring strategy across Riyadh and alternative locations (Jordan, Lebanon, UAE, Egypt), ensuring quality and cultural alignment.


**Key Responsibilities**
* Set the technical vision and engineering strategy aligned with business objectives
* Lead and develop engineering managers, SMEs, and senior engineers across all disciplines
* Own engineering delivery performance, reporting, and continuous improvement
* Collaborate closely with architecture, cybersecurity, product, delivery, design, QA, data, and DevSecOps/platform disciplines to ensure alignment and cohesive outcomes across the engineering organisation
* Represent engineering in senior leadership forums and client engagements
* Manage stakeholder relationships across the organisation and with external partners
* Champion modern engineering practices including DevSecOps, CI/CD, observability, and automation
* Ensure compliance with security, governance, and regulatory requirements


**Technical Landscape**
 The role provides strategic oversight across the following technology stack. Hands\-on coding is not expected, but a strong understanding of the technologies in use and the ability to engage credibly with technical teams is required.
   

  

**Back End:** 
 NodeJS, Adobe Experience Manager, Apigee, RESTful APIs, microservices architecture, event\-driven architecture, SQL and NoSQL databases, OAuth/JWT, message queuing and async processing.
   

  

**Front End:** 
 Flutter, Svelte, HTML5/CSS3/JavaScript/TypeScript, Android and iOS native development, component\-based architecture, micro frontend patterns, progressive web applications, accessibility (WCAG), state management.
   

  

**AI \& Emerging Tech:** 
 AI\-assisted development tooling, Agentic AI, LLMOps, AI integration into engineering workflows, evaluation of emerging AI/ML technologies for engineering productivity.
   

  

**Requirements**
* Significant experience leading engineering organisations of 50\+ in a Tech/SaaS environment
* Proven track record of improving delivery velocity and engineering maturity at scale
* Experience introducing AI tooling and practices into engineering teams
* Strong understanding of back end and front end technologies — able to engage credibly with engineering teams and contribute to technical discussions
* Demonstrated ability to work effectively across disciplines including architecture, cybersecurity, product, delivery, design, and QA
* Experience building engineering teams across multiple geographies, ideally in the MENA region
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills with senior/executive audiences
* Experience with engineering governance, standards, and platform modernisation
* Track record of building engineering culture, career frameworks, and communities of practice


**Desirable**
* Experience in a consulting or digital services environment
* Experience working with Saudi Arabia's digital transformation landscape (e.g. Vision 2030 aligned programmes)

data.jd_text:
**Company Overview**
 At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close\-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.
   

  

**Department Overview**
 Directly manage and guide specialized technical leads, including the Incident managers, Support \& Operations team, Upgrade \& Deployment Lead, KPI Reporting \& Analytics Lead, Drive Test Lead, and Knowledge Transfer Lead.
   

  

**Job Description**
 A Service Delivery Manager (SDM) provides oversight of the operational health of the customer system, from service delivery through lifecycle support. The SDM ensures and may manage internal \& external resources to deliver services and maintain their compliance with customer contractual commitments.
   

  

 The SDM establishes standard procedures designed to ensure consistently high service performance, monitors employees and evaluates customer feedback to develop quality improvement processes. The SDM is responsible for customer success as defined by success criteria during the transition phase
   

  

 A Service Delivery Manager is assigned to one or more of MSI’s customers depending on the size of the system and its complexity. A SDM is expected to have or develop a detailed knowledge of the customer’s system and their operational staff.
   

  

**Responsibility**
 The main role of the Service Delivery Manager is to facilitate customer success by adhering to global service delivery processes related to the customer. The Service Delivery Manager also acts as the main interface between MSI and the customer.
   

  

 The Service Delivery Manager (SDM) is a critical leadership role responsible for overseeing specialized Operations \& Maintenance (O\&M) and deployment functions for the STC Nationwide Kodiak MCX network. Operating alongside the Customer Service Manager (CSM), the SDM leads dedicated technical teams to ensure seamless application upgrades, rigorous performance tracking, and effective knowledge transfer to support the mission\-critical environment.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Upgrades \& deployments: oversee the dedicated Upgrade and Deployment team (consisting of 4 personnel) responsible for executing software patching, rollbacks, updates, and deployment across all lab and production systems.
* Performance monitoring \&reporting: direct the KPI Reporting \& Analytics team to generate comprehensive system performance reports, Kodiak Analytic reports, and drive test reports to ensure service quality and SLA compliance.
* Testing \& verification: oversee change management verification, Wave mobile application acceptance testing, and drive testing operations (in coordination with 3rd party vendors).
* Knowledge transfer \& enablement: manage the Knowledge Transfer lead to facilitate comprehensive user engagement, onboarding, fleet mapping preparation, and continuous training development for the customer.
* Cross\-functional collaboration: work closely with the Customer Support Manager (CSM), Incident Managers, and supporting functions (like HR, Commercial, and Procurement) to align strategic goals and ensure continuous service improvement.


**Required Operating Environment Context**
 The role supports a 24x7x365 support model handling highly complex, mission\-critical push\-to\-talk (MCPTT) applications.
   

  

 The candidate will be subject to local Saudization requirements, which may require specific educational degrees related to the role to be granted a work permit.
   

  

 Deliverables
   

  

* Take part in the formulation of standard procedures regarding service delivery.
* Lead the transition and transformation of project operations to Managed Services.
* Ensure that procedures and plans formulated for the customer are in line with the organization’s goals.
* Ensure that procedures formulated are fully implemented to achieve service level objectives.
* Attend important meetings on behalf of the service delivery team or appoint representatives.
* Make recommendations for changes to technology or procedures for the customer.
* Prepare periodic reports and present such reports to the customer stakeholders.
* Analysis of system performance and facilitate improvement recommendations.


 Cost and Efficiency
   

  

 A common fiscal responsibility of the Service Delivery Manager is to ensure delivery processes are efficient and cost effective. To reduce costs and streamline the process without adversely impacting the client experience, they might eliminate paperwork, unnecessary service steps or non\-value\-added features. For technology service providers, an emphasis should be placed on the efficient delivery of hardware and software services.
   

  

* Suggest new strategies to maintain or improve on the quality of service delivery \& minimize cost.
* Carry out research regularly and attend seminars to learn improved service delivery procedures and processes.


 Customer Satisfaction
   

  

 A key role for the service delivery manager is to constantly assess customer feedback and make necessary improvements. Managers typically conduct evaluations with customers on the phone, in person, via e\-mail or through postal mail. When scores fall below the preset thresholds, the manager may conduct additional research and take steps to correct deficiencies. For example, some customers might feel like parts of the process are slow or delayed. By identifying and analyzing the issues, the service delivery manager can work on eliminating bottlenecks.
   

  

* Collect data and information on client satisfaction, inquiry, and complaint.
* Plan, manage and execute customer meetings for service delivery reporting and improvements.
* He/she will ensure that clients’ satisfaction is always guaranteed and will consistently collate data on customer satisfaction, inquiry and complaint.
* Responsible for maintaining a positive relationship with customers.
* identifying customer needs and ensuring that the service provider is able to meet these needs with an appropriate catalogue of services.
* The Service Delivery Manager has responsibility for being the Customer’s advocate within Motorola and being Motorola’s face to the Customer.
* Support the customer to best use the features and deliverables of Managed Service.
* Performs analysis of issues and problems.
* Lead efforts to escalate across internal functional groups to resolve service or client business impacting issues.
* Provides support relative to contractual commitments and SLA's.


 Management
   

  

* Educate the members of the service delivery team on new plans and implication on service delivery.
* Assess the individual and collective performance of the team members.
* Organize and head meetings with the service delivery team.
* Responsible for training of service delivery resources.
* Reporting.


 Basic Requirements
   

  

* Diploma or degree in Engineering (Electrical) or related discipline
* ITIL v4 certification
* High level of understanding of Communication systems and IP Networks
* 2\+ years experience with planning and transitioning a project to operations and maintenance phase
* 5\+ years experience managing a service delivery team, ideally focused on operations and maintenance
* High\-level experience in telecoms or public safety
* Excellent communications skills (verbal, written and presentation in English and Arabic)
* Excellent customer service skills with a focus on Total Customer Satisfaction
* Effective consultation and liaison skills
* Good planning and time management skills
* Ability to prioritise, multi\-task and meet deadlines
* Excellent theoretical and practical problem\-solving skills
* Well\-developed interpersonal and teamwork skills
* Ability to work unsupervised
* Technical literacy


 Travel Requirements
   

  

 25\-50%
   

  

 Relocation Provided
   

  

 Domestic
   

  

 Position Type
   

  

 Experienced
   

  

 Referral Payment Plan
   

  

 No

 Motorola Solutions Arabia, Inc., Saudi Branch
   

  

***EEO Statement***
 Motorola Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other legally\-protected characteristic.
   

  

 We are proud of our people\-first and community\-focused culture, empowering every Motorolan to be their most authentic self and to do their best work to deliver on the promise of a safer world. data.jd_text:
Creatio is a global vendor of an AI\-native platform to automate workflows and CRM with no\-code and a maximum degree of freedom. Our platform combines an AI\-first architecture, composable no\-code tools, and enterprise\-grade governance to help organizations build and scale faster.
   

  

 We’re proud to be recognized by top industry analysts as a Leader and Strong Performer in multiple Gartner and Forrester reports.
   

  

 In 2025, Creatio was named to Inc.’s Best Workplaces list, recognizing our commitment to employee wellbeing and a strong workplace culture.
   

  

 For the role of
 **Enterprise Account Executive (KSA)** 
 , we are seeking an experienced field sales professional to help us scale the number of Enterprises that use the Creatio platform. Candidates must have experience building and developing a territory to high performance within an innovative SaaS technology provider. Successful candidates will help to build a portfolio of business within the top target enterprises in their territory. Successful candidates will need to drive their own activity and build a funnel while being supported by the broader Creatio organization of diverse and executive, product, and technical teams.
   

  

 The role is based in
 **Riyadh (KSA)** 
 and will report to the Regional Sales Director MEA (based in Dubai).
   

  

 Our targets are ambitious, and we are seeking engaging, collaborative, successful Enterprise Account Executives who have the skills, experience, and track record to make an immediate impact. We’re fast\-paced, innovative, and collaborative. We pursue excellence in everything and have a lot of fun along the way.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Deliver against revenue targets and all key performance metrics.
* Generate new business opportunities on an assigned territory, manage pipeline, opportunities, forecasting, and other items related to a normal outside sales function.
* Manage the end\-to\-end enterprise sales process and resource to create and execute winning solution sales strategies.
* Establish relationships with VP/C\-level buyers (Business and IT).
* Develop and orchestrate sales presentations and product demonstrations.
* Focus on new logo acquisition and manage relationships with the existing accounts to identify opportunities for cross and up\-sales.
* Ability to work with all customer functions including executive\-level personnel, various customer stakeholders, architecture, operations, design, vendor management, innovation, sourcing, and customer procurement.


**Desired Skills And Experience**
* Minimum 5 years of experience working within enterprise SaaS platform sales to large enterprises
* Proven track record of meeting quarterly and annual targets
* Deep understanding of executive\-level Enterprise and/or Global Account sales and methodologies
* Superb written and verbal communications and organizational skills
* 4\-year degree required, with technical curiosity and desire to learn
* Experience with CRM/BPM software space is strongly preferred
* Fluency in English and native Arabic


**What You Should Expect From Us**
* The award\-winning product (a Leader in Gartner Quadrants) to be proud of.
* Focus on making our clients successful (NPS score – 42%).
* Dedicated leadership with open doors.
* Steady stream of inbound leads (though we expect you to generate your own leads as well).
* Collaborative environment where everybody is happy to help.
* A remote\-first hybrid model: while giving plenty of space for concentration and personal working habits, we encourage regular meetings in one of our five hubs worldwide.
* Culture of genuine care, ownership, dedication, and high standards (learn more here).
* A vibrant corporate life: enjoy the opportunity to explore your teammates' cultures in online and offline events, participate in sports competitions, enjoy art master classes, and create your new favorite memories at our parties.
* Creatio offers all team members competitive pay.
* Paid leave options for life\-qualifying events, sicknesses, etc.

data.jd_text:
Egis is a leading global consulting, construction engineering and operating firm. We work together with our clients, across every aspect of transport, energy and the built environment to build a more balanced, sustainable and resilient world. The Egis Group has over 50 years’ experience and a team of 22,000 employees in over 120 countries around the world. Joining our Group means, above all, sharing our values as a people\-first company, strongly committed to sustainability and innovation.
   

  





 In the Middle East we're proud to be delivering some of the most iconic projects which help connect people, protect our environment and meet emission reduction targets. From motorways to tramways, nuclear power plants to smart cities, clients choose us to help them solve their most complex challenges \- delivering climate\-responsible growth that meets the needs of communities, industry, and the planet.
   

  

  

  




**Job Description**

 We are seeking an experienced and dynamic Project Manager to join our growing team in Doha, Qatar. In this pivotal role, you will lead the successful delivery of road asset management projects from conception through completion, driving excellence in infrastructure lifecycle management whilst fostering collaborative relationships with internal teams and external stakeholders. As a Project Manager specialising in road asset management, you will be instrumental in ensuring road infrastructure projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards, whilst maintaining a customer\-focused approach and supporting your team through every phase of the asset management lifecycle.
   

  




* Develop and maintain strong collaborative relationships with key stakeholders, including road authorities, maintenance contractors, traffic management teams, and community representatives, ensuring clear communication of asset management objectives, performance targets, and infrastructure deliverables
* Plan, organise, and oversee all aspects of road asset management projects, from condition assessments through maintenance delivery and asset renewal, ensuring alignment with road network strategic objectives and regulatory requirements
* Identify, analyse, and evaluate emerging risks related to road infrastructure deterioration, traffic disruption, safety hazards, and environmental constraints; escalate appropriately and implement timely solutions to maintain road network performance
* Manage road asset management budgets and financial forecasts, monitoring maintenance costs, capital expenditure, and whole\-life asset costs whilst providing accurate financial reporting to road authorities and stakeholders
* Establish and maintain comprehensive asset management schedules, maintenance programmes, and renewal timelines; track progress against planned interventions and adjust strategies based on asset condition data and performance metrics
* Lead and coordinate cross\-functional teams including asset engineers, maintenance crews, traffic management specialists, and data analysts, delegating responsibilities effectively whilst fostering an inclusive work environment focused on road network optimisation
* Conduct regular asset performance reviews and stakeholder meetings, ensuring all parties remain informed of road condition status, maintenance progress, and upcoming infrastructure interventions
* Manage changes to road asset management programmes through formal change control processes, evaluating impact on network performance and obtaining necessary approvals whilst maintaining transparency with road users
* Develop and maintain detailed asset registers, condition databases, maintenance records, and performance reports that comply with asset management standards and regulatory requirements
* Mentor and coach team members in asset management principles and road infrastructure best practices, supporting their professional development whilst fostering a culture of continuous improvement in asset stewardship
* Communicate proactively with road authorities, local communities, and road users, addressing concerns about road conditions, managing expectations during maintenance activities, and ensuring stakeholder satisfaction throughout asset management programmes
* Analyse road network performance data, asset condition trends, and maintenance effectiveness, identifying lessons learned and recommending asset management strategy improvements for future road infrastructure initiatives


**Qualifications**

 \*\*Required Skills and Competencies:\*\*
   

  




* Project Management expertise with proven ability to manage projects through their complete lifecycle
* Strong project planning, scheduling, and resource allocation capabilities
* Experience in Road, Highways and Infrastructure Projects
* Have a strong understanding of Asset Management principles, standards and best practices.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to engage effectively with diverse stakeholders
* Demonstrated commercial acumen and budgetary control experience
* Proficiency in risk identification, analysis, and mitigation strategies
* Change management expertise and experience with formal change control processes
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities with a detail\-oriented approach
* Team leadership and management experience with proven ability to motivate and develop team members
* Time management and organizational skills with the ability to prioritize multiple competing demands
* Conflict resolution and negotiation capabilities
* Presentation and reporting skills
* Adaptability and flexibility in approach to meet varying project needs



 \*\*Required Experience:\*\*
   

  




* Minimum 8\+ years of professional project management experience
* Demonstrated experience managing projects of varying scales and complexity.
* Proven track record of delivering projects on time and within budget
* Experience coordinating with multiple internal and external stakeholders
* Experience in vendor and supplier management
* Familiarity with project management tools, systems, and software platforms



 \*\*Preferred Qualifications:\*\*
   

  




* Recognized Project Management certification such as PRINCE2, APM, PMP, or equivalent
* HNC/HND or equivalent qualification in a relevant discipline
* Portfolio or program management experience
* Experience in a multicultural or international project environment
* Knowledge of quality assurance and quality control processes
* Experience with Lean or Agile project management methodologies
* Background in vendor relationship management and contract administration



 \*\*Domain Expertise:\*\*
   

  




* Understanding of project governance frameworks and compliance requirements
* Knowledge of risk management and mitigation frameworks
* Familiarity with resource capacity planning and allocation strategies
* Understanding of project documentation standards and best practices
* Knowledge of performance metrics and key performance indicators (KPIs) for project success

data.jd_text:
Job Specification
   

  

**Job Purpose**
 Assure the most effective performance of project controls, specifically
 **project planning and scheduling management** 
 , including schedule development and schedule analysis (schedule risk, critical and sub?critical activities, schedule variance). This is achieved through timely execution of key activities and strict compliance with standardised processes.
   

  

 Job Context and Major Challenges
   

  

* Requires the ability to:
+ Understand key project drivers, define roles and responsibilities, develop communication protocols, and implement planning and scheduling procedures
+ Identify schedule risks and issues
+ Anticipate elements of engineering, procurement, and construction that may lead to disputes or claims
+ Communicate and influence effectively in a multicultural environment to ensure project delivery within the agreed timeframe

* Major challenges include:
+ Completing detailed planning and scheduling assessments, including recovery and rectification plans, under short deadlines and high?pressure conditions
+ Developing and sustaining strong working relationships with EPC contractor planning teams to ensure accurate and timely information for decision?making


 Key Job Accountabilities
   

  

* Provide management and technical leadership across all planning and scheduling functions, including schedule risk analysis, reporting, productivity, and impact assessment, by establishing fit?for?purpose project planning and scheduling procedures.
* Lead and manage the planning and scheduling team, coordinating inputs from engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, and interface functions.
* Ensure contractors and subcontractors implement effective planning and scheduling measures in line with project requirements.
* Manage the preparation of project control gate deliverables related to planning and scheduling in accordance with the Project Management System.
* Ensure the effective implementation and ongoing updating of the project planning and scheduling procedures.
* Coordinate the collection, consolidation, analysis, and reporting of progress measurement and control data to assess overall project status and identify potential problem areas.
* Conduct schedule delay and impact analysis and review schedule recovery plans, including evaluation of additional resources when required.
* Ensure all approved project changes are assessed, incorporated, and reflected in the overall schedule stewardship and reporting.
* Evaluate contractor performance in planning and scheduling, identify discrepancies, and ensure corrective actions are implemented.
* Act as the primary interface between senior project management and EPC contractors on all planning, scheduling, and reporting matters.


**Qualifications**
 Minimum Requirements
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Finance, Construction Management, or a related discipline


 Knowledge and Experience
   

  

* Minimum 10 years’ experience in project controls for EPC oil and gas capital projects, primarily in planning and scheduling
* Strong knowledge of project controls principles, theories, and practices
* Experience on major projects from both owner and contractor perspectives
* Proven experience managing EPC lump?sum contracts
* Experience working in multicultural environments with large local subcontractors


 Technical and Business Skills
   

  

* Subject matter expertise in project planning and scheduling
* Proficient in scheduling and risk analysis tools (e.g., Primavera P6, schedule risk analysis software)
* Demonstrated ability to develop and maintain project schedules (Level 1 to Level 4\), including logic ties, sequencing, assumptions, and resource loading
* Strong capability in performing schedule analyses using current project data
* Ability to undertake complex tasks and provide guidance to team members
* Proactive approach and ability to deliver timely analysis aligned with project needs
* Strong understanding of cross?functional and organisational interfaces
* Ability to work independently within established procedures while contributing to their improvement
* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
* Strong negotiation, influencing, analytical, and problem?solving skills
* Excellent interpersonal, teamwork, and collaboration skills
* High level of computer literacy, including planning software and standard office applications

 At Raytheon, the foundation of everything we do is rooted in our values and a higher calling – to help our nation and allies defend freedoms and deter aggression.  Raytheon’s National Advanced Surface\-to\-Air Missile System (NASAMS) Program Team is seeking an
 **NASAMS In\-country Associate Director \- Program Management** 
 in Qatar. In this role, you will work closely with the Qatari Emiri Air Forces (QEAF) and our key OCONUS subcontractor, Kongsberg Air Defense (KDA).
   

  

 As part of the Short \& Medium Range Air Defense Systems Product Area within the Land and Air Defense Systems (L\&ADS) Strategic Business Unit, the team has successfully delivered NASAMS systems to Qatar and is now transitioning into operations and sustainment, with opportunities for product modernization.
   

  

 As the Senior Program Manager, you will report to the NASAMS Program Director within the MRAD Directorate and collaborate closely with the Qatar NASAMS Program Manager based in Andover, MA. Serving as the primary point of contact for Qatar NASAMS execution efforts in Doha, you will work in partnership with the Qatar NASAMS Program Manager to ensure a unified approach to program execution.
   

  

 Key responsibilities include managing subcontractor execution schedules with the KDA in\-country Project Manager to meet delivery commitments, supporting the CONUS Program Manager in preparing EACs and Program Review packages, and maintaining program infrastructure. This requires coordination across Raytheon functions, off\-sites, and international partners to ensure timely staffing, start\-up, and delivery of contractual products and services.
   

  

 You will lead in\-country teams for modernization, warranty, after\-sales support, repair \& return, and technical assistance, with responsibility for schedule and performance. This high\-visibility role involves daily interaction with the MRAD Directorate, regional and CONUS\-based functions, and senior\-level customer representatives, ensuring program success through cross\-functional collaboration and effective stakeholder engagement.
   

  

 This accompanied role will be in Doha, Qatar for a 2\-year international assignment on a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) with potential extension.
   

  

 Ability to travel internationally (up to 25%) as needed.
   

  

 Employment is contingent upon meeting all medical requirements for overseas assignments including comprehensive post\-offer medical examination.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Oversee daily execution of the in\-country team, schedule, and performance for assigned contracts, ensuring compliance and fostering customer intimacy to support growth efforts.
* Serve as the primary operational Point of Contact for QEADF, providing procurement guidance, sustainment support, technical troubleshooting, and resource allocation for NASAMS Tactical Operations in Qatar.
* Direct in\-country team members, including site leads, warranty/logistics, quality, and technical personnel, to ensure maximum operational readiness for QEADF.
* Build strong partnerships with the major OCONUS subcontractor KDA, acting as the primary liaison between the NASAMS program office and subcontractor leadership.
* Drive timely resolution of issues, ensuring Raytheon and subcontractor concerns are addressed promptly.
* Support contract proposals, including bidding, negotiation, definitization, and start\-up processes.
* Develop and maintain a collaborative relationship with the QEAF customer, providing regular program updates and coordinating expectations with OCONUS and CONUS teams.
* Ensure subcontractor commitments meet financial, technical, and schedule requirements, escalating issues to the CONUS Program Manager as needed.
* Collaborate with internal functions, such as MRAD, Engineering, Contracts, Finance, Supply Chain, and Quality, to enhance program success.
* Manage subcontractor lifecycle deliverables and support customer program reviews and visits.
* Lead, mentor, and motivate the in\-country team to achieve program objectives while fostering a culture aligned with corporate vision and values.

* PMX Certification Level 4, or ability to obtain within 12 months.
* CORE certification or process improvement equivalent.
* 7\+ years of experience in Program Management and Risk \& Opportunity Measures.
* Experience with large Air Defense weapon systems and prior military.
* Experience in program execution across System Integration, Fielding, Training, Operations, and Sustainment.
* Experience with financial analysis tools and project management tools and/or systems.
* Experience working with cross\-functional teams.
* Proven ability to effectively lead a cross\-functional team in an international environment.
* Demonstrated ability to effectively work with international customers.
* The ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. government issued Secret security clearance is required.
* U.S. citizenship is required, as only U.S. citizens are eligible for a security clearance.


**Qualifications We Prefer**

* Experience working in MENA region.
* Experience as a Senior Non\-commissioned Officer.
* Experience in international program execution, including collaboration with large international subcontractors and US Government programs.
* Strong working knowledge of EX/IM regulations, security requirements, and subcontract formation, execution, and management.

* Expertise in supporting development, production, sustainment, and execution of complex weapon systems, preferably within the aerospace and defense industry.

data.jd_text:
**Primary Purpose Of The Job**
 To lead, manage and successfully deliver the EPIC Execution Phase for the PS3 BH Field Redevelopment Project – covering both Greenfield and Brownfield scopes— ensuring delivery within cost, schedule, quality, and HSE requirements in line with QatarEnergy's Project Management Framework.
   

  

 The role acts as the Project Manager’s primary deputy, accountable for day‑to‑day coordination, decision‑making, and execution oversight for all EPIC activities across engineering, procurement, fabrication, installation, pre‑commissioning, commissioning, and handover.
   

  

 The EPIC Phase Scope of Work includes, but is not limited to:
   

  

* New Production Station (PS3\) bridge connected to the existing complex, consisting of a Process (PS3K) Platform, a Utilities and Living Quarters (PS3L) Platform, MJ Separation and Compression (PS3M), Riser Platform (PS3R), Flare and interconnecting bridges with structural props.
* Brownfield Modifications to existing PS3A,PS3B and PS3C, plus HV Electrical modifications and Civil works at Halul Island.
* A structural Prop and new 4 leg jacket with topside for injection wells.
* Structural Props (support platform) at several remote WHJs.


**Required Experience And Skills**
* At least 10 years in senior Project Management roles delivering large offshore packages.
* Proven leadership delivering multi‑billion USD EPIC contracts involving Topsides, Jackets, Brownfield modifications, offshore construction, installation, and commissioning.
* Work experience in fabrication, offshore construction, and Inspection and Pre\-commissioning activities.
* Strong understanding of engineering design, offshore fabrication, load‑out, T\&I, hook‑up, pre‑commissioning and commissioning.
* Knowledge of offshore codes and standards (API, DNV, ISO) and Shell DEPs.
* Solid experience with risk management, schedule control, earned value, interface management, and change management.
* Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills in multicultural environments.
* Strong decision‑making capability, including under pressure and with limited information.
* Ability to lead large teams (\>150 personnel) across multiple locations and time zones.


**Educational Qualifications**
* B.Sc. in an Engineering Discipline or equivalent from an internationally recognized University with 18 years minimum relevant project experience.

data.jd_text:
The Data Cleansing Program Director leads the Government\-Wide data cleansing program — driving large\-scale data quality uplift across multiple government entities. You will own the cleansing strategy, orchestrate a multi\-vendor delivery model, oversee enterprise data modelling, and ensure that cleansed datasets are published into the Government\-Wide catalogue and sharing platforms — sustainably, with strong governance, ongoing monitoring, and continuous improvement.
   

  

* Define and lead the Government\-Wide data cleansing strategy aligned with data quality standards, policies, and government priorities
* Establish a structured framework to prioritize critical datasets and drive phased execution across entities
* Standardize, automate, and scale the end\-to\-end data cleansing lifecycle — leveraging advanced tools and AI\-driven solutions; govern reusable accelerators
* Establish and oversee a multi\-vendor delivery model — coordinated execution, performance management, and scalability across entities
* Oversee large\-scale data quality improvement initiatives aligned to defined quality dimensions, rules, and thresholds
* Oversee development of entities' enterprise data models — aligned with Government\-Wide data standards, central information models, and interoperability requirements
* Ensure creation, standardization, and publication of cleansed datasets into the Government\-Wide data catalogue and sharing platforms — enabling accessibility and reuse
* Oversee development of data quality dashboards to track KPIs and cleansing progress
