data.jd_text:
**Director of Project Management** 




  





 Majid Al Futtaim is seeking an experienced and dynamic Director of Project Management to lead the delivery of large\-scale residential, non\-residential, infrastructure, and landscape development projects.
 



 This leadership role will oversee the full project lifecycle — from planning and procurement through execution, handover, and post\-delivery customer experience. The successful candidate will play a key role in ensuring projects are delivered on time, within budget, and to the highest standards of quality, safety, and sustainability.
 



  





**PURPOSE OF THE JOB** 




  





 • The Director of Project Management reports to the Chief Development Officer and works in close partnership with the Director of Development. The Director of Project Management is responsible for the delivery of all residential, non\-residential buildings and infrastructure (civil and landscape) works for the development.
 



 • The role requires development of short and long term planning for delivery of the project business plan. Monthly forecasting and monitoring of progress of works (cost time and quality) to handover is required to ensure cash and revenue projections are achieved.
 



 • Bring together, direct and manage all PM staff, contractors and consultants with clear briefing and management for all works, demonstrating a strong presence on site as a “hands on” leader.
 



 • Control time, cost, quality and health and safety via clear direction and management tools (dashboards, programs, budgets, meetings) to ensure design intent is delivered, resulting in a positive customer experience combined with efficiency of operations.
 



 • Prioritise response to any direct requests or instructions given by Senior Shareholder representatives and ensure full resolution agreed with the Shareholder expeditiously, at all times in liaison with and sign off by the DM team of such process.
 



 • Develop Best Practice methodology in benchmarking and value engineering to ensure cost efficiency without jeopardizing initial development concepts/customer expectations at time of pre\-sales.
 



 • Review existing operations \& administrative systems \& streamline as required to optimize resource efficiency.
 



 • Prepare clear \& concise RFP’s consistent with budgets for consultant \& contractor selection process as necessary \& in liaison with DM team.
 



 • Lead \& report on WOW initiatives as relate to PM operations and Capex across development projects.
 



 • Working closely with the customer experience/FM teams and managing the aftercare team is essential to ensure a positive customer experience continues post\-handover.
 



 • Develop safety, sustainability \& innovation strategies and targets for each business plan year.
 



 • Report regularly, and with clarity and transparently at all times.
 



 • Manage internal audits to ensure that company procedures and policies are being followed and adhered to.
 



  





**PRIMARY DUTIES \& RESPONSIBILITIES** 




**Key Tasks** 




 • Manage delivery of all residential, non\-residential built form and infrastructure works.
 



 • Use, and develop where necessary, key processes and procedures to ensure monitoring and management of time, cost and quality for all projects.
 



 • Work in close cooperation with the Director of Development on design of all works and ensure the delivery of design intent is achieved.
 



 • Develop and manage budget for all costs to ensure KPI’s are achieved.
 



 • Work with CDO, development and finance teams to develop business plan strategy.
 



 • Forecast and manage handover of all works to ensure Business Plan cash flow and revenue projections are achieved on, or ahead of target.
 



 • Procure all services with clear and concise briefing, pre\-qualification, negotiation and appointment in line with company policies and procedures.
 



 • Focus on cash management of works to ensure the most efficient use of company\-wide CAPEX.
 



 • Ensure strategy of handover of works to FM is comprehensive and well planned starting at the concept design stage, to ensure seamless handover resulting in a positive customer experience.
 



 • Ensure supportive relationship with Customer Experience Team to enhance the customer experience at all touch points relative to the PM function.
 



 • HSE compliance to be in line with best practice to maintain/improve track record.
 



 • Risk management framework regularly updated and managed to avoid negative impacts and ensure efficient, financially and corporate compliance via transparent, sustainable and safe operations at all time.
 



 • Ensure approvals/licenses and other obligations are procured and adhered to for all works.
 



 • Develop a meeting framework to ensure clear briefing, direction and follow up of the PM team, contractors, consultants and liaison with other in house staff to meet agreed KPIs.
 



 • Provide clear, concise and transparent reporting and communication to senior management on a monthly basis, including weekly meeting and updates to CDO.
 



 • Ensure sustainability initiatives are developed and targets adhered to for the project.
 



 • Foster innovation within the team to achieve companywide innovation targets.
 



 • Develop and foster strong relationships with key government authorities, contractors and consultants to ensure smooth management and delivery of projects.
 



 • Foster motivation and develop a collaborative team environment where the Development Management \& Project Management teams work seamlessly.
 



  





**PERSON SPECIFICATION** 




**Education \& Experience** 




 • BSc in Project Management, Engineering, or related discipline.
 



 • 15\+ years of Middle East work experience in the development field, with the majority of experience being client\-side.
 



  





**Skills \& Competencies** 




  





**Functional Knowledge** 




 • Deep knowledge of built form and infrastructure within large scale/multiple project environments.
 



 • Strong understanding of development processes and procedures.
 



 • Strong understanding of customer needs and business value drivers.
 



 • Proficient in software applications such as AutoCAD, MS Project, MS Office, BIM, and related systems.
 



  





**Technical Competencies** 




 • Excellent communication and presentation skills.
 



 • Strong planning, organizational, and project management skills.
 



 • Strong analytical skills.
 



 • Strong budgeting and future planning skills.
 



  





**Management Competencies** 




 • Leads by example.
 



 • Team player.
 



 • Strong interpersonal relationship skills.
 



 • Initiative and proactive mindset.
 



 • Diplomacy and stakeholder management.
 



  





**Communication** 




 • Effective writing and reporting skills.
 



 • Ability to deliver presentations across a variety of situations and topics.
 



 • Strong relationship development and maintenance skills.
 



 • Strong internal communication capabilities.
 



 • Fluency in English, both verbal and written, is preferred. Fluency in Arabic would be advantageous but not essential.
 



  





**Core Values** 




 • Bold
 



 • Passionate
 



 • Togetherness

We are looking for The Cybersecurity Engineer (CE) to be dedicated to the Schneider
   

  

 Electric Enterprise Network and Security Services team that provides lifecycle security services for
   

  

 customers.
   

  

**Key Tasks:**
 The Cybersecurity Engineer has primary responsibility for technical execution / delivery of security
   

  

 solutions to customers. While executing a Schneider Electric security solution, the CE will represent
   

  

 Schneider Electric as a technical leader with the proficiency to implement technical security solutions.
   

  

 Solutions will be composed of key elements that meet the customer needs. The CE will manage the
   

  

 implementation of solutions, perform site visits to maintain the security solution, provide security training,
   

  

 and consult on security matters when required. The CE will ensure that the security infrastructure required
   

  

 to support Schneider Electric applications is in place. The CE may also function as a requirements
   

  

 analyst and serve as the conduit between the customer and the Schneider Electric Delivery Organization.
   

  

 The CE will be required to evaluate existing and new technologies to determine their applicability and
   

  

 value for inclusion in the Schneider Electric security solutions, and communicate his or her thoughts to
   

  

 the UAE Cybersecurity Operations Manager or the Global Cybersecurity Director.
   

  

* Work with the product manager or project sponsor to successfully implement the Schneider Electric Security solutions and associated applications
* Configuration of any approved host and network security solutions
* Configuration of Network Performance Monitoring and Management solutions
* Oversee any required modification or reconfiguration of network elements
* Manage installation and connectivity testing of the security solutions
* Lead application acceptance testing (from a security perspective)
* Develop and deliver end user training
* Develop and deliver technical documentation as required
* Technical research to meet security solution requirement


**Credentials:**
* 5\+ years of experience in OT Industrial Control System
* 3\+ years performing the installation and/or management of network\-based firewalls, preferably Cisco, Fortinet, Juniper or another top\-tier product.
* 3\+ years performing network troubleshooting using sniffers and monitors.
* 3\+ years performing the installation and/or management of network\-based Intrusion Detection products.
* 3\+ years advanced systems administration (Windows Active Directory)
* 3\+ years of experience in implementing Host\-based security technologies (Antivirus, Data Leakage Prevention, Host IPS, Whitelisting)
* 3\+ years of experience in implementing system backup technologies
* Understanding of high\-availability networking technologies
* Experience working in a mixed environment of both standard TCP/IP and nonstandard networking protocols
* Experience in developing, evaluating, implementing Security Policy and Procedures
* Experience with the Schneider Electric product line and Industries is desirable but not essential
* Experience with LAN, WAN and technologies
* Facilitation skills to lead requirements discovery workshops and project scope change requirements
* Analytical skills to critically evaluate the information gathered from multiple sources, reconcile conflicts, decompose high\-level information into details, abstract up from low\-level information to a more general understanding, distinguish presented user requests from the underlying true needs, and distinguish solution ideas from requirements

* Writing skills to communicate information effectively to customers, Project Managers, and technical staff
* Organizational skills to work with the vast array of information gathered during elicitation and analysis to cope with rapidly changing information and be able to apply this
* Interpersonal skills, to help negotiate customer priorities and to resolve conflicts among project stakeholders


**Qualifications:**
* Bachelor’s Degree in a computer related field, plus one of the following certifications:
* Cisco Certified Network Associate Security (CCNA Security)
* Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP)
* ISA99 or IC32\-34 related OT certification


**Competencies:**
* Based in Oman
* Independent, self\-sufficient, able to work alone without direct supervision.
* Capable of taking full responsibility for executing tasks, sometimes at remote locations.
* Confident in customer project environment.
* Able to show initiative, make quick decisions, and follow through to a conclusion.

**About the Role** 









 The
 **Service Operations Manager** 
 is based in Oman and is responsible for leading and driving the overall service operations performance across the country. The role focuses on delivering operational excellence, achieving revenue and profitability targets, and ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction across all service segments, including maintenance, repairs, spare parts, and retrofit projects.
 



  





 This position plays a critical role in managing service delivery through internal teams and Authorized Service Providers (ASPs), optimizing resources, and strengthening operational processes. The role also supports business growth by closely aligning with service sales, enhancing customer relationships, and ensuring compliance with company standards, local regulations, and ISO management systems.
 



  





**How You Will Make an Impact** 




  




* Report directly to the Service Director and take full responsibility for Service Operations across Oman.
* Drive revenue growth and profitability by ensuring operational excellence, cost control, and efficient execution of service activities.
* Lead, develop, and coach the operations team to achieve business targets, including revenue, margin, collections, and cost management.
* Conduct regular operational reviews, including bids, quotations, contracts, and estimates to ensure accuracy and competitiveness.
* Establish and enforce operational discipline through standardized tools, processes, and performance management.
* Act as a key member of the DAOM leadership team, providing regular performance updates and strategic inputs.
* Monitor, analyze, and improve the performance of operations teams, ASPs, contractors, and third\-party manpower.
* Ensure timely execution and invoicing of service jobs to meet monthly revenue recognition targets.
* Drive key service KPIs such as response time, first\-time fix rate, and customer satisfaction.
* Support service sales by generating leads for AMC, OMC, T\&M, spare parts, and replacement opportunities.
* Plan and manage operational budgets, manpower, and resources to support current operations and future growth.
* Develop and strengthen the ASP network, ensuring proper contracts, performance tracking, and payment structures.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with customers, contractors, dealers, and service partners.
* Handle and resolve escalated service issues, ensuring timely closure and high customer satisfaction.
* Communicate regularly with DAOM management and regional teams on service performance, profitability, and improvements.
* Oversee performance management and development of the service operations team.
* Monitor job progress and ensure timely closure of pending service activities.
* Coordinate closely with spare parts teams to ensure availability of materials and minimize service delays.
* Oversee spare parts operations, including planning and inventory management for internal and external customers.
* Ensure full compliance with local regulations, company policies, and ethical standards.
* Drive implementation and maintenance of ISO standards (ISO 9001, 14001, 45001\) within the department.
* Lead recruitment, development, and retention of operational staff.
* Ensure full compliance with EHS requirements for employees, ASPs, and subcontractors.








**What You Need to Succeed** 




  




* Bachelor’s degree in engineering (Mechanical / Electrical or equivalent).
* Minimum 10 years of experience in HVAC service operations, with at least 3 \- 5 years in a managerial role.
* Proven track record of successfully managing HVAC service operations within Oman or GCC markets.
* Strong technical expertise in VRV/DX systems, chillers, controls, and airside products.
* Extensive experience managing technicians, engineers, contractors, and service providers.
* Strong commercial and financial acumen, including contracts, pricing, margins, and cash flow management.
* Experience in spare parts operations, inventory planning, and service logistics.
* Familiarity with ISO standards (ISO 9001, 14001, 45001\) and operational best practices.
* Strong leadership, team management, and coaching capabilities.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Analytical mindset with the ability to drive performance improvements.
* Customer\-focused with a strong commitment to service excellence.
* Proficiency in English (written and spoken); Arabic is an advantage.
* Experience in multinational HVAC organizations.

**Job title:** 
 Head of Corporate Planning \& Performance
 



**Stream:** 
 Finance \& Procurement
 



**Function:** 
 Finance
 



**Location:** 
 Oman – Muscat
 



**Budget control:** 
 \*OPEX and/or CAPEX and/or Revenue amount as relevant\*
 



**Reporting to:** 
 VP, Finance
 



**Direct Reports: 2** 




  





  





**Job purpose** 




 Lead and oversee the Corporate Planning \& Performance function within OQEP’s Finance stream, ensuring the development, consolidation, and delivery of integrated corporate planning, budgeting, and performance reporting frameworks that support strategic decision\-making and drive business performance across the organization.
 



  





 The position will act in accordance with the OQEP’s Mission, Vision, Values \& Strategies, as well as, policies, guidelines, and international standards, supported by an IT Technology platform, QHSE \& Energy Management System requirements standards, Omani’s government \& other legal justifications, and best international practices in consonance with national objectives.
 



  





**Main Tasks and Responsibilities** 



* Lead the development and continuous improvement of OQEP's integrated corporate planning framework, ensuring alignment between strategic objectives, financial plans, and operational targets across all business functions and streams.
* Oversee the annual corporate planning cycle including the preparation, consolidation, and submission of OQEP's Business Plan, Long\-Range Plan (LRP), and annual budget in coordination with all functions and asset teams.
* Direct the corporate budgeting process end\-to\-end, including budget guidelines issuance, consolidation of OPEX and CAPEX submissions, variance analysis, and executive\-level budget reporting.
* Lead the performance reporting function, ensuring the development and delivery of accurate, timely, and insightful management reports, dashboards, and scorecards for OQEP's executive leadership and Board.
* Oversee the development and maintenance of OQEP's corporate KPI framework, ensuring KPIs are aligned with strategic objectives, cascaded effectively across the organization, and tracked with appropriate rigor.
* Provide strategic financial insights and analytical support to VP Finance and the Executive Leadership Team to enable informed decision\-making on business performance, resource allocation, and strategic priorities.
* Lead the consolidation and analysis of mid\-year and quarterly reforecasts, highlighting performance gaps, risks, and opportunities and recommending corrective actions to leadership.
* Oversee benchmarking activities against industry peers and best practices to identify performance improvement opportunities and inform strategic planning assumptions.
* Ensure integration of corporate planning and performance management processes with OQ Group requirements, timelines, and reporting standards.
* Drive the digitalization and continuous improvement of planning and performance reporting tools, systems, and processes, leveraging advanced analytics, automation, and business intelligence platforms.
* Develop and maintain Corporate Planning \& Performance policies, procedures, standards, and governance frameworks in alignment with OQEP and OQ Group guidelines.
* Build and maintain effective relationships with functional heads, asset management teams, and OQ Group corporate functions to ensure coherent and aligned planning and performance management across OQEP.
* Lead, develop, and mentor the Corporate Planning \& Performance team, fostering a high\-performance culture and building capability within the department.
* Manage the Corporate Planning \& Performance department budget, ensuring efficient resource utilization and value delivery.
* Perform other related duties as assigned.



  





**Key interactions:** 




 Internal: Finance function, all OQEP business functions and streams, Operated Assets and Non\-Operated Assets functions, Executive Leadership Team.
 



 External: OQ Group Corporate Planning and Finance functions, external auditors and consultants, government ministries, benchmark and industry intelligence partners.
 



  





**Notable Working Conditions.** 
 Office environment, intensive computer screen use, occasional domestic and international travel.
 



  





**Education requirements:** 




**Required:** 
 Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or related field.
 



**Preferred:** 
 Postgraduate qualification (Master’s, MBA, CFA, CIMA, CA, or CPA); professional certifications in financial planning, performance management, or business analytics are an advantage.
 



  





**Language:** 
 Excellent knowledge of written, read, and spoken English (required) \| Arabic \- Native (desirable)
 



  





**Background and experience** 




  




* 10\+ years of relevant experience in corporate planning, financial planning \& analysis, budgeting, or performance management.
* Oil \& Gas / Energy industry experience strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated experience leading corporate planning and budgeting cycles at an organizational level.
* Proven track record of developing and delivering executive\-level performance reporting and KPI frameworks.
* Experience working with OQ Group or similar large integrated energy group planning processes is an advantage.
* Strong exposure to financial modelling, long\-range planning, and strategic scenario analysis.
* Previous leadership of multi\-disciplinary finance or planning teams.
* Experience with ERP and business intelligence platforms (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Power BI, Tableau) is preferred.



  





**Competencies and skills:** 




  





**Soft:** 




  




* People management and leadership.
* Strategic thinking and business\-oriented mindset.
* Strong communication, presentation, and influencing skills.
* Stakeholder management across all organizational levels including ELT and Board.
* Analytical and critical thinking.
* Change management and continuous improvement mindset.
* Attention to detail with ability to synthesize complex information into clear executive narratives.
* Cultural sensitivity in a multinational environment.



  





**Technical:** 




  




* Computer literacy including MS Office (advanced Excel and PowerPoint).
* Corporate financial planning and budgeting methodologies.
* Long\-range planning and scenario analysis.
* KPI framework design and performance management.
* Financial modelling and forecasting.
* Management reporting and dashboard development.
* Business intelligence and data analytics tools (Power BI, Tableau, or equivalent).
* ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, or equivalent).
* OQ Group / OQEP planning and reporting standards.
* Benchmarking methodologies and industry analysis.

**Job title:** 
 Manager, Geoscience

 Investment Valuations \& Strategy
 



**Location:** 
 Oman \- HO
 



**Budget control:** 
 \*OPEX and/or CAPEX and/or Revenue amount as relevant\*
 



**Reporting to:** 
 Head Investment Integrated Valuations \& Strategy
 



**Direct reports: 3** 




**Job purpose** 




  





 Lead and integrate all Geoscience (Geology, Geophysics, and Petrophysics) activities under the Commercial structure to maximize subsurface value, mature hydrocarbon resources, reduce geological uncertainty, and support economically sound investment decisions. The role ensures delivery of high\-quality subsurface interpretations, volumetric assessments, prospect maturation, and reservoir characterization to enable exploration success, field development optimization, reserves growth, and commercial negotiations.
 



  





 The position will act in accordance with the OQEP’s Mission, Vision, Values \& Strategies, as well as, policies, guidelines, and international standards, supported by an IT Technology platform, QHSE \& Energy Management System requirements standards, Omani’s government \& other legal justifications, and best international practices in consonance with national objectives.
 



**Main tasks and responsibilities:** 




  





**Strategic \& Commercial Alignment** 



* Align G\&G strategies with corporate growth objectives, portfolio strategy, and commercial targets.
* Translate subsurface insights into value\-driven business cases and investment proposals.
* Support farm\-in/farm\-out evaluations, asset acquisitions, and divestments.
* Contribute to reserves booking strategy and certification processes.



  





**Exploration \& Prospect Maturation** 



* Oversee basin analysis, play fairway evaluation, and prospect generation.
* Ensure robust risking, volumetrics, and uncertainty analysis for exploration opportunities.
* Approve prospect maturation workflows prior to drill\-ready status.
* Present subsurface evaluations to management and investment committees.



  





**Reservoir Characterization \& Development Support** 



* Integrate seismic, geological, petrophysical, and well data into coherent reservoir models.
* Guide static model construction and ensure subsurface integrity for FDPs (Field Development Plans).
* Support well planning, placement, and post\-well evaluation.
* Drive uncertainty reduction strategies to improve recovery factors and reserves classification.



  





**Technical Governance \& Quality Assurance** 



* Establish G\&G technical standards, workflows, and best practices.
* Ensure independent technical assurance and peer reviews.
* Validate subsurface risks prior to major capital commitments.
* Maintain compliance with international reporting standards (e.g., SPE\-PRMS).



  





**Data \& Digital Integration** 



* Oversee subsurface data management, seismic reprocessing strategies, and petrophysical database integrity.
* Promote digital subsurface solutions, AI\-based interpretation, and integrated modeling technologies.
* Ensure effective knowledge management and lessons learned capture.



  





**Leadership \& Capability Development** 



* Lead and develop Principal\-level technical experts.
* Foster a high\-performance, collaborative subsurface culture.
* Build succession planning and technical competency frameworks.
* Act as senior technical authority in G\&G matters.



  





**Stakeholder \& External Engagement** 



* Represent the company in JV technical committees and regulator discussions.
* Support commercial negotiations with technical subsurface insights.
* Coordinate with Drilling, Reservoir Engineering, Production, and HSSE functions.



  





**Key interactions:** 




**Internal:** 
 Operations team, Exploration team, Subsurface, support functions.
 



**External:** 
 Partners, OQEP JVs, consultancy firms, Government related entities
 



**Notable Working Conditions.** 
 Office environment, intensive computer screen use, sporadic visits to operation site.
 



**Education requirements:** 




 BS Degree in Geology, relevant science subject or equivalent. MSc degree desirable
 



**Language requirements:** 




 Excellent knowledge of written, read, and spoken English (required) Arabic \- Native (desirable)
 



**Background and experience** 




  





 • 8\+ years of relevant experience in similar role with an operator, preferably with experience in Exploration or New Ventures with various subsurface fields experience and different environments.
 


* Broad geoscience knowledge, with experience in both geophysics , geology and petrophysics.
* Experienced with both exploration and development upstream oil and gas activities including Design and Execution of FDPs.
* Experience in M\&A/International assets with VDRs and Deals Delivery is prioritized including knowledge of transactional processes and technical interface with commercial workflows.
* Managing G\&G studies and activities, as well as leading the FDPs process.
* Relevant software experience, Landmark, Petrel and ArcGIS is preferred.
* Demonstrated strong experience in the following fields:
* Well operations planning and execution
* Field appraisal and development planning
* Petrophysical evaluation and Reservoir characterization
* Prospect generation, evaluation and proposal
* Exposure to regional and new venture evaluations
* 3D Geological modelling skills, preferably in Petrel Software
* Mastery level expert user of geological interpretations systems
* Ability to work in a multi\-disciplinary team environment
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills (verbal and written) with proficiency in written and spoken English
* Preferably, an exposure of working in different local Oman/GCC geological settings clastics, carbonates, passive margins, thrust belts etc.
* Track record of deadline delivery and result oriented with ability to prioritize and deliver
* Experienced in mentoring and coaching.



**Competencies and skills:** 




**Soft:** 



* People and Leadership skills
* Leading multidisciplinary integrated teams and contribution to exploration opportunity risking and ranking.
* Must be able to work under pressure and provide input in short project timelines
* Good presentation and communication skills, written and verbal



**Technical:** 



* Computer literacy including MS Office
* Technical Leadership \& reviews
* Audits and preparation of Field Development Plans
* Self\-starter with the ability to multi task while maintaining priorities
* Project Management skills
* Possess organizational skills
* Geophysics , Petrophysics \& Geology
* Knowledgeable in geophysical, petrophysical and geological analysis integration
* Petrel \& Techlog software

data.jd_text:
**Company Description** 




 SFINX is an Active Intelligence platform that harnesses AI, computer vision, and real\-time data analytics to transform the way organizations process physical security data. By unifying unstructured data from cameras, IoT sensors, access control, and SCADA systems, SFINX provides a single intelligent interface for actionable insights. Our advanced deep learning engine enables capabilities such as behavioral analytics, facial recognition, predictive threat detection, and operational KPI monitoring. Serving modern enterprises, smart cities, and critical infrastructures, SFINX offers AI\-powered intelligence for real\-time decision\-making. With one platform, we integrate every system for comprehensive situational awareness and total visibility.
 



**About the Role** 




 We are looking for an experienced and customer focused Service Delivery Manager to lead the successful delivery of integrated physical security and smart platform projects across enterprise and government environments.
 



 The ideal candidate will manage customer relationships, oversee project execution, coordinate technical teams, and ensure operational excellence across deployments involving CCTV, access control, AI analytics, IoT, PSIM, and smart city technologies.
 



 This role requires a strong balance of technical understanding, operational leadership, and customer engagement.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 



* Lead end\-to\-end service delivery for physical security and smart platform projects.
* Manage implementation, deployment, commissioning, and post\-delivery support activities.
* Act as the primary point of contact for customers during project execution and operational support.
* Coordinate cross\-functional teams including presales, engineering, PMO, support, and external partners.
* Ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and aligned with customer expectations.
* Oversee SLAs, KPIs, incident management, escalation handling, and service reporting.
* Drive operational excellence and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Support architecture review sessions and customer workshops.
* Ensure seamless integration between CCTV, access control, IoT, AI analytics, and third\-party systems.
* Monitor project risks, resource planning, and delivery performance.
* Build long\-term customer relationships and identify opportunities for service expansion.
* Maintain high customer satisfaction and ensure successful adoption of deployed solutions.



**Required Qualifications** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field.
* 5\+ years of experience in service delivery, project management, or operations within the physical security or smart technology industry.
* Strong understanding of:
* CCTV \& Video Management Systems (VMS)
* Access Control Systems
* AI Video Analytics
* IoT \& Smart City Platforms
* PSIM / Security Integration Platforms
* Cloud and Hybrid Architectures
* Experience managing enterprise or government projects.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Strong problem\-solving and operational leadership capabilities.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.
* PMP, ITIL, or related certifications are considered a plus.
* Experience with smart cities, critical infrastructure, transportation, or enterprise security environments.
* Familiarity with API integrations, ONVIF, SDKs, and enterprise system integrations.
* Exposure to GIS platforms, analytics dashboards, and operational intelligence systems.
* Experience working with multinational customers and regional system integrators.

data.jd_text:
We are a leading international law and professional services firm providing legal, corporate and fiduciary services to global corporations, financial institutions, capital market participants and investment fund managers. With a global presence spanning the Americas, Europe, the Middle East and Asia, we advise on the laws of Bermuda, the British Virgin Islands, the Cayman Islands, Guernsey, Ireland and Jersey.
 



  





 We treat everyone as the intelligent professional they are. Our approach is to trust and empower our people to deliver consistently, and enable them to succeed. Diversity is our secret weapon – it’s the sheer breadth of Walkers people that makes us who we are – gathered from across the globe and fluent in languages, jurisdictions and cultures that help us to mirror our clients and keep our own thinking in tune with the world in which we operate.
 



  





**Overview Of Role** 




  





 This role will ideally be based in either our Dubai, Hong Kong or Singapore office.
 



 We are keen to hear from qualified candidates in London who are open to relocating to Dubai, Hong Kong or Singapore.
 



  





 This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced compliance professional with a background in the legal or professional services sector to join a team dealing with conflicts of interest and client confidentiality matters.
 



  





 Reporting to our Director of Conflicts and joining the OGC team, the successful candidate will assist with the development of a specialised team of conflicts professionals responsible for analysing, advising on and resolving legal and commercial conflicts of interest, information barriers and share dealing requests. This is to ensure we comply with all applicable regulations, professional rules of conduct, contractual terms related to conflicts of interest and client confidentiality, and protect client relationships and our reputation.
 



  





 Our conflicts analysts assist with the resolution of complex conflicts issues, deal with sensitive confidential matters, and carry out conflict checks associated with share dealing requests and lateral hires into the business.
 



  





 The Senior Conflicts Manager will work closely with the Director of Conflicts on the ongoing development of our policies, controls and processes as they relate to conflicts of interest, client confidentiality, information barriers, share dealing and Market Abuse Regulations. This will include optimising our use of tech/automation (including
 *Intapp* 
 ), standardising and simplifying our policies and processes across the Walkers group, and building an optimal team shape that provides agility, efficiency, consistency and excellent service to the business and our clients.
 



  





**Duties, Responsibilities \& Person Specification** 




  




* Day\-to\-day management of conflicts advisors within the relevant time zone (including leading the recruitment of additional conflicts advisors).
* Act as a point of escalation for the team and the business on all legal and commercial conflicts issues, analysing and resolving issues in accordance with applicable regulations, professional rules and Walkers' own policy and procedures.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders across Walkers globally, acting as a point of contact in relation to all conflicts and client confidentiality queries and leading communications across the business in this area.
* Together with other senior team members, lead on internal training as it relates to conflicts of interest, client confidentiality, share dealing and insider lists.
* Identify any weaknesses or areas for potential improvement in our existing client onboarding system (Intapp Intake) and, working with the Director of Conflicts and the Compliance Business Systems team, recommend enhancements that streamline/simplify processes for team and the business, and/or strengthen our controls.
* Working with the Director of Conflicts and key stakeholders from across the business, develop and deliver a phased programme of work that: (i) rapidly enhances our conflicts offering/service delivery to the business (including through improved time zone coverage/capacity, responsiveness, efficiency and expertise); (ii) enables us to provide a fully centralised conflict checking/analysis function within the next two years.
* Support the Director of Conflicts in driving quality, consistency, service excellence, efficiency, proactivity and adaptability across the Conflicts team.
* Assist the Director of Conflicts in developing and leading people initiatives within the Conflicts team to drive development of expertise and skills, attraction and retention, and fostering a high\-performing, collaborative and open team culture.
* Input into regular reporting to senior management and/or other stakeholders as required.
* Participate in cross\-functional initiatives which impact or relate to conflicts of interest and client confidentiality.
* Keep abreast with developments in regulation, technology and the market which are relevant to conflicts of interest, client confidentiality, market abuse/insider trading, and information barriers.



  





**Education, Skills \& Experience** 




  




* Bachelor's degree in law, business, finance or another relevant field.
* Experience in a compliance or in\-house legal role in an international law firm or professional services environment.
* Compliance expert with deep technical and practical knowledge of legal conflicts of interest, commercial conflicts and client confidentiality, with some knowledge of Market Abuse Regs.
* Familiarity with Intapp Intake.
* Experience of policy work.
* Experience of people management, including supervision/management of large teams and experience devising and driving people initiatives (including around recruitment and development).
* Proven track record of delivering change and process improvements.
* Experience working in an offshore environment or with offshore structures would be helpful but not required
* Strategic: ability to work in pursuit of a clear strategic direction, align the team's priorities with those of the wider OGC team and the firm, and proactively identify improvements.
* Leadership: ability to lead and inspire the team, drive collaboration and foster a high\-performing team culture.
* Technical: deep knowledge of relevant regulations and professional rules as they relate to conflicts of interest and client confidentiality, and an ability to apply these in practice.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills: solutions\-orientated with the ability to interpret complex fact patterns to reach decisions or develop clear recommendations.
* Quality: strong attention to detail and produces high quality work product.
* Judgement: confident taking decisions, with sound judgement of when to escalate issues or seek further opinions.
* Adaptable: willingness to embrace change and uncertainty and manage competing demands in a dynamic and fast\-paced environment; willing to constructively challenge the status quo.
* Communication: strong verbal and written communication skills, ensuring communications are properly targeted, persuasive, accurate and accessible.
* Emotional intelligence: ability to empathise, understand, and manage emotions effectively, fostering a positive and inclusive work environment.
* Collaborative: builds strong and effective relationships with stakeholders and peers; works collaboratively with colleagues across the business. A "one\-team" ethos.
* Commercial: sound, commercially driven decision\-making. A relentless focus on service excellence.
* Familiarity with Intapp.



  





**Other** 




  




* Walkers is a global business and this role may therefore require audio or video conferencing outside of normal business hours.
* This role will be based in either our Dubai, Hong Kong or Singapore office. However, our agile working policy does allow some home working each week.
* Some international travel may be required.

* Drive operational excellence initiatives and cost optimization programs while maintaining high patient satisfaction standards.

* Establish structured governance forums and operational review mechanisms to ensure alignment between clinical and administrative functions.
* Collaborate closely with Medical Directors on service planning, staffing, scheduling, and operational improvements.
* Support implementation of corrective operational actions tied to quality and patient experience outcomes.



**Regulatory Compliance \& Accreditation** 



* Ensure full compliance with UAE healthcare regulatory authorities and licensing requirements.

* Oversee compliance related to data privacy, financial governance, radiation safety, and organizational policies.
* Represent the organization in engagements with regulators, insurers, investors, and external stakeholders.



**Leadership \& Culture** 



* Build and mentor a high\-performing leadership team across clinical support and non\-clinical departments.
* Drive workforce planning, organizational effectiveness, employee engagement, and retention initiatives.
* Foster a culture focused on accountability, collaboration, operational excellence, and patient\-centered care.

**Digital Transformation \& Analytics**

**Governance \& Board Reporting**

**Job Description** 




**Project Coordinator – Client Side (F\&B, Leisure \& Fit\-Out Projects)** 




 Location
 



 Dubai, UAE
 



 Reporting To
 



 Project Manager / Senior Project Manager
 








**Role Overview** 




 We are seeking a highly organized and tech\-savvy Project Support Coordinator to assist the Project Management team on client\-side F\&B, leisure, hospitality, fit\-out, and construction projects.
 



 The role will support project delivery through technical coordination, document management, reporting, procurement support, commercial tracking, and stakeholder coordination while leveraging modern AI tools and digital platforms to improve efficiency, reporting quality, and project controls.
 



 The ideal candidate should possess strong analytical and organizational capabilities, excellent communication skills, and the ability to manage multiple workstreams in a fast\-paced project environment.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Project Coordination \& Administration** 



* Support the Project Manager in coordinating multiple projects from design through execution and handover.
* Track project deliverables, schedules, approvals, risks, and action items.
* Coordinate with consultants, contractors, suppliers, operators, and internal stakeholders.
* Prepare meeting agendas, minutes, and follow\-up trackers.
* Maintain organized project documentation, correspondence logs, and filing systems.
* Assist in monitoring project progress against timelines and key milestones.



  





**Technical \& Commercial Support** 



* Assist in preparation of draft RFPs, tender documentation, and scope summaries.
* Support review and comparison of BOQs, quotations, and contractor submissions.
* Assist in tracking payment applications, variations, invoices, and procurement logs.
* Support coordination and review of drawings, specifications, and consultant deliverables.
* Maintain trackers for RFIs, submittals, approvals, and change management items.



  





**Reporting \& Dashboard Management** 



* Compile drafts
* Weekly and monthly project reports
* Progress dashboards
* Commercial and budget trackers
* Procurement status reports
* Risk and action trackers
* Executive summaries and presentations
* Assist in preparing clear visual reports for management and stakeholders.
* Support data analysis and reporting accuracy across projects.



**AI \& Digital Tools Integration** 



* Utilize AI tools and digital platforms to improve project administration and reporting workflows.
* Use AI\-assisted applications for:
* Drafting reports and meeting minutes
* Summarizing project updates
* Organizing project data
* Preparing dashboards and presentations
* Supporting BOQ and document review
* Tracking project progress and deliverables
* Support implementation of digital project management and document control systems.
* Identify opportunities for automation and process improvement using AI\-enabled tools.



  





**Preferred Software \& Tools** 




 Experience with some or all of the following is preferred:
 


* Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint)
* Microsoft Project / Primavera P6
* Power BI
* ChatGPT / Microsoft Copilot
* Procore / Autodesk Construction Cloud
* SharePoint / Document Management Systems
* Teams’ collaboration platforms



  





**Qualifications \& Experience** 



* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Architecture, Construction Management, Project Management, or related field.
* 2–5 years of experience in project coordination, project support, PMO, or construction administration roles.
* Experience in F\&B, hospitality, fit\-out, retail, leisure, or construction projects is preferred.
* Client\-side, consultancy, or developer\-side experience is advantageous.



  





**Skills \& Competencies** 



* Strong organizational and coordination skills
* Good commercial and analytical understanding
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
* Attention to detail and problem\-solving mindset
* Strong reporting and presentation capabilities
* High proficiency in digital tools and willingness to adopt AI technologies
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in fast\-paced project environments



  





**Key Attributes** 



* Detail\-oriented and proactive
* Tech\-enabled and process\-driven
* Strong follow\-up and accountability
* Adaptable and solution\-oriented
* Collaborative with a positive attitude



  





**Preferred Industry Exposure** 




 Experience supporting projects within:
 


* F\&B and restaurant developments
* Hospitality and leisure projects
* Interior fit\-out and retail rollouts
* Multi\-site project coordination
* Construction and refurbishment projects

* Manage P\&L for working capital \& real estate portfolios.
* Develop annual product plans, pricing strategies, and performance targets.
* Track product performance and implement corrective actions.
* Ensure compliance with regulatory and internal risk policies.
* Maintain sound portfolio quality and prudent underwriting standards.
* Lead a team of Product Managers and Analysts.

* Minimum 10 years of banking or financial services experience, with at least 5–7 years in product management.

* Exposure to high\-impact strategic projects

data.jd_text:
The AVP – Financial Crime Compliance plays a hands\-on role in building, running, and continuously improving the Bank’s AML/CTF framework. This position is responsible for how the AML program works day to day — making sure it is practical, effective, and fully aligned with UAE AML laws, Central Bank regulations, and UAE FIU expectations.
 



 The role combines technical ownership with operational leadership. It covers everything from maintaining AML policies and overseeing transaction monitoring systems, to guiding investigations and ensuring suspicious activity is identified, escalated, and reported properly. It also acts as a key escalation point to the Head of Compliance and the MLRO on AML risks, breaches, and program gaps.
 



  





 Main Duties and Responsibilities:
 



**Strategic Contribution** 



* Establish and maintain adequate support structures (people, processes, tools, frameworks, systems) to facilitate sustainable business growth and mitigate FCC risks.



**People Management** 



* Lead and manage the AML team by setting clear individual goals, monitoring performance, and supporting the development and motivation of team members to help them perform at their best.
* Work closely with the Compliance Governance \& Assurance team as a subject\-matter expert, supporting the design and delivery of AML training programmes across the business.
* Provide day\-to\-day guidance and on\-the\-job coaching to junior colleagues and regularly facilitate knowledge\-sharing sessions for the Compliance and FLOD teams.
* Act as a role model for both direct and indirect reports, promoting strong ethical standards, reinforcing organizational values, and helping to build a culture rooted in integrity and accountability across the bank.



**AML/CTF Oversight and Advisory** 



* Oversee the design, implementation, and ongoing effectiveness of the AML/CTF program. Ensure the framework remains aligned with evolving regulatory expectations, current financial crime risks, and emerging typologies.
* Provide senior oversight of transaction monitoring, suspicious activity management, and AML systems, ensuring strong governance, effective controls, and timely escalation of material issues. Act as a key advisor on AML/CTF matters across the bank, supporting business units, Compliance teams, and senior management on complex or high\-risk issues.
* Lead regulatory and external engagement on financial crime matters, including interactions with supervisory authorities, the FIU, correspondent banks, and law\-enforcement agencies. Support the Head of Compliance in regulatory relationship management.
* Own AML transaction monitoring systems and oversee its effectiveness to support operational controls, including acting as an SME to define system requirements, parameters, scenarios, logic, and underlying models
* Own and continuously enhance the AML technology landscape, including transaction monitoring frameworks, system effectiveness, and risk models, working closely with Compliance systems vendor to ensure the program remains robust, scalable, and future\-ready.
* Act as a subject\-matter expert, providing trusted AML/CTF advice and support to business units and Compliance teams.
* Act as a subject\-matter expert on customer risk assessment methodologies and rating models, supporting their periodic review, testing, and ongoing enhancement.
* Ensure timely and effective remediation of issues identified through RCSAs, internal and external audits, and regulatory supervisory reviews.
* Lead and contribute to AML/CTF\-related projects in line with project governance standards.



**Reporting** 



* Ensure that the Head of Compliance, and Senior Management are well informed of critical AML/CTF compliance plans, initiatives, escalations, and issues.
* Prepare MLRO report as required by CBUAE regulation.

data.jd_text:
**Job Summary**
 We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Director for Compliance, Financial Crime \& Conduct Risk (CFCR) Advisory within the Wholesale and Retail Banking (WRB) division based in Dubai, UAE. This senior role reports directly to the Head of CFCR Advisory and plays a critical part in managing regulatory, compliance, conduct, and financial crime risks associated with the bank's WRB operations.
   

  

 In this role, you will take on first\-line accountability for delivering robust compliance oversight and control mechanisms across the WRB function, aligning closely with the Group's Strategic Enterprise Risk Management Framework. You will champion the design, implementation, and continuous improvement of compliance and financial crime prevention policies and controls, thereby strengthening the integrity and resilience of WRB activities.
   

  

 With direct responsibility for the oversight of processes including those outsourced or hubbed, you will ensure adherence to operational risk frameworks and governance standards. Your insights will support risk appetite management and early identification of emerging risks or potential regulatory concerns, enabling swift escalation and decisive action by senior leadership.
   

  

 This role requires exceptional advisory capabilities, a strategic mindset, and the ability to work collaboratively across multiple stakeholders to foster a strong risk and compliance culture within a complex and evolving banking environment.
   

  

**Role Objectives**
 The Director will lead the CFCR Advisory efforts within WRB by developing strategies that mitigate financial crime risks, uphold the highest standards of conduct, and ensure full regulatory compliance. You will serve as a trusted advisor to senior business leaders, providing timely and pragmatic guidance on regulatory developments and compliance challenges.
   

  

 By partnering with various internal functions including legal, risk, and business units, you will streamline processes to embed compliance into day\-to\-day operations effectively. Your leadership will enable proactive management of risks and help sustain the bank’s reputation and operational soundness.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will foster an environment where innovation and diligence coexist, encouraging continuous learning, adaptability, and collaboration to meet the demands of a dynamic regulatory landscape.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Strategic Leadership: Collaborate with the Head of CFCR Advisory to define, communicate, and implement the overarching CFCR strategy that supports both UAE and DIFC regulatory requirements and aligns with the bank’s global objectives.
* Collaboration and Alignment: Build and maintain strong partnerships with CFCR leads across various client segments and product teams to promote a unified, consistent approach to risk management under the One Bank philosophy.
* Process Design and Oversight: Lead the end\-to\-end design and ongoing refinement of compliance and financial crime prevention processes within WRB, including oversight of outsourced operations while ensuring compliance with group governance frameworks.
* Risk Identification and Reporting: Proactively identify emerging risks or potential regulatory breaches, facilitating timely escalation and transparent reporting to senior management and relevant governance bodies.
* Policy Implementation: Ensure rigorous application of CFCR policies across WRB, delivering compliance reviews, risk assessments, advisory services, and assurance activities tailored to business needs and regulatory expectations.
* Change and Project Leadership: Manage projects addressing regulatory changes and process improvements that enhance risk frameworks and operational resilience, driving a culture of continuous enhancement and agility.
* Regulatory Engagement: Serve as the primary liaison with UAE regulators for inspections and audits related to WRB, coordinating responses and ensuring comprehensive remediation of any identified findings.


**Key Accountabilities**
* Deliver robust advisory support across the WRB function to ensure consistent application of compliance and financial crime controls.
* Ensure comprehensive risk assessments are performed and controls effectively mitigate identified risks.
* Maintain high standards of governance by overseeing compliance adherence to policies and procedures.
* Provide insightful and accurate risk reporting that supports informed decision\-making by executive management.
* Lead training and awareness initiatives to embed a strong risk culture amongst business units.
* Champion collaboration with internal and external stakeholders to harmonize risk management practices and regulatory engagement.


**Operational Excellence**
 Drive continuous improvement in compliance and financial crime risk management through innovative approaches and leveraging technology where possible. Foster a culture of operational excellence by implementing best practices, standardising workflows, and promoting accountability at all levels. Coordinate with technology and data teams to develop enhanced surveillance tools and reporting mechanisms that support proactive risk detection and mitigation.
   

  

 Your role will encompass ensuring all CFCR initiatives are delivered on time, within scope, and with measurable impact on risk reduction and operational effectiveness.
   

  

**Risk Advisory and Governance**
 Provide expert advice and challenge to the WRB business on regulatory and compliance matters, financial crime risks, and conduct standards. Effectively translate complex regulatory requirements into practical business solutions that balance risk and opportunity. Participate actively in governance forums and working groups, ensuring alignment of WRB practices with group policies and regulatory expectations. Support the development and implementation of risk appetite frameworks and risk limits pertaining to compliance and financial crime risks.
   

  

**Stakeholder Relationship Management**
 Build and nurture strong relationships with key internal stakeholders including senior business leaders, risk and control functions, legal, and compliance teams, as well as external regulators and industry bodies. Act as a credible and trusted resource delivering sound advice and promoting transparency and proactive risk management. Facilitate cross\-functional collaboration to enhance overall risk governance and operational resilience.
   

  

**Change and Transformation**
 Lead transformational initiatives that embed a sustainable and adaptable risk culture within WRB. Manage change effectively by aligning initiatives with business priorities while ensuring compliance requirements are met. Drive adoption of new regulatory frameworks and technology solutions that enhance efficiency and effectiveness of compliance processes. Support and mentor teams through change to ensure continuity and high performance.
   

  

**Team Leadership and Development**
 Although this is not a direct people leadership role, you will play a key role in influencing and mentoring colleagues across the CFCR Advisory and broader risk teams. Promote continuous professional development by identifying learning needs and fostering a collaborative, supportive environment that encourages knowledge sharing and skills enhancement.
   

  

 Your leadership will contribute to building a resilient, competent, and engaged risk community aligned with the bank's values and strategic objectives.
   

  

**Compliance Culture and Ethical Standards**
 Champion integrity, ethical behaviour, and compliance with laws and regulations as foundational principles within the WRB division. Promote awareness and accountability regarding conduct risk and financial crime prevention. Embed risk and compliance awareness into all levels of the organisation, ensuring that all employees understand their responsibilities and uphold the highest standards.
   

  

**Work Environment**
 This is a full\-time office\-based role located in Dubai, working within a highly dynamic and multicultural environment. You will engage with diverse teams and stakeholders across the UAE and the broader Middle East region.
   

  

**Skills And Experience**
* Significant experience in compliance, conduct risk, and financial crime management within a regulated banking environment, preferably with exposure to both wholesale and retail banking.
* Comprehensive knowledge of UAE and DIFC regulatory regimes, as well as relevant international standards and best practices.
* Proven track record in leading compliance frameworks, advisory functions, and risk mitigation strategies.
* Strong analytical and investigative skills, comfortable interpreting complex regulatory requirements and translating them into actionable policies and procedures.
* Experience managing relationships with regulators and adept at responding to audits, inspections, and regulatory inquiries.
* Strong project leadership skills with the ability to implement change and manage multiple initiatives concurrently.
* Exceptional communication abilities, capable of conveying complex information clearly and persuasively to a variety of audiences including senior executives.
* Collaborative working style with aptitude for influencing across functions and geographies in a matrix organisation.


**Qualifications**
* The ideal candidate will hold a relevant university degree supplemented by professional certifications such as Certified Anti\-Money Laundering Specialist (CAMS), Chartered Institute for Securities \& Investment (CISI) qualifications, or equivalent compliance and risk credentials.
* Fluency in both Arabic and English is essential to navigate regulatory communications effectively and engage with diverse stakeholders across the UAE.
* Additional academic or professional qualifications in law, finance, or risk management will be advantageous, alongside a demonstrable commitment to continuous professional development.


**About Standard Chartered**
**About Standard Chartered**
 Standard Chartered is a leading international bank with a rich heritage of over 170 years, deeply committed to fostering sustainable and inclusive economic growth in the communities we serve globally. Renowned for our innovative and agile approach, we continuously challenge the status quo to bring new solutions and drive meaningful change.
   

  

 Our purpose is clear: to drive commerce and prosperity through our distinctive diversity and inclusive culture. We uphold values centred on integrity, innovation, and respect for differences, creating an empowering workplace where all colleagues feel valued and inspired to contribute to the organisation’s success.
   

  

 Joining Standard Chartered means becoming part of a vibrant, diverse global community dedicated to making a positive impact and achieving excellence in everything we do.
   

  

**What We Offer**
**What We Offer**
 We offer a comprehensive and competitive remuneration package aligned with our Fair Pay Charter, designed to support the holistic wellbeing of our colleagues – mentally, physically, financially, and socially.
   

  

* Benefits: Inclusive of pension schemes, medical and life insurance, alongside flexible benefits tailored to individual and local needs.
* Generous Leave: Extensive leave options including parental and maternity leave of up to 20 weeks, sabbaticals up to 12 months, volunteer leave, and a minimum 30 days of combined annual and public holidays.
* Flexible Work Arrangements: Options to support work\-life integration encompassing office presence and remote work.
* Wellbeing Initiatives: Access to leading digital wellbeing tools such as Unmind, resilience development programmes, Employee Assistance Programmes, and focused mental health support.
* Learning and Development: Commitment to continuous learning through diverse training platforms to support career growth and skill advancement.
* Inclusive Culture: A values\-driven, respectful workplace embracing diversity at all levels to empower every individual to reach their full potential.

**Job Summary**
 You will act as a specialist advisor across Fintech, NPM and Crypto/Digital Assets, providing first\-line risk management support to Client Coverage in a rapidly evolving segment. Working across lines of business, you will partner closely with Product and Compliance colleagues, support client engagement and market advocacy, and help strengthen non\-financial risk management (Conduct, Regulatory, Financial Crime, Operational and Reputational risks) across the client lifecycle.
   

  

* Provide expert first\-line risk advisory support to Coverage teams
* Help shape segment and client selection strategy aligned to risk appetite
* Engage key stakeholders across Client Lifecycle, Financial Crime, Technology and Compliance
* Drive awareness, training and management information (MI/MIS) to improve risk outcomes


**Key Responsibilities**
 Strategy \& portfolio direction
   

  

* Support the development and implementation of client strategy for the Fintech/NPM and Crypto portfolio across prospecting, pre\-onboarding risk assessment, onboarding, and ongoing maintenance/growth.
* Help deliver an effective target operating model for FI Client Risk Advisory, ensuring alignment to risk appetite and agreed parameters.
* Provide expert risk, control and governance guidance to Financial Institutions segment leaders and their teams, supporting execution of relevant strategies.
* Bring strategic insight on how the Fintech landscape is evolving and the implications for the portfolio.
* Develop the advisory offering to FI clients and Coverage teams, driving stronger ownership of risk, controls and governance in the first line.


 Risk management (first line)
   

  

* Support effective risk oversight and reporting for the portfolio across relevant principal risk types.
* Coach Coverage Bankers to identify, manage and remediate key risk issues, coordinating holistically with stakeholders and escalating as appropriate.
* Partner with Product and Conduct \& Financial Crime Risk (CFCR/CFCC as relevant) on emerging trends, high\-risk transactions and activities so processes and controls keep pace.
* Lead/support development of management information (MI/MIS) to enable better\-informed decision\-making.
* Lead/support development of training to improve portfolio risk awareness across Coverage teams.


 Business partnership
   

  

* Support review of clients and prospects against internal standards on risk tolerance, footprint fit, business potential, values and market perception—ensuring we bank the right clients.
* Create a culture of trusted advice to Coverage Bankers, aligned to effective risk management principles and the bank’s control/process frameworks.
* Continuously build industry and product knowledge personally and across the wider team; build institutional knowledge in disruptive technologies (e.g., AI/ML, cryptocurrencies, agile).
* Support Coverage teams to deepen knowledge of Fintech/NPMs and Crypto, and the bank’s related product offerings.
* In combination with the FI Business Lead, help drive high\-quality, well\-governed, risk\-appropriate revenues and returns.


 Process improvement
   

  

* Support regular reviews of risk processes to identify challenges and opportunities for improvement.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to streamline FI risk processes across the organisation (including CFCR/CFCC, IMO, FI Risk and Product partners).
* Drive improvements to process design and execution critical to success across onboarding, offboarding and active supervision through the client lifecycle.


 People \& talent
   

  

* Work closely with colleagues and stakeholders to enhance quality and ensure on\-time completion of deliverables.
* Advise on training and development; provide oversight to ensure critical roles are appropriately skilled, qualified and effectively supervised.
* Role\-model leadership through influence and partnership.


 Governance \& regulatory engagement
   

  

* Prepare and present papers and reports to senior management and governance forums on industry, client and portfolio matters.
* Support good governance of the portfolio; ensure the team is conversant with and compliant with relevant governance procedures.
* Support internal audits and regulatory exams by proactively identifying and remediating areas for improvement.
* Maintain awareness and understanding of the regulatory framework and expectations relevant to the Fintech/NPM segment.


 Regulatory \& business conduct
   

  

* Demonstrate exemplary conduct and live the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
* Embed the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, ensuring compliance with applicable laws, regulations and guidelines.
* Identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters collaboratively.
* Engage with regulators openly and cooperatively, understanding the evolving regulatory and risk environment.


**Experience**
**Skills and Experience**
* Experience in Payments, Fintech, Digital Assets and/or Correspondent Banking (or closely related areas).
* Strong understanding of non\-financial risk management, including Conduct, Regulatory, Financial Crime, Operational and Reputational risks.
* Proven ability to partner across lines of business and influence senior stakeholders without direct reporting lines.


**Skills**
* Business markets and industry knowledge
* Strategic planning and portfolio/segment strategy support
* Client relationship management
* Risk management, controls and governance
* Ability to translate emerging sector trends into practical guidance, MI and training


**Qualifications**
 Qualifications
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree required; advanced education preferred.
* Memberships such as ACAMS and/or ICA preferred.
* English required.


**About Standard Chartered**
 We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other.
